function supportsTerm(before, after, token, original, mode) {
  before = withoutQuoteWrappers(before + "a").slice(0, -1);
  after = withoutQuoteWrappers("a" + after).slice(1);
  if (mode === "affirmative" && (deniedListPrefix.test(before) || deniedEnglishSuffix.test(after) || deniedChineseSuffix.test(after) || !affirmativeUse.test(before) && deniedListSuffix.test(after))) return false;
  if (/^clean\s/u.test(token) && (/\b(?:the|some|with|using|used|have|had|received|needs?|requires?|from)\s+$/u.test(before) || /^\s+(?:is|was|will be|must be)\b/u.test(after))) return false;
  if (/^(?:cleaned|cleansed)\s/u.test(token) && /\b(?:the|with|used|using|received|downloaded|provided)\s+$/u.test(before)) return false;
  if (wholeCleaningAction.test(token) && /^(?:库|中心|机房|硬件|设备|\s+(?:cent(?:er|re)|racks?|cabinets?|hardware|cables?)\b)/u.test(after)) return false;
  if (token === "it") return original.normalize("NFKC") === "IT";
  if (token === "react" || token === "excel") {
    const toolUse = toolUsePrefix.test(before);
    if (!toolUse && (/\b(?:i|we|you|they|can|could|must|should|will|would)\s+$/u.test(before) || token === "react" && /^\s+(?:(?:(?:more|less)\s+)?[a-z]+ly|faster|slower|better|worse|to|when|if)\b/u.test(after) || token === "excel" && /^\s+(?:at|in)\b/u.test(after))) return false;
    const technicalNoun = token === "react" ? /^\s+components?\b/u : /^\s+spreadsheets?\b/u;
    if (original.normalize("NFKC") === token && !toolUse && !technicalNoun.test(after)) return false;
  }
  if (["go", "r", "c"].includes(token)) {
    return !before.trim() && /^[.!。\s]*$/u.test(after) && /^[A-Z]/u.test(original.normalize("NFKC")) || languageUsePrefix.test(before) || /^\s*(?:\b(?:language|code|programming|scripts?|packages?|developer)\b|语言|代码|脚本|开发)/u.test(after);
  }
  return true;
}
function* literalEvidence(quote, token, mode) {
  for (let at = quote.normalized.indexOf(token); at >= 0; at = quote.normalized.indexOf(token, at + 1)) {
    const limit = at + token.length, start = quote.offsets.get(at), end = quote.offsets.get(limit);
    if (start === void 0 || end === void 0 || end - start > maxLabelLength) continue;
    const before = quote.normalized.slice(0, at), after = quote.normalized.slice(limit), original = quote.text.slice(start, end);
    if (!wordBoundary(quote, at) || !wordBoundary(quote, limit) && !/^['’]s\b/u.test(after) && !hanNominalEndBoundary(quote, limit, token)) continue;
    if (/[.#+]$|[\p{L}\p{N}_]-$/u.test(before) || /^[#+]|^[.-][\p{L}\p{N}_]/u.test(after)) continue;
    if (before.endsWith(":") && !skillHeadingPrefix.test(before) || /^:[\p{L}\p{M}\p{N}_:]/u.test(after)) continue;
    if (supportsTerm(before, after, token, original, mode)) yield original;
  }
}
function uniqueEvidence(quote, forms, mode) {
  let evidence = null;
  const phrases = forms === cleaningNames ? /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...forms, ...Array.from(quote.normalized.matchAll(cleaningSpans), (match) => match[0])]) : forms;
  for (const form of phrases) {
    for (const match of literalEvidence(quote, form, mode)) {
      if (evidence !== null && evidence !== match) return null;
      evidence = match;
    }
  }
  return evidence;
}
function findSkillMatch(text, label, mode) {
  const token = skillToken(label);
  if (!token) return null;
  const forms = reviewedGroup(token);
  return uniqueEvidence(indexQuote(text), forms ?? [token], mode);
}
function groundSkillMatches(quote, terms, mode) {
  if (!terms.length) return [];
  const source = indexQuote(quote), labels = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const term of terms.slice(0, MAX_MATERIAL_SKILL_LABELS_PER_ITEM)) {
    const token = skillToken(term);
    if (!token) continue;
    const evidence = uniqueEvidence(source, [token], mode);
    if (!evidence) continue;
    const forms = reviewedGroup(token);
    if (forms && uniqueEvidence(source, forms, mode) !== evidence) continue;
    labels.add(forms?.[0] ?? evidence);
  }
  return [...labels];
}
function findMaterialSkillEvidence(text, label) {
  return findSkillMatch(text, label, "affirmative");
}
function groundMaterialSkillTerms(quote, terms) {
  return groundSkillMatches(quote, terms, "affirmative");
}
function findMaterialSkillMention(text, label) {
  return findSkillMatch(text, label, "mention");
}
function groundMaterialSkillMentions(quote, terms) {
  return groundSkillMatches(quote, terms, "mention");
}

  if (!evidence) return false;
  if (findMaterialSkillEvidence(maskQuotes(text), label) !== null) return true;
  return Array.from(text.matchAll(quoted)).some((match) => match[0].slice(1, -1).trim() === evidence);
}
var supervised = /\b(?:under (?:[\w'’-]+ ){0,2}(?:supervision|guidance|review)|with (?:[\w'’-]+ ){0,3}(?:guidance|supervision|review)|with (?:my|a|the) (?:mentor|instructor|supervisor)(?:['’]s help|(?=,))|(?:during|in|on) (?:a|my|the) supervised (?:placement|internship|exercise|workshop|lab|session|project))\b/iu;
var instructionalPractice = /\b(?:(?:using|following|followed)\s+(?:(?:[\w'’-]+)\s+){0,3}(?:tutorials?|runbooks?|examples?|review notes))\b/iu;
var deniedInstructionalPractice = /\b(?:without(?:\s+(?:using|following))?|(?:not|(?:isn|aren|wasn|weren)['’]t)\s+(?:using|following)|(?:used|using|following|followed)\s+(?:no|zero|none|neither|not(?:\s+even)?\s+(?:a|an|any|one))|never\s+(?:used|followed))\b[^.;]{0,45}\b(?:tutorials?|runbooks?|examples?|review notes)\b/iu;
var chineseGuidance = /^(?:我|本人)?(?:之前|目前|此前|曾经|只|仅|曾|还)*(?:在[^，,；;。]{0,20}(?:指导|监督|辅导|带领|复核|审阅|review)\s*下|由[^，,；;。]{1,16}(?:指导|带领)|(?:跟随|跟着|按(?:照)?|依照)[^，,；;。]{0,18}?(?:教程|示例|样例|示范|演示|评审反馈)|(按(?:照)?指导))/iu;
var practiceAction = /(?:练习|演练|复现|操作|使用|实现|完成|实践|调试|配置|部署|搭建|编写|制作|做过|执行|测试|修复|排查|构建|开发|设置|改成|改写)/u;
var personalPassivePractice = new RegExp("^\u7531(?:\u6211|\u672C\u4EBA)(?=(?:\u4EB2\u81EA|\u72EC\u7ACB|\u76F4\u63A5|\u8D1F\u8D23|\u6765|\u7EE7\u7EED)*" + practiceAction.source + ")", "u");
var guidedNegation = /\b(?:without (?:any )?(?:guidance|supervision)|(?:under|with) (?:no|zero) (?:guidance|supervision)|(?:not|(?:isn|aren|wasn|weren)['’]t)\s+(?:under|with)\s+(?:[\w'’-]+\s+){0,3}(?:guidance|supervision|review))\b|(?:无须|无需|没有|未经|未受)(?:任何|导师|同伴|老师|他人|的)*(?:指导|监督|复核)|(?:下|指导[，,]\s*)(?:并|也|仍)?(?:未能|不会|没有|不曾|从未)/iu;
function instructionalFragmentStart(part) {
  const heading = /^([^:：;；.。]{1,80})\s*[:：]\s*/u.exec(part);
  if (heading) {
    const title = heading[1].trim();
    const personal = /^(?:my(?: own)? )?(?:placement|internship|lab|exercise|practice project)$|^(?:我(?:的)?|本人(?:的)?)?(?:实习|练习|演练|项目)$/iu.test(title);
    const affiliation = /^(.+?)\s+(?:实习|internship|placement)$/iu.exec(title)?.[1];
    const namedAffiliation = affiliation !== void 0 && /^\p{Lu}[\p{L}\p{N}-]*(?:\s+\p{Lu}[\p{L}\p{N}-]*){1,4}$/u.test(affiliation) && !/\b(?:my|our|your|her|his|their|its|the|team|group|colleague|mentor|supervisor|report|example|sample|plan|planned|future|upcoming|proposed)\b/iu.test(affiliation);
    if (!personal && !namedAffiliation) return null;
  }
  const start = heading?.[0].length ?? 0, body = part.slice(start);
  return !deniedInstructionalPractice.test(body) && /^(?:followed|used)\s+(?:[\w'’-]+\s+){0,3}(?:runbooks?|tutorials?|examples?)\s+to\s+(?:inspect|configure|trace|test|build|write|debug|repair|implement|calibrate)\b/iu.test(body) ? start : null;
}
function guidedPractice(part, sourceMentions = false) {
  if (guidedNegation.test(part)) return false;
  const context = /^(?:\d{4}年)?(?:在|参与|练习|演练|实习|项目)[^，,；;。]{1,100}[，,]\s*/u.exec(part);
  const body = context && !/(?:团队|小组|我们|同事|导师|经理|他们|她们|表示|声称|说明|报告|计划|打算|将要|未|没有)/u.test(context[0]) ? part.slice(context[0].length) : part;
  const zh = chineseGuidance.exec(body);
  if (zh) {
    const action2 = body.slice(zh[0].length).replace(/^[，,\s]*(?:我|本人)?/u, "");
    if (sourceMentions && /^清洗|^对[^，,；;。!?！？]{1,80}清洗/u.test(action2)) {
      const clause = action2.replace(/[，,；;。.!?！？\s]+$/u, "").trim();
      const evidence = findMaterialSkillEvidence(clause, "data cleaning");
      return evidence !== null && evidence === clause;
    }
    const practice = practiceAction.exec(action2);
    if (!practice || zh[1] && practice.index !== 0) return false;
    const assertion = action2.slice(practice.index + practice[0].length).split(/[，,；;。!?！？]|\.(?![A-Za-z0-9_])/u, 1)[0];
    if (/^不了/u.test(assertion) || /是.*计划\s*$|的计划(?:尚|还|仍)?未执行/u.test(assertion)) return false;
    if (action2.startsWith("\u7531") && !personalPassivePractice.test(action2)) return false;
    return !/^(?:团队|小组|我们|同事|其他人|学员们|他们|她们|安排|要求|让|叫|记录|说明|解释|报告|描述|计划|打算|准备|将|会|没有|未能|不会)/u.test(action2);
  }
  if (instructionalFragmentStart(part) !== null) return true;
  if (!supervised.test(part) && !(instructionalPractice.test(part) && !deniedInstructionalPractice.test(part))) return false;
  const actor = /\bI\s+/iu.exec(part);
  if (!actor) return false;
  const prefix = part.slice(0, actor.index);
  if (prefix && !(/^(?:with|under|during|in|on)\b/iu.test(prefix) && supervised.test(prefix)) && !/^(?:at|in|on|during|with (?:a|my|the) (?:mentor|instructor|supervisor))\s+[^,;]{1,100},\s*$/iu.test(prefix)) return false;
  const action = part.slice(actor.index + actor[0].length);
  if (/^(?:(?:have|had|also|only|previously|personally)\s+)*did\s+not\b(?!\s+only\b)/iu.test(action)) return false;
  if (/\b(?:documented|reported|explained|described|recorded|noted|said|wrote)\b[^.;]{0,80}\b(?:that|how|whether)\b/iu.test(action) || /\b(?:my|our|the|a|an)\s+(?:colleagues?|team|manager|mentor|interns?|supervisor)\s+(?:used|built|practised|practiced|rehearsed|ran|wrote|made|tested|configured|implemented)\b/iu.test(action)) return false;
  return /^(?:(?:have|had|also|only|previously|personally)\s+)*(?:[\w-]+ed|built|ran|wrote|made|did|set|took|drew|used)\b/iu.test(action) && !/\b(?:planned|enrolled|hired|intended|asked|wanted|expected|hoped|watched|observed|pretended|claimed)\b/iu.test(action);
}
function guidedSkillScope(raw, text, sourceMentions = false) {
  if (!guidedPractice(text, sourceMentions)) return null;
  const fragment = instructionalFragmentStart(text);
  if (fragment !== null) return raw.slice(fragment);
  const actor = /\bI\s+/iu.exec(text);
  return actor ? raw.slice(actor.index) : raw;
}
var scopeBreak = /[;；]|,?\s+\b(?:but|whereas|while|although|however|rather than|except for|excluding)\b\s*|,?\s+\band\s+(?=(?:I|we|our|they|my|she|he|the|have|had|never|not|independently)\b)|(?:,\s*|\s+and\s+)(?=(?:[\p{L}\p{N}_][\p{L}\p{N}_.+#'’-]*\s+){1,5}(?:is|are|was|were|has|have|uses?|used|requires?|manages?|maintains?)\b)|[,，]\s*(?=(?:I|not|except)\b)|[，,]?\s*(?:但是|不过|然而|而非|但(?=[\p{L}]))|[，,]\s*(?=(?:我|本人|同事|导师|团队|小组|他们|她们|(?:可|能|能够|可以|不能|无法)独立)|[^，,；;。]{1,35}由(?:导师|同伴|同事|老师|讲师|结对伙伴))/giu;
var personalAssessmentHeading = /^(?:简介|个人简介|自我介绍|个人技能|个人能力|(?:my |personal )?(?:profile|summary))\s*[:：]\s*/iu;
var reportedAssessment = /^[^，,；;。.]{1,80}\b(?:said|say|says|reported|claimed|wrote)\s*[:,，]|^[^，,；;。.]{1,40}(?:(?:说|表示|声称|报告)(?:过)?|写道)\s*[:：,，]/iu;
function assessmentScopes(quote, masked) {
  const scopes = [];
  let start = personalAssessmentHeading.exec(masked)?.[0].length ?? 0;
  let assertionScope = "asserted";
  function reportedInRange(from, end) {
    const ending = masked[end] ?? "";
    const range = masked.slice(from, end) + (/^[,，:：]$/u.test(ending) ? ending : "");
    return reportedAssessment.test(range.replace(/\s+/gu, " ").trim());
  }
  function add(end, inherited) {
    const text = masked.slice(start, end).replace(/\s+/gu, " ").trim();
    const next = inherited === "embedded" || hypothetical.test(text) || reportedInRange(start, end) ? "embedded" : inherited === "denied" || deniedAssertion.test(text) ? "denied" : "asserted";
    if (text && next === "asserted") scopes.push({ raw: quote.slice(start, end), text });
    return next;
  }
  for (const separator of masked.matchAll(scopeBreak)) {
    const prefix = masked.slice(start, separator.index).trim();
    const frontedGuidance = !/\bI\s+/iu.test(prefix) && /^(?:with|under|during|in|on)\b/iu.test(prefix) && supervised.test(prefix + ",");
    if (/^[，,]\s*$/u.test(separator[0]) && (chineseGuidance.exec(prefix)?.[0].length === prefix.length || frontedGuidance)) continue;
    assertionScope = add(separator.index, assertionScope);
    start = separator.index + separator[0].length;
    const next = masked.slice(start).trimStart();
    const nextEnd = start + (masked.slice(start).matchAll(scopeBreak).next().value?.index ?? masked.length - start);
    if (assertionScope === "denied" && /^[\s，,]*(?:but|但是|但)\s*$/iu.test(separator[0]) && /^(?:I\b|my experience\b|我(?!们|的)|本人(?!的|团队))/iu.test(next) && !reportedInRange(start, nextEnd)) assertionScope = "asserted";
  }
  add(masked.length, assertionScope);
  return scopes;
}
var englishConceptual = /^I(?:['’]m| am| was)\s+(?:(?:only|somewhat|basically)\s+)?familiar with\b|^I (?:have|had)\s+(?:(?:only|a|some|basic|conceptual|theoretical|limited)\s+)+(?:knowledge|understanding|familiarity) (?:of|with)\b|^my experience (?:with|of|in)\b.{1,60}\bis limited to reading\b|^I (?:have )?only read (?:about|the documentation for)\b|^I (?:(?:can|am able to) explain|(?:have )?explained)\s+(?!(?:how|that|whether)\b)\S/iu;
var chineseConceptual = /^(?:我|本人)?(?:目前|仅|只|基本|初步|比较)*(?:了解|熟悉)\s*[\p{L}\p{N}]|^(?:我|本人)?对[^，,；;。]{1,55}(?:只有|仅有|有|只有一点|有些)(?:基础|基本|初步|概念上|理论上)的?(?:了解|认识|理解)|^(?:我|本人)?(?:目前|此前|对[^，,。]{1,40})?(?:仅|只)?(?:读过|阅读过|有阅读[^，,。]{0,45}(?:经验|经历))|^(?:我|本人)(?:能|能够|可以)解释\s*[\p{L}\p{N}]/u;
function conceptualAssessment(text) {
  return (englishConceptual.test(text) || chineseConceptual.test(text)) && !/\b(?:familiar with|knowledge of|understanding of)\s+(?:(?:the|an?|this)\s+)?(?:example|sample|quotation|quote)\b|^(?:我|本人)?(?:熟悉|了解)(?:示例|例句|引文)/iu.test(text);
}

// app/lib/materials/self-assessment-evidence.ts
var selfConflict = /\b(?:self[- ](?:assessments?|ratings?)|(?:my|personal) (?:skill |proficiency )?(?:ratings?|assessments?))\s+(?:(?:for|of|on)\s+[^,;]{1,60}\s+)?(?:conflict|contradict|disagree|(?:are|were) inconsistent)\b|(?:自评|自我(?:评价|评估)|能力评估)(?:前后|相互|彼此|有|存在|表述)*(?:矛盾|冲突|不一致)/iu;
var deniedConflict = /\b(?:(?:do(?:es)? not|never|no longer) (?:conflict|contradict|disagree)|no (?:remaining )?conflict|conflict (?:is|was|has been) resolved)\b|(?:没有|并无|不存在|已解决|并不)(?:矛盾|冲突)/iu;
var selfUncertain = /^I(?:['’]m| am| remain)\s+(?:(?:still|currently)\s+)?(?:unsure|uncertain|not sure) (?:about (?:my|whether)|whether I|if I)\b|^我(?:目前|还|仍)?(?:不确定|不清楚)(?:自己|我|是否|能否)|^(?:我的|我对).{0,45}自评(?:仍|还)?不确定/iu;
function personalUncertainty(part) {
  return !deniedConflict.test(part) && !/\b(?:my|our) (?:team|colleague)['’]s\b|(?:团队|小组)的?(?:能力|自评)/iu.test(part) && (selfUncertain.test(part) || /(?:\bmy\b|我|^自评)/iu.test(part) && selfConflict.test(part));
}
function supportsSelfLevelHintInScope(quote, masked, proposed, labels, sourceMentions = false) {
  const scopes = assessmentScopes(quote, masked);
  if (proposed !== "uncertain" && scopes.some((scope) => personalUncertainty(scope.text))) return false;
  const supported = scopes.map((scope) => {
    const raw = scope.raw.replace(/\s+/gu, " ").trim(), text = maskQuotes(raw);
    if (proposed === "guided") {
      const evidence = guidedSkillScope(raw, text, sourceMentions);
      return evidence;
    }
    return (proposed === "uncertain" ? personalUncertainty(text) : conceptualAssessment(text)) ? raw : null;
  });
  if (!supported.some(Boolean)) return false;
  return !labels?.length || labels.every((label) => supported.some((scope) => scope !== null && assertedSkillEvidence(scope, label)) && scopes.every((scope, index) => !assertedSkillEvidence(scope.raw, label) || supported[index] !== null && assertedSkillEvidence(supported[index], label)));
}
function supportsMaterialSelfLevelHint(input) {
  if (!input.level || input.kind !== "experience" && input.kind !== "skill-claim") return false;
  return supportsSelfLevelHintInScope(input.text, maskQuotes(input.text), input.level, input.labels, input.sourceMentions);
}

// worker/document-executor/source-statements.ts
var segmenter = typeof Intl.Segmenter === "function" ? new Intl.Segmenter("en", { granularity: "sentence" }) : null;
var listPrefix = /^(?:[-*•▪‣]\s+|[\d０-９]{1,3}\.\s+|(?:[\d０-９]{1,3}|[一二三四五六七八九十]{1,3})[、)）]\s*|[(（](?:[\d０-９]{1,3}|[一二三四五六七八九十]{1,3})[)）]\s*)/u;
var sectionHeading = /^(?:岗位职责|工作职责|职位描述|任职要求|岗位要求|任职资格|优先条件|加分项|工作经历|项目经历|技能|responsibilities|requirements|preferred qualifications|work experience|skills)\s*[:：]?$/iu;
function statementBoundaries(text, additionalHeading) {
  const bounds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  if (!segmenter) return bounds;
  const layout = text.replace(/[^\r\n]*(?:\r\n|[\r\n]|$)/gu, (line, at) => {
    if (!line.endsWith("\r") && !line.endsWith("\n")) return line;
    const trimmed = line.trim(), next = text.slice(at + line.length, at + line.length + 128).trimStart();
    const title = at === 0 && (/^\[[^\]\r\n]{1,64}\][^.!?。！？]{0,100}$/u.test(trimmed) || /^.{0,80}(?:\brole|\bjob description|\br[eé]sum[eé]|\bCV|岗位|职位|简历)$/iu.test(trimmed));
    if (!trimmed || title || sectionHeading.test(trimmed) || additionalHeading?.(trimmed) || /^#{1,6}\s/u.test(trimmed) || listPrefix.test(next)) return line;
    return line.replace(/[\r\n]/gu, " ");
  });
  for (const { segment, index } of segmenter.segment(layout)) {
    const trimmed = segment.trim();
    if (!trimmed) continue;
    const start = index + segment.length - segment.trimStart().length, end = start + trimmed.length;
    bounds.set(start, end);
    const bullet = listPrefix.exec(trimmed);
    if (bullet) bounds.set(start + bullet[0].length, end);
  }
  return bounds;
}
function completeNumberedStatementBoundaries(text, baseBounds) {
  const bounds = new Map(baseBounds);
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/[^\r\n]+/gu)) {
    const line = match[0], trimmed = line.trimStart();
    const start = match.index + line.length - trimmed.length;
    if (/^[\d０-９]{1,3}\.\s*$/u.test(trimmed)) {
      bounds.delete(start);
      continue;
    }
    const prefix = listPrefix.exec(trimmed);
    if (!prefix || !/^[\d０-９]{1,3}\./u.test(prefix[0])) continue;
    const bodyStart = start + prefix[0].length;
    const end = baseBounds.get(bodyStart);
    if (end !== void 0) bounds.set(start, end);
  }
  return bounds;
}

// worker/document-executor/source-requirement-evidence.ts
var mustHeading = /^(?:(?:(?:job|role|minimum|mandatory|essential|basic)\s+)?(?:requirements|qualifications)|(?:required|mandatory|essential|must[- ]have)\s+(?:skills|qualifications|tools|experience|competencies)|required|mandatory|essential|must[- ]haves?|(?:(?:job|role|key)\s+)?responsibilities|duties|岗位职责|工作职责|任职要求|岗位要求|任职资格|任职必备|必须|必备|必备技能|必备条件|硬性要求|基本要求)$/iu;
var preferredHeading = /^(?:(?:preferred|optional|desirable|bonus)\s+(?:skills|qualifications|tools|experience|competencies)|nice[- ]to[- ]haves?|preferred|optional|加分项?|优先条件|优先要求|可选技能|可选条件)$/iu;
function headingText(line) {
  return line.replace(/^#{1,6}\s+/u, "").replace(/\s+#{1,6}$/u, "").replace(/[:：]\s*$/u, "").replace(/^(\*\*|__)(.*?)\1$/u, "$2").replace(/[:：]\s*$/u, "").trim();
}
function headingLevel(line) {
  const label = headingText(line);
  return mustHeading.test(label) ? "must" : preferredHeading.test(label) ? "preferred" : null;
}
function isRequirementLevelHeading(line) {
  return headingLevel(line) !== null;
}

// worker/document-executor/source-review-evidence.ts
function isDetachedQuotedStatement(source, sources) {
  const span = locateCandidateQuote(source, sources);
  return !span || Array.from(sources.text.matchAll(quoted)).some((match) => match.index < span.start && match.index + match[0].length >= span.end);
}
var urlTokens = /\bhttps?:\/\/[^\s<>"“”‘’「」『』，。；：！？（）【】]+/giu;
function urlLiteral(token) {
  let end = token.length;
  while (end > 0 && ".,;:!?)}]".includes(token[end - 1])) end--;
  return token.slice(0, end);
}
function groundedStatementBoundaries(text) {
  const layout = text.replace(urlTokens, (token) => {
    const literal2 = urlLiteral(token);
    return literal2.replace(/[.!?]/gu, "x") + token.slice(literal2.length);
  });
  return statementBoundaries(layout, isRequirementLevelHeading);
}
function sourceMentionStatementBoundaries(text) {
  return completeNumberedStatementBoundaries(text, groundedStatementBoundaries(text));
}

// app/lib/materials/skill-labels.ts
function normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(label) {
  return label.normalize("NFKC").toLowerCase();
}
function containsMaterialSkillLabel(text, label) {
  const normalized = normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(text), token = normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(label);
  let offset = normalized.indexOf(token);
  while (offset >= 0) {
    const before = normalized[offset - 1] ?? "", after = normalized[offset + token.length] ?? "";
    if (!/^[a-z0-9_]/u.test(token) || !/[a-z0-9_]/u.test(before) && !/[a-z0-9_]/u.test(after)) return true;
    offset = normalized.indexOf(token, offset + 1);
  }
  return false;
}
function findReviewedSourceTerm(text, label, projection) {
  return projection === SOURCE_MENTION_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION ? findMaterialSkillMention(text, label) : findMaterialSkillEvidence(text, label);
}
function supportsReviewedSkillLabel(text, label, projection) {
  return isSourceLinkedMaterialReviewProjection(projection) ? findReviewedSourceTerm(text, label, projection) !== null : containsMaterialSkillLabel(text, label);
}
function labelForAddedSourceTerm(quote, fact, sourceTerm, projection) {
  const [label] = projection === SOURCE_MENTION_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION ? groundMaterialSkillMentions(quote, [sourceTerm]) : groundMaterialSkillTerms(quote, [sourceTerm]);
  return label && findReviewedSourceTerm(fact, label, projection) !== null ? label : null;
}
function sourceMentionAssessmentText(text) {
  const start = text.length - text.trimStart().length, end = text.trimEnd().length;
  const prefix = /^[\d０-９]{1,3}\.[^\S\r\n]+/u.exec(text.slice(start, end));
  if (!prefix) return text;
  const bodyStart = start + prefix[0].length, bounds = sourceMentionStatementBoundaries(text);
  return bounds.get(start) === end && bounds.get(bodyStart) === end ? text.slice(bodyStart, end) : text;
}
function retainedMaterialSelfAssessmentHints(items, hints, projection) {
  return hints.filter((hint) => {
    const item = items.find((item2) => item2.id === hint.candidateId);
    if (!item || item.kind !== "skill-claim" && item.kind !== "experience") return false;
    const retainedLabel = item.skillLabels ? item.skillLabels.includes(hint.skillLabel) : item.origin === "extracted" || containsMaterialSkillLabel(item.text, hint.skillLabel);
    if (!retainedLabel) return false;
    const needsEvidence = isSourceLinkedMaterialReviewProjection(projection) || item.origin === "user";
    const text = projection === SOURCE_MENTION_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION ? sourceMentionAssessmentText(item.text) : item.text;
    return !needsEvidence || supportsMaterialSelfLevelHint({
      kind: item.kind,
      text,
      labels: [hint.skillLabel],
      level: hint.level,
      sourceMentions: projection === SOURCE_MENTION_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION
    });
  });
}

// app/server/documents/review-points.ts
function validateDocumentReviewPoints(input, ownerId, reference) {
  const parsed = documentCandidateReviewPointsSchema.safeParse(input === void 0 ? [] : input);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  return materialReviewPointsSchema.parse(parsed.data.map((point) => {
    const sourceRef = resolveCandidateSourceRef(point.source, ownerId, reference);
    if (!sourceRef) throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
    return { id: deterministicId("review-point", { code: point.code, sourceRef }), code: point.code, sourceRef, resolution: "unresolved" };
  }));
}
function mergeDocumentReviewPointResolutions(current, input) {
  const existing = materialReviewPointsSchema.parse(current ?? []);
  if (input === void 0) return existing;
  const parsed = materialReviewPointsSchema.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success || parsed.data.length !== existing.length) throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  const byId = new Map(existing.map((point) => [point.id, point]));
  for (const point of parsed.data) {
    const prior = byId.get(point.id);
    if (!prior || point.code !== prior.code || canonicalJson(point.sourceRef) !== canonicalJson(prior.sourceRef)) throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  }
  return parsed.data;
}
function hasBlockingDocumentReviewPoints(points) {
  return (points ?? []).some((point) => point.resolution === "unresolved" && MATERIAL_HIGH_IMPACT_REVIEW_CODES.includes(point.code));
}

// app/server/documents/extraction-validator.ts
var storedProjection = external_exports.enum(["literal-skill-labels-v1", GROUNDED_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION, SOURCE_MENTION_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION]);
var storedExtractionSchema = external_exports.object({ reviewProjection: storedProjection, candidate: external_exports.unknown() }).strict();
function extractionProjection(providerPolicyId) {
  if (providerPolicyId === KIMI_SOURCE_MENTIONS_POLICY_ID) return SOURCE_MENTION_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION;
  return providerPolicyId === KIMI_GROUNDED_TERMS_POLICY_ID ? GROUNDED_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION : "literal-skill-labels-v1";
}
function serializeDocumentExtraction(candidate, providerPolicyId) {
  const json2 = JSON.stringify({ reviewProjection: extractionProjection(providerPolicyId), candidate });
  if (utf8Bytes(json2) > MAX_DOCUMENT_ITEMS_JSON_BYTES) throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  return json2;
}
function validateStoredDocumentExtraction(json2, ownerId, reference) {
  const raw = JSON.parse(json2);
  const stored = storedExtractionSchema.safeParse(raw);
  return stored.success ? projectExtraction(stored.data.candidate, ownerId, reference, stored.data.reviewProjection) : projectExtraction(raw, ownerId, reference, "legacy");
}
function validateDocumentExtraction(candidate, ownerId, reference, providerPolicyId) {
  return projectExtraction(candidate, ownerId, reference, extractionProjection(providerPolicyId));
}
function projectExtraction(candidate, ownerId, reference, projection) {
  const parsed = documentExtractionSchema.safeParse(candidate);
  if (!parsed.success)
    throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  const reviewProjection = isSourceLinkedMaterialReviewProjection(projection) ? projection : void 0;
  const sourceMentions = projection === SOURCE_MENTION_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION;
  const bounds = sourceMentions ? sourceMentionStatementBoundaries(reference.text) : void 0;
  const statementStarts = new Map(bounds && [...bounds].map(([start, end]) => [end, start]));
  const masked = sourceMentions ? maskQuotes(reference.text) : "";
  const items = parsed.data.items.map((item) => {
    const sourceRef = resolveCandidateSourceRef(item.source, ownerId, reference);
    if (!sourceRef)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
    if (sourceMentions && (item.text !== item.source.quote || bounds.get(sourceRef.start) !== sourceRef.end || isDetachedQuotedStatement(item.source, reference))) throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
    return {
      id: item.id,
      kind: item.kind,
      text: item.text,
      origin: "extracted",
      sourceRef,
      requirementLevel: item.requirementLevel,
      ...reviewProjection || projection === "literal-skill-labels-v1" && item.kind !== "constraint" ? {
        skillLabels: item.skillLabels.filter((label) => supportsReviewedSkillLabel(item.source.quote, label, reviewProjection))
      } : {}
    };
  });
  const hints = parsed.data.items.flatMap((item, itemIndex) => {
    if (item.selfLevelHint === null) return [];
    if (sourceMentions) {
      const projected = items[itemIndex], { start, end } = projected.sourceRef;
      const assessmentStart = statementStarts.get(end) ?? start;
      const text = reference.text.slice(assessmentStart, end), labels = projected.skillLabels;
      if (!supportsMaterialSelfLevelHint({ kind: item.kind, text, labels, level: item.selfLevelHint, sourceMentions }) || !supportsSelfLevelHintInScope(text, masked.slice(assessmentStart, end), item.selfLevelHint, labels, sourceMentions)) return [];
    }
    return item.skillLabels.flatMap((label, index) => {
      if (projection !== "legacy" && !items[itemIndex].skillLabels?.includes(label)) return [];
      return [{ id: `hint-${item.id}-${index}`, candidateId: item.id, skillLabel: label, level: item.selfLevelHint }];
    });
  });
  const selfAssessmentHints = materialSelfAssessmentHintsSchema.safeParse(hints);
  if (!selfAssessmentHints.success) throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  const review = {
    ...reviewProjection ? { reviewProjection } : {},
    items,
    selfAssessmentHints: selfAssessmentHints.data,
    reviewPoints: validateDocumentReviewPoints(parsed.data.reviewPoints, ownerId, reference)
  };
  if (!fitsJsonBytes(review, MAX_DOCUMENT_ITEMS_JSON_BYTES))
    throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  return review;
}

// app/server/documents/review-service.ts
function parseDraft(input) {
  const parsed = documentReviewDraftSchema.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  return parsed.data;
}
var extractionJoin = `LEFT JOIN document_extractions e ON e.owner_id=r.owner_id AND e.id=r.extraction_id AND e.text_version_id=r.text_version_id`;
var reviewProjectionColumns = `json_extract(e.candidates_json, '$.reviewProjection') AS review_projection,
    CASE WHEN json_extract(e.candidates_json, '$.reviewProjection') IN ('${GROUNDED_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION}','${SOURCE_MENTION_MATERIAL_REVIEW_PROJECTION}') THEN
      (SELECT json_group_object(json_extract(i.value,'$.id'),json_extract(i.value,'$.kind')) FROM json_each(e.candidates_json,'$.candidate.items') i)
    END AS original_kinds`;
function reclassifiedFacts(items, originalKinds) {
  const ids = items.filter((item) => item.sourceRef && Object.hasOwn(originalKinds, item.id) && item.kind !== originalKinds[item.id]).map((item) => item.id);
  return ids.length ? { reclassifiedItemIds: ids } : {};
}
function reviewedItem(item, candidate, prior, projection, addition, originalText) {
  const { skillLabels, ...fact } = item;
  const sourceLinked = isSourceLinkedMaterialReviewProjection(projection);
  const sameSource = candidate && canonicalJson(item.sourceRef) === canonicalJson(candidate.sourceRef);
  const sameFact = sameSource && item.text === candidate.text && item.kind === candidate.kind;
  if (item.origin === "extracted" && (!sameFact || item.requirementLevel !== candidate.requirementLevel))
    throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  if (sourceLinked && item.sourceRef && !sameSource)
    throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  let addedLabel = null;
  if (addition) {
    if (!sourceLinked || !sameSource || !candidate.sourceRef || item.origin !== "user" || item.kind !== candidate.kind || prior?.kind !== candidate.kind || canonicalJson(prior.sourceRef) !== canonicalJson(candidate.sourceRef))
      throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
    addedLabel = labelForAddedSourceTerm(originalText.slice(candidate.sourceRef.start, candidate.sourceRef.end), item.text, addition, projection);
    if (!addedLabel || !skillLabels?.includes(addedLabel) || prior.skillLabels?.includes(addedLabel))
      throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  }
  if (skillLabels?.some((label) => !sameSource || label !== addedLabel && (!prior?.skillLabels?.includes(label) || !sourceLinked && !candidate.skillLabels?.includes(label))))
    throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
  const reviewedWords = prior?.skillLabels ?? (sourceLinked ? candidate?.skillLabels : void 0);
  if (!sameFact || sourceLinked && item.text !== prior?.text) {
    if (!reviewedWords) return fact;
    const labels = sameSource && item.kind === candidate.kind ? skillLabels ?? [] : [];
    return { ...fact, skillLabels: labels.filter((label) => supportsReviewedSkillLabel(fact.text, label, projection)) };
  }
  if (!skillLabels && (reviewedWords || !prior && candidate.skillLabels)) return { ...fact, skillLabels: [] };
  return item;
}
var ReviewService = class {
  constructor(repo, storage) {
    this.repo = repo;
    this.storage = storage;
  }
  retainReviewPoints(current, incoming = []) {
    const points = new Map(incoming.map((point) => [point.id, point]));
    for (const point of current ? this.project(current).reviewPoints ?? [] : [])
      points.set(point.id, point);
    return [...points.values()];
  }
  async readDocumentExtraction(owner, input) {
    const request = external_exports.object({ documentId: materialIdSchema, extractionId: materialIdSchema }).strict().parse(input);
    const row = await this.repo.one("SELECT e.*,j.document_version_id,j.generation,c.revoked_at FROM document_extractions e JOIN document_jobs j ON j.owner_id=e.owner_id AND j.id=e.job_id JOIN document_processing_consents c ON c.owner_id=j.owner_id AND c.id=j.consent_id WHERE e.owner_id=? AND e.document_id=? AND e.id=? AND e.state='active' AND j.state='succeeded'", owner.ownerId, request.documentId, request.extractionId);
    if (!row)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("not-found");
    const { stored, reference } = await this.reference(owner.ownerId, request.documentId, String(row.text_version_id));
    if (row.revoked_at !== null || row.generation !== stored.document.generation || row.document_version_id !== stored.document.currentDocumentVersionId)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("gone");
    const validated = validateStoredDocumentExtraction(String(row.candidates_json), owner.ownerId, reference), current = await this.row(owner.ownerId, String(row.text_version_id));
    const revision = current ? Number(current.revision) : 0;
    return {
      expectedRevision: revision,
      draft: parseDraft({
        id: current?.id ?? request.extractionId,
        schemaVersion: DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        documentId: request.documentId,
        documentVersionId: stored.version.id,
        textVersionId: stored.version.textVersionId,
        extractionId: request.extractionId,
        origin: "ai",
        ...validated,
        reviewPoints: this.retainReviewPoints(current, validated.reviewPoints),
        revision,
        updatedAt: new Date(Number(row.created_at)).toISOString()
      })
    };
  }
  async adoptDocumentExtraction(owner, input) {
    const request = external_exports.object({
      documentId: materialIdSchema,
      textVersionId: materialIdSchema,
      extractionId: materialIdSchema,
      expectedRevision: materialRevisionSchema,
      mutationId: materialIdSchema
    }).strict().parse(input);
    const proposed = await this.readDocumentExtraction(owner, { documentId: request.documentId, extractionId: request.extractionId });
    if (proposed.draft.textVersionId !== request.textVersionId)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    return this.saveDocumentReviewDraft(owner, {
      ...request,
      items: proposed.draft.items,
      selfAssessmentHints: proposed.draft.selfAssessmentHints,
      reviewPoints: proposed.draft.reviewPoints
    }, await this.repo.identity(owner.ownerId, "adoptDocumentExtraction", request));
  }
  project(row) {
    const items = JSON.parse(String(row.items_json));
    return parseDraft({
      id: row.id,
      schemaVersion: DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      documentId: row.document_id,
      documentVersionId: row.document_version_id,
      textVersionId: row.text_version_id,
      extractionId: row.extraction_id,
      origin: row.origin,
      ...isSourceLinkedMaterialReviewProjection(row.review_projection) ? {
        reviewProjection: row.review_projection,
        ...reclassifiedFacts(items, JSON.parse(String(row.original_kinds)))
      } : {},
      items,
      selfAssessmentHints: JSON.parse(String(row.self_assessment_hints_json)),
      reviewPoints: JSON.parse(String(row.review_points_json ?? "[]")),
      revision: row.revision,
      updatedAt: new Date(Number(row.updated_at)).toISOString()
    });
  }
  async row(ownerId, textVersionId) {
    return this.repo.one(`SELECT r.*, ${reviewProjectionColumns} FROM document_review_drafts r ${extractionJoin}
            WHERE r.owner_id=? AND r.text_version_id=? AND r.state='active'`, ownerId, textVersionId);
  }
  async reference(ownerId, documentId, textVersionId) {
    const stored = await this.repo.version(ownerId, documentId, void 0, textVersionId);
    const text = await this.storage.read(stored.objectKey);
    const reference = {
      ownerId,
      documentId,
      documentVersionId: stored.version.id,
      textVersionId,
      lifecycle: stored.document.lifecycle,
      text,
      segments: stored.segments
    };
    return { stored, reference };
  }
  async readDocumentReviewDraft(owner, input) {
    const { documentId, textVersionId, includeConfirmation } = documentEndpointContracts.readDocumentReviewDraft.request.parse(input);
    await this.repo.version(owner.ownerId, documentId, void 0, textVersionId);
    if (!includeConfirmation) {
      const row2 = await this.row(owner.ownerId, textVersionId);
      return { draft: row2 ? this.project(row2) : null };
    }
    const row = await this.repo.one(
      `
            SELECT r.*, ${reviewProjectionColumns}, c.id AS confirmation_id, d.revision AS document_revision
            FROM document_review_drafts r
            ${extractionJoin}
            JOIN documents d ON d.owner_id=r.owner_id AND d.id=r.document_id AND d.lifecycle='active'
            JOIN document_versions v ON v.owner_id=r.owner_id AND v.document_id=r.document_id
                AND v.id=r.document_version_id AND v.text_version_id=r.text_version_id AND v.state='ready'
            LEFT JOIN document_confirmations c ON c.owner_id=r.owner_id AND c.document_id=r.document_id
                AND c.document_version_id=r.document_version_id AND c.text_version_id=r.text_version_id
                AND d.current_document_version_id=c.document_version_id AND c.state='active'
                AND c.revision=(SELECT max(last.revision) FROM document_confirmations last
                    WHERE last.owner_id=r.owner_id AND last.document_id=r.document_id AND last.document_version_id=r.document_version_id)
                AND c.review_revision=r.revision AND c.origin=r.origin AND c.items_json=r.items_json
                AND c.review_points_json=r.review_points_json
            WHERE r.owner_id=? AND r.document_id=? AND r.text_version_id=? AND r.state='active'`,
      owner.ownerId,
      documentId,
      textVersionId
    );
    if (!row) return { draft: null };
    return { draft: this.project(row), ...row.confirmation_id ? { confirmation: {
      confirmationId: String(row.confirmation_id),
      revision: Number(row.document_revision)
    } } : {} };
  }
  async saveDocumentReviewDraft(owner, input, adoptionIdentity) {
    const request = documentEndpointContracts.saveDocumentReviewDraft.request.parse(input), identity = adoptionIdentity ?? await this.repo.identity(owner.ownerId, "saveDocumentReviewDraft", request);
    const { stored, reference } = await this.reference(owner.ownerId, request.documentId, request.textVersionId);
    const replay = await this.repo.receipt(identity);
    if (replay) {
      const row = await this.row(owner.ownerId, request.textVersionId);
      if (!row || Number(row.revision) !== replay.revision)
        throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
      return { draft: this.project(row) };
    }
    const current = await this.row(owner.ownerId, request.textVersionId);
    if ((current ? Number(current.revision) : 0) !== request.expectedRevision)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    if (current?.extraction_id && request.extractionId === null)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    let extraction = null;
    if (request.extractionId) {
      const row = await this.repo.one("SELECT candidates_json FROM document_extractions WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND text_version_id=? AND state='active'", owner.ownerId, request.extractionId, request.textVersionId);
      if (!row)
        throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
      extraction = validateStoredDocumentExtraction(String(row.candidates_json), owner.ownerId, reference);
    }
    if (!adoptionIdentity && current && current.extraction_id !== request.extractionId && (isSourceLinkedMaterialReviewProjection(current.review_projection) || isSourceLinkedMaterialReviewProjection(extraction?.reviewProjection)))
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    if (request.skillTermAddition && (!current || current.extraction_id !== request.extractionId || adoptionIdentity))
      throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
    const priorReview = !adoptionIdentity && current && current.extraction_id === request.extractionId ? this.project(current) : extraction;
    const items = request.items.map((item) => {
      if (item.sourceRef && !validateMaterialSourceRef(item.sourceRef, owner.ownerId, reference))
        throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
      const addition = request.skillTermAddition?.itemId === item.id ? request.skillTermAddition.sourceTerm : void 0;
      return reviewedItem(
        item,
        extraction?.items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === item.id),
        priorReview?.items.find((prior) => prior.id === item.id),
        extraction?.reviewProjection,
        addition,
        reference.text
      );
    });
    if (request.selfAssessmentHints.some((hint) => !extraction?.selfAssessmentHints.some((candidate) => canonicalJson(candidate) === canonicalJson(hint))))
      throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
    const selfAssessmentHints = retainedMaterialSelfAssessmentHints(items, request.selfAssessmentHints.filter((hint) => priorReview?.selfAssessmentHints.some((prior) => prior.id === hint.id)), extraction?.reviewProjection);
    const basePoints = this.retainReviewPoints(current, extraction?.reviewPoints);
    const reviewPoints = mergeDocumentReviewPointResolutions(basePoints, request.reviewPoints);
    const revision = request.expectedRevision + 1, id = current ? String(current.id) : this.repo.id(), origin = request.extractionId ? request.items.some((item) => item.origin === "user") ? "mixed" : "ai" : "manual", now = this.repo.now();
    const draft = parseDraft({
      id,
      schemaVersion: DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      documentId: request.documentId,
      documentVersionId: stored.version.id,
      textVersionId: request.textVersionId,
      extractionId: request.extractionId,
      origin,
      items,
      selfAssessmentHints,
      reviewPoints,
      ...isSourceLinkedMaterialReviewProjection(extraction?.reviewProjection) ? {
        reviewProjection: extraction.reviewProjection,
        ...reclassifiedFacts(items, Object.fromEntries(extraction.items.map((item) => [item.id, item.kind])))
      } : {},
      revision,
      updatedAt: new Date(now).toISOString()
    });
    const write = this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO document_review_drafts(owner_id,id,document_id,document_version_id,text_version_id,extraction_id,origin,items_json,self_assessment_hints_json,review_points_json,revision,state,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'active',?) ON CONFLICT(owner_id,text_version_id) DO UPDATE SET extraction_id=excluded.extraction_id,origin=excluded.origin,items_json=excluded.items_json,self_assessment_hints_json=excluded.self_assessment_hints_json,review_points_json=excluded.review_points_json,revision=excluded.revision,updated_at=excluded.updated_at WHERE document_review_drafts.revision=? AND document_review_drafts.state='active'", owner.ownerId, id, request.documentId, stored.version.id, request.textVersionId, request.extractionId, origin, JSON.stringify(items), JSON.stringify(selfAssessmentHints), JSON.stringify(reviewPoints), revision, now, request.expectedRevision);
    const extractionGuards = request.extractionId && request.extractionId !== current?.extraction_id ? [
      this.repo.guard("EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_extractions e JOIN document_jobs j ON j.owner_id=e.owner_id AND j.id=e.job_id JOIN document_processing_consents c ON c.owner_id=j.owner_id AND c.id=j.consent_id JOIN documents d ON d.owner_id=j.owner_id AND d.id=j.document_id WHERE e.owner_id=? AND e.id=? AND e.text_version_id=? AND e.state='active' AND j.state='succeeded' AND c.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.lifecycle='active' AND d.generation=j.generation AND d.current_document_version_id=j.document_version_id)", owner.ownerId, request.extractionId, request.textVersionId)
    ] : [];
    await this.repo.commit(identity, { draftId: id, revision }, [
      this.repo.activeVersionGuard(owner.ownerId, request.documentId, stored.version.id, stored.document.generation),
      ...extractionGuards,
      ...current ? [] : [
        this.repo.guard("NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_review_drafts WHERE owner_id=? AND text_version_id=?)", owner.ownerId, request.textVersionId)
      ],
      write,
      this.repo.changed()
    ]);
    return { draft };
  }
  async acceptAiExtraction(ownerId, input) {
    const previous = await this.repo.one("SELECT id FROM document_extractions WHERE owner_id=? AND job_id=? AND state='active'", ownerId, input.jobId);
    if (previous) {
      await this.repo.document(ownerId, input.documentId);
      return { extractionId: String(previous.id), disposition: "candidates-available" };
    }
    let context;
    try {
      context = await this.reference(ownerId, input.documentId, input.textVersionId);
    } catch (error51) {
      if (error51 instanceof DocumentServiceError && ["not-found", "gone", "conflict"].includes(error51.code))
        return { extractionId: null, disposition: "rejected" };
      throw new DocumentServiceError("unavailable");
    }
    const job = await this.repo.one("SELECT provider_policy_id FROM document_jobs WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND state='running'", ownerId, input.jobId);
    if (!job) return { extractionId: null, disposition: "rejected" };
    const providerPolicyId = String(job.provider_policy_id);
    const validated = validateDocumentExtraction(input.candidate, ownerId, context.reference, providerPolicyId), id = this.repo.id(), now = this.repo.now();
    const captureJson = serializeDocumentExtraction(input.candidate, providerPolicyId);
    const draft = parseDraft({
      id: this.repo.id(),
      schemaVersion: DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      documentId: input.documentId,
      documentVersionId: input.documentVersionId,
      textVersionId: input.textVersionId,
      extractionId: id,
      origin: "ai",
      ...validated,
      revision: 0,
      updatedAt: new Date(now).toISOString()
    });
    try {
      const results = await this.repo.db.batch([
        this.repo.guard("EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_jobs j JOIN documents d ON d.owner_id=j.owner_id AND d.id=j.document_id JOIN document_processing_consents c ON c.owner_id=j.owner_id AND c.id=j.consent_id WHERE j.owner_id=? AND j.id=? AND j.state='running' AND j.document_id=? AND j.document_version_id=? AND j.text_version_id=? AND j.generation=? AND j.consent_id=? AND j.provider_policy_id=? AND d.lifecycle='active' AND d.generation=? AND d.revision=? AND d.current_document_version_id=? AND c.revoked_at IS NULL AND c.text_version_id=j.text_version_id AND c.generation=d.generation)", ownerId, input.jobId, input.documentId, input.documentVersionId, input.textVersionId, input.generation, input.consentId, providerPolicyId, input.generation, input.documentRevision, input.documentVersionId),
        this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO document_extractions(owner_id,id,job_id,document_id,text_version_id,candidates_json,state,created_at,model_version,policy_version) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,'active',?,?,?)", ownerId, id, input.jobId, input.documentId, input.textVersionId, captureJson, now, input.modelVersion ?? null, input.policyVersion ?? DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION),
        this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO document_review_drafts(owner_id,id,document_id,document_version_id,text_version_id,extraction_id,origin,items_json,self_assessment_hints_json,review_points_json,revision,state,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,'ai',?,?,?,0,'active',?) ON CONFLICT(owner_id,text_version_id) DO UPDATE SET extraction_id=excluded.extraction_id,origin='ai',items_json=excluded.items_json,self_assessment_hints_json=excluded.self_assessment_hints_json,review_points_json=excluded.review_points_json,updated_at=excluded.updated_at WHERE document_review_drafts.revision=0 AND document_review_drafts.items_json='[]' AND document_review_drafts.self_assessment_hints_json='[]' AND document_review_drafts.extraction_id IS NULL AND document_review_drafts.state='active'", ownerId, draft.id, input.documentId, input.documentVersionId, input.textVersionId, id, JSON.stringify(draft.items), JSON.stringify(draft.selfAssessmentHints), JSON.stringify(draft.reviewPoints), now),
        this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_jobs SET extraction_id=?,state='succeeded',revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND state='running'", id, now, ownerId, input.jobId),
        this.repo.changed()
      ]);
      return { extractionId: id, disposition: results[2]?.meta.changes ? "initialized" : "candidates-available" };
    } catch (error51) {
      if (error51 instanceof Error && /malformed JSON/iu.test(error51.message))
        return { extractionId: null, disposition: "rejected" };
      throw new DocumentServiceError("unavailable");
    }
  }
};

// app/server/documents/confirmation-service.ts
var ConfirmationService = class {
  constructor(repo, storage) {
    this.repo = repo;
    this.review = new ReviewService(repo, storage);
  }
  async createDocumentConfirmation(owner, input) {
    const request = documentEndpointContracts.createDocumentConfirmation.request.parse(input), identity = await this.repo.identity(owner.ownerId, "createDocumentConfirmation", request), stored = await this.repo.version(owner.ownerId, request.documentId, request.documentVersionId);
    if (stored.version.textVersionId !== request.textVersionId)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
    const replay = await this.repo.receipt(identity);
    if (replay)
      return replay;
    const row = await this.review.row(owner.ownerId, request.textVersionId);
    if (!row)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    const draft = this.review.project(row);
    if (draft.revision !== request.reviewRevision || canonicalJson(draft.items) !== canonicalJson(request.items) || stored.document.revision !== request.expectedRevision)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    if (hasBlockingDocumentReviewPoints(draft.reviewPoints))
      throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
    const result = { confirmationId: this.repo.id(), revision: request.expectedRevision + 1 };
    return this.repo.commit(identity, result, [
      this.repo.activeVersionGuard(owner.ownerId, request.documentId, request.documentVersionId, stored.document.generation),
      this.repo.guard("EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_review_drafts WHERE owner_id=? AND text_version_id=? AND revision=? AND state='active' AND items_json=?)", owner.ownerId, request.textVersionId, request.reviewRevision, JSON.stringify(request.items)),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE documents SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND lifecycle='active' AND revision=? AND generation=?", this.repo.now(), owner.ownerId, request.documentId, request.expectedRevision, stored.document.generation),
      this.repo.changed(),
      this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO document_confirmations(owner_id,document_id,document_version_id,id,text_version_id,review_revision,revision,origin,state,items_json,review_points_json,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'active',?,?,?)", owner.ownerId, request.documentId, request.documentVersionId, result.confirmationId, request.textVersionId, request.reviewRevision, result.revision, draft.origin, JSON.stringify(request.items), JSON.stringify(draft.reviewPoints ?? []), this.repo.now())
    ]);
  }
};

// app/server/documents/selection-service.ts
var SelectionService = class {
  constructor(repo) {
    this.repo = repo;
  }
  async readAdoptedMaterials(owner, input) {
    const contract = documentEndpointContracts.readAdoptedMaterials;
    const { goalId, workspaceId, baseVersionId, checkDocumentIds = [] } = contract.request.parse(input);
    const rows = await this.repo.all(`
            SELECT l.slot, l.document_id, l.document_version_id, c.id AS confirmation_id, v.text_version_id, d.revision,
                (SELECT json_group_array(candidate.value) FROM json_each(?) candidate WHERE EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM document_mutations m WHERE m.owner_id=w.user_id AND m.endpoint='detachAdoptedMaterial'
                      AND json_extract(m.result_json,'$.goalId')=w.goal_id AND json_extract(m.result_json,'$.workspaceId')=w.id
                      AND json_extract(m.result_json,'$.documentId')=candidate.value)) AS cancelled_candidates
            FROM planning_workspaces w
            JOIN career_goals g ON g.user_id=w.user_id AND g.id=w.goal_id AND g.status='active' AND g.active_slot=1
            LEFT JOIN goal_document_links l ON l.owner_id=w.user_id AND l.goal_id=w.goal_id AND l.enabled=1 AND l.purpose='planning'
            LEFT JOIN material_context_dependencies x ON x.owner_id=l.owner_id AND x.context_version_id=l.context_version_id
                AND x.document_id=l.document_id AND x.document_version_id=l.document_version_id AND x.confirmation_id=l.confirmation_id AND x.slot=l.slot
                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_usage_links u WHERE u.owner_id=l.owner_id AND u.context_version_id=l.context_version_id
                    AND u.goal_id=w.goal_id AND u.workspace_id=w.id AND u.kind IN ('generation','accepted'))
            LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.owner_id=x.owner_id AND d.id=x.document_id AND d.kind=x.slot AND d.lifecycle='active' AND d.generation=x.generation
            LEFT JOIN document_versions v ON v.owner_id=d.owner_id AND v.document_id=d.id AND v.id=x.document_version_id
                AND v.text_version_id=x.text_version_id AND v.generation=x.generation AND v.state='ready'
            LEFT JOIN document_confirmations c ON c.owner_id=v.owner_id AND c.document_id=v.document_id AND c.document_version_id=v.id
                AND c.id=x.confirmation_id AND c.text_version_id=v.text_version_id AND c.state='active'
            WHERE w.user_id=? AND w.goal_id=? AND w.id=? AND w.active_plan_version_id=?
            ORDER BY l.slot,l.document_id LIMIT 6`, JSON.stringify(checkDocumentIds), owner.ownerId, goalId, workspaceId, baseVersionId);
    if (!rows.length) throw new DocumentServiceError("not-found");
    const entries = rows.filter((row) => row.document_id !== null).map((row) => {
      if (!row.confirmation_id) throw new DocumentServiceError("gone");
      return {
        slot: row.slot,
        documentId: row.document_id,
        documentVersionId: row.document_version_id,
        confirmationId: row.confirmation_id,
        textVersionId: row.text_version_id,
        revision: row.revision
      };
    });
    const previouslyCancelled = JSON.parse(String(rows[0].cancelled_candidates));
    const detachedDocumentIds = previouslyCancelled.filter((id) => !entries.some((entry) => entry.documentId === id));
    return contract.response.parse({ entries, ...detachedDocumentIds.length ? { detachedDocumentIds } : {} });
  }
  async read(ownerId, selectionId) {
    const row = await this.repo.one("SELECT * FROM material_selections WHERE owner_id=? AND id=?", ownerId, selectionId);
    if (!row)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("not-found");
    const entries = await this.repo.all("SELECT * FROM material_selection_entries WHERE owner_id=? AND selection_id=? ORDER BY slot,document_id", ownerId, selectionId);
    return materialSelectionSchema.parse({
      selectionId: row.id,
      schemaVersion: DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      selectionRevision: row.revision,
      scope: JSON.parse(String(row.scope_json)),
      entries: entries.map((entry) => ({
        slot: entry.slot,
        documentId: entry.document_id,
        documentVersionId: entry.document_version_id,
        confirmationId: entry.confirmation_id
      })),
      state: row.state,
      boundGoalId: row.bound_goal_id
    });
  }
  scopeGuard(ownerId, scope) {
    if (scope.kind === "draft")
      return scope.previousGoalId === null ? [] : [
        this.repo.guard("EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM career_goals WHERE user_id=? AND id=? AND status='active' AND active_slot=1)", ownerId, scope.previousGoalId)
      ];
    return [
      this.repo.guard("EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM planning_workspaces w JOIN career_goals g ON g.user_id=w.user_id AND g.id=w.goal_id WHERE w.user_id=? AND w.goal_id=? AND w.id=? AND w.revision=? AND w.active_plan_version_id=? AND g.status='active' AND g.active_slot=1)", ownerId, scope.goalId, scope.workspaceId, scope.revision, scope.baseVersionId)
    ];
  }
  async validateEntries(ownerId, entries) {
    const guards = [];
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const stored = await this.repo.version(ownerId, entry.documentId, entry.documentVersionId);
      if (stored.document.kind !== entry.slot)
        throw new DocumentServiceError("invalid-content");
      const row = await this.repo.one("SELECT * FROM document_confirmations WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND document_version_id=? AND id=?", ownerId, entry.documentId, entry.documentVersionId, entry.confirmationId);
      if (!row)
        throw new DocumentServiceError("not-found");
      if (row.state !== "active" || row.text_version_id !== stored.version.textVersionId)
        throw new DocumentServiceError("gone");
      guards.push(this.repo.activeVersionGuard(ownerId, entry.documentId, entry.documentVersionId, stored.document.generation), this.repo.guard("EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_confirmations WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND document_version_id=? AND id=? AND state='active' AND text_version_id=?)", ownerId, entry.documentId, entry.documentVersionId, entry.confirmationId, stored.version.textVersionId));
    }
    return guards;
  }
  insertEntry(ownerId, selectionId, entry) {
    return this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO material_selection_entries(owner_id,selection_id,slot,document_id,document_version_id,confirmation_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)", ownerId, selectionId, entry.slot, entry.documentId, entry.documentVersionId, entry.confirmationId);
  }
  replaceCurrentScope(ownerId, scope) {
    const identity = scope.kind === "draft" ? "json_extract(scope_json,'$.kind')='draft' AND json_extract(scope_json,'$.draftId')=?" : "json_extract(scope_json,'$.kind')='goal' AND json_extract(scope_json,'$.goalId')=?";
    const scopeId = scope.kind === "draft" ? scope.draftId : scope.goalId;
    return [
      this.repo.statement(`UPDATE material_context_versions SET state='revoked' WHERE owner_id=? AND selection_id IN (SELECT id FROM material_selections WHERE owner_id=? AND state='active' AND ${identity}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_usage_links u WHERE u.owner_id=material_context_versions.owner_id AND u.context_version_id=material_context_versions.id AND u.kind IN ('generation','accepted'))`, ownerId, ownerId, scopeId),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE material_plan_proposals SET state='revoked' WHERE owner_id=? AND state='pending' AND context_version_id IN (SELECT id FROM material_context_versions WHERE owner_id=? AND state='revoked')", ownerId, ownerId),
      this.repo.statement(`UPDATE material_selections SET state='revoked',updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND state='active' AND ${identity}`, this.repo.now(), ownerId, scopeId)
    ];
  }
  async createMaterialSelection(owner, input) {
    const request = documentEndpointContracts.createMaterialSelection.request.parse(input), identity = await this.repo.identity(owner.ownerId, "createMaterialSelection", request), guards = await this.validateEntries(owner.ownerId, request.entries), replay = await this.repo.receipt(identity);
    if (replay) {
      if ((await this.read(owner.ownerId, replay.selectionId)).state === "revoked")
        throw new DocumentServiceError("gone");
      return replay;
    }
    const result = { selectionId: this.repo.id(), selectionRevision: 0 };
    return this.repo.commit(identity, result, [
      ...this.scopeGuard(owner.ownerId, request.scope),
      ...guards,
      ...this.replaceCurrentScope(owner.ownerId, request.scope),
      this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO material_selections(owner_id,id,scope_json,revision,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,0,'active',?,?)", owner.ownerId, result.selectionId, JSON.stringify(request.scope), this.repo.now(), this.repo.now()),
      ...request.entries.map((entry) => this.insertEntry(owner.ownerId, result.selectionId, entry))
    ]);
  }
  async updateMaterialSelection(owner, input) {
    const request = documentEndpointContracts.updateMaterialSelection.request.parse(input), identity = await this.repo.identity(owner.ownerId, "updateMaterialSelection", request), selection = await this.read(owner.ownerId, request.selectionId), guards = await this.validateEntries(owner.ownerId, request.entries), replay = await this.repo.receipt(identity);
    if (selection.state === "revoked")
      throw new DocumentServiceError("gone");
    if (replay)
      return replay;
    if (selection.state !== "active" || selection.selectionRevision !== request.expectedRevision)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    const result = { selectionId: request.selectionId, selectionRevision: request.expectedRevision + 1 };
    return this.repo.commit(identity, result, [
      ...this.scopeGuard(owner.ownerId, selection.scope),
      ...guards,
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE material_selections SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=? AND state='active'", this.repo.now(), owner.ownerId, request.selectionId, request.expectedRevision),
      this.repo.changed(),
      this.repo.statement("DELETE FROM material_selection_entries WHERE owner_id=? AND selection_id=?", owner.ownerId, request.selectionId),
      ...request.entries.map((entry) => this.insertEntry(owner.ownerId, request.selectionId, entry)),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE material_context_versions SET state='revoked' WHERE owner_id=? AND selection_id=? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_usage_links u WHERE u.owner_id=material_context_versions.owner_id AND u.context_version_id=material_context_versions.id AND u.kind IN ('generation','accepted'))", owner.ownerId, request.selectionId),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE material_plan_proposals SET state='revoked' WHERE owner_id=? AND state='pending' AND context_version_id IN (SELECT id FROM material_context_versions WHERE owner_id=? AND selection_id=? AND state='revoked')", owner.ownerId, owner.ownerId, request.selectionId)
    ]);
  }
  async readMaterialSelection(owner, input) {
    const request = documentEndpointContracts.readMaterialSelection.request.parse(input), selection = await this.read(owner.ownerId, request.selectionId);
    const versions = [];
    for (const entry of selection.entries) {
      const row = await this.repo.one("SELECT d.lifecycle,d.current_document_version_id,v.state FROM documents d JOIN document_versions v ON v.owner_id=d.owner_id AND v.document_id=d.id WHERE d.owner_id=? AND d.id=? AND v.id=?", owner.ownerId, entry.documentId, entry.documentVersionId);
      versions.push({
        documentId: entry.documentId,
        documentVersionId: entry.documentVersionId,
        state: !row ? "unavailable" : row.lifecycle !== "active" || row.state !== "ready" ? "revoked" : row.current_document_version_id !== entry.documentVersionId ? "superseded" : "active"
      });
    }
    return { selection, versions };
  }
};

// app/server/documents/deletion-service.ts
var DeletionService = class {
  constructor(repo, storage, port) {
    this.repo = repo;
    this.storage = storage;
    this.port = port;
  }
  async deleteDocument(owner, input) {
    const request = documentEndpointContracts.deleteDocument.request.parse(input), identity = await this.repo.identity(owner.ownerId, "deleteDocument", request), document = await this.repo.document(owner.ownerId, request.documentId, false), replay = await this.repo.receipt(identity);
    if (replay)
      return replay;
    const existing = await this.repo.one("SELECT id FROM document_deletion_jobs WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?", owner.ownerId, request.documentId);
    if (existing)
      return this.repo.commit(identity, { deletionJobId: String(existing.id), state: "cleanup-pending" }, []);
    if (document.lifecycle !== "active")
      throw new DocumentServiceError("gone");
    if (document.revision !== request.expectedRevision)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    const result = { deletionJobId: this.repo.id(), state: "cleanup-pending" }, now = this.repo.now(), oid = owner.ownerId, did = request.documentId;
    await this.repo.commit(identity, result, [
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE documents SET lifecycle='cleanup-pending',display_name='\u5DF2\u5220\u9664',generation=generation+1,revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND lifecycle='active' AND revision=? AND generation=?", now, oid, did, request.expectedRevision, document.generation),
      this.repo.changed(),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_versions SET state='cleanup-pending',segments_json='[]' WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?", oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_processing_consents SET revoked_at=coalesce(revoked_at,?) WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?", now, oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_jobs SET state='revoked',revision=revision+1,extraction_id=NULL,execution_slot=CASE WHEN dispatch_state='not-sent' OR dispatch_state='settled' THEN NULL ELSE execution_slot END,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?", now, oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_budget_reservations SET state='released',updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND state='reserved' AND job_id IN(SELECT id FROM document_jobs WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND dispatch_state='not-sent')", now, oid, oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_budget_reservations SET state='held-unknown',updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND state='reserved' AND job_id IN(SELECT id FROM document_jobs WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND dispatch_state='may-have-sent')", now, oid, oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_review_drafts SET state='revoked',items_json='[]',self_assessment_hints_json='[]',review_points_json='[]',revision=revision+1 WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?", oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_extractions SET state='revoked',candidates_json='{}' WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?", oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_confirmations SET state='revoked',items_json='[]',review_points_json='[]' WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?", oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE material_selections SET state='revoked',revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id IN(SELECT selection_id FROM material_selection_entries WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?)", now, oid, oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE material_context_versions SET state='revoked',snapshot_json='{}',preview_json='{}' WHERE owner_id=? AND id IN(SELECT context_version_id FROM material_context_dependencies WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?)", oid, oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE material_plan_proposals SET state='revoked' WHERE owner_id=? AND state='pending' AND context_version_id IN(SELECT context_version_id FROM material_context_dependencies WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?)", oid, oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE goal_document_links SET enabled=0 WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?", oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_storage_operations SET state='cleanup-pending' WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?", oid, did),
      this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO document_deletion_jobs(owner_id,id,document_id,generation,state,next_attempt_at,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'revoked',?,?)", oid, result.deletionJobId, did, document.generation + 1, now, now)
    ]);
    if (this.port)
      try {
        await this.port.cancelForDocument(oid, did);
      } catch {
      }
    return result;
  }
  async readDocumentDeletion(owner, input) {
    const request = documentEndpointContracts.readDocumentDeletion.request.parse(input);
    const row = await this.repo.one("SELECT * FROM document_deletion_jobs WHERE owner_id=? AND id=?", owner.ownerId, request.deletionJobId);
    if (!row)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("not-found");
    return documentEndpointContracts.readDocumentDeletion.response.parse({ deletionJobId: row.id, state: row.state, errorCode: row.error_code });
  }
  async reconcile(owner, input) {
    const status = await this.readDocumentDeletion(owner, input);
    if (status.state === "completed")
      return status;
    const row = await this.repo.one("SELECT * FROM document_deletion_jobs WHERE owner_id=? AND id=?", owner.ownerId, input.deletionJobId), documentId = String(row.document_id), generation = Number(row.generation);
    await this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_deletion_jobs SET state='cleaning',error_code=NULL WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND generation=? AND state<>'completed'", owner.ownerId, input.deletionJobId, generation).run();
    try {
      let proof = { writersTerminated: true, resultsAbsent: true };
      if (this.port)
        proof = await this.port.cancelForDocument(owner.ownerId, documentId);
      else if (await this.repo.one("SELECT 1 FROM document_jobs WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND dispatch_state<>'not-sent' LIMIT 1", owner.ownerId, documentId))
        proof = { writersTerminated: false, resultsAbsent: false };
      const operations = await this.repo.all("SELECT id FROM document_storage_operations WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND generation<? AND state='cleanup-pending' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10", owner.ownerId, documentId, generation);
      for (const operation of operations)
        await this.storage.reclaim(this.repo, owner.ownerId, String(operation.id));
      const pendingSql = `SELECT 1 FROM documents WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND (${documentHasPendingStorage})`;
      const pending = await this.repo.one(pendingSql, owner.ownerId, documentId);
      if (!pending && proof.writersTerminated && proof.resultsAbsent) {
        await this.repo.db.batch([
          this.repo.guard(`NOT EXISTS(${pendingSql})`, owner.ownerId, documentId),
          this.repo.statement("UPDATE documents SET lifecycle='deleted',updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND generation=? AND lifecycle='cleanup-pending'", this.repo.now(), owner.ownerId, documentId, generation),
          this.repo.changed(),
          this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_deletion_jobs SET state='completed',error_code=NULL WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND generation=?", owner.ownerId, input.deletionJobId, generation)
        ]);
      } else
        await this.defer(owner.ownerId, input.deletionJobId, Number(row.attempts), null);
    } catch {
      await this.defer(owner.ownerId, input.deletionJobId, Number(row.attempts), "cleanup-failed");
    }
    return this.readDocumentDeletion(owner, input);
  }
  async defer(ownerId, id, attempts, error51) {
    await this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_deletion_jobs SET state=?,error_code=?,attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND state<>'completed'", error51 ? "failed" : "cleaning", error51, this.repo.now() + Math.min(36e5, 1e3 * 2 ** Math.min(attempts, 12)), ownerId, id).run();
  }
  async maintain(limit = 10) {
    const rows = await this.repo.all("SELECT owner_id,id FROM document_deletion_jobs WHERE state<>'completed' AND next_attempt_at<=? ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT ?", this.repo.now(), Math.min(10, limit));
    for (const row of rows)
      await this.reconcile({ ownerId: String(row.owner_id) }, { deletionJobId: String(row.id) });
  }
};

// app/server/documents/service.ts
var DocumentService = class {
  constructor(repo, storage) {
    this.repo = repo;
    this.storage = storage;
  }
  async readDocumentMutation(owner, input) {
    const request = external_exports.object({ endpoint: external_exports.enum(["createDocument", "createDocumentVersion"]), mutationId: materialIdSchema }).strict().parse(input);
    const row = await this.repo.one("SELECT result_json FROM document_mutations WHERE owner_id=? AND endpoint=? AND mutation_id=?", owner.ownerId, request.endpoint, request.mutationId);
    if (!row)
      return { receipt: null };
    const receipt = documentEndpointContracts.createDocument.response.parse(JSON.parse(String(row.result_json)));
    await this.repo.version(owner.ownerId, receipt.documentId, receipt.documentVersionId);
    return { receipt };
  }
  async listDocuments(owner, input) {
    const request = documentEndpointContracts.listDocuments.request.parse(input);
    const rows = await this.repo.all("SELECT * FROM documents WHERE owner_id=? AND lifecycle='active' AND id>? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?", owner.ownerId, request.cursor ?? "", (request.limit ?? 30) + 1);
    const page = rows.slice(0, request.limit ?? 30);
    return {
      documents: page.map((row) => this.repo.projectDocument(row)),
      nextCursor: rows.length > page.length ? String(page.at(-1).id) : null
    };
  }
  async readDocument(owner, input) {
    const request = documentEndpointContracts.readDocument.request.parse(input);
    const stored = await this.repo.version(owner.ownerId, request.documentId, request.versionId);
    const text = await this.storage.read(stored.objectKey);
    await this.repo.version(owner.ownerId, request.documentId, stored.version.id);
    return { document: stored.document, version: stored.version, text };
  }
  async createDocument(owner, input) {
    return this.save(owner, documentEndpointContracts.createDocument.request.parse(input), false);
  }
  async createDocumentVersion(owner, input) {
    return this.save(owner, documentEndpointContracts.createDocumentVersion.request.parse(input), true);
  }
  async save(owner, request, isVersion) {
    const endpoint = isVersion ? "createDocumentVersion" : "createDocument";
    const identity = await this.repo.identity(owner.ownerId, endpoint, request);
    const replay = await this.repo.receipt(identity);
    if (replay) {
      await this.repo.document(owner.ownerId, replay.documentId);
      return replay;
    }
    let text;
    try {
      text = prepareDocumentText(request.text);
    } catch (error51) {
      throw new DocumentServiceError(error51 instanceof Error && error51.message === "TEXT_TOO_LARGE" ? "payload-too-large" : "invalid-content");
    }
    const current = "documentId" in request ? await this.repo.document(owner.ownerId, request.documentId) : null;
    if (current && "expectedRevision" in request && current.revision !== request.expectedRevision)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    const existing = await this.repo.one("SELECT body_digest,state FROM document_storage_operations WHERE owner_id=? AND mutation_endpoint=? AND mutation_id=?", owner.ownerId, endpoint, request.mutationId);
    if (existing)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
    const documentId = current?.id ?? this.repo.id(), versionId = this.repo.id(), textVersionId = this.repo.id(), intentId = this.repo.id(), generation = current?.generation ?? 0, revision = current ? current.revision + 1 : 0, now = this.repo.now();
    const key = documentStorageKey(owner.ownerId, documentId, generation, versionId, intentId);
    const digest = await materialSha256(text), points = Array.from(text).length, bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(text).byteLength;
    const count = await this.repo.one("SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE owner_id=? AND lifecycle<>'deleted') documents,(SELECT count(*) FROM document_versions v WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_storage_operations o WHERE o.owner_id=v.owner_id AND o.document_version_id=v.id AND o.state<>'deleted')) versions,(SELECT coalesce(sum(v.code_points),0) FROM document_versions v JOIN documents d ON d.owner_id=v.owner_id AND d.id=v.document_id WHERE v.owner_id=? AND d.lifecycle<>'deleted' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_storage_operations o WHERE o.owner_id=v.owner_id AND o.document_version_id=v.id AND o.state<>'deleted')) points", owner.ownerId, owner.ownerId, documentId, owner.ownerId);
    if (!current && Number(count?.documents) >= 30 || Number(count?.versions) >= 10 || Number(count?.points) + points > 1e6)
      throw new DocumentServiceError("quota-exceeded");
    const statements = [
      this.repo.guard("(SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE owner_id=? AND lifecycle<>'deleted')<? AND (SELECT count(*) FROM document_versions v WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_storage_operations o WHERE o.owner_id=v.owner_id AND o.document_version_id=v.id AND o.state<>'deleted'))<10 AND (SELECT coalesce(sum(v.code_points),0) FROM document_versions v JOIN documents d ON d.owner_id=v.owner_id AND d.id=v.document_id WHERE v.owner_id=? AND d.lifecycle<>'deleted' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_storage_operations o WHERE o.owner_id=v.owner_id AND o.document_version_id=v.id AND o.state<>'deleted'))+?<=1000000", owner.ownerId, current ? 31 : 30, owner.ownerId, documentId, owner.ownerId, points)
    ];
    if (current)
      statements.push(this.repo.guard("EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM documents WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND lifecycle='active' AND generation=? AND revision=?)", owner.ownerId, documentId, generation, current.revision));
    else
      statements.push(this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO documents(owner_id,id,kind,display_name,lifecycle,generation,revision,current_document_version_id,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'active',0,0,?,?,?)", owner.ownerId, documentId, "kind" in request ? request.kind : "resume", "displayName" in request ? request.displayName : "", versionId, now, now));
    statements.push(this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO document_versions(owner_id,document_id,id,text_version_id,state,generation,revision,text_digest,object_key,utf8_bytes,code_points,segments_json,parser_version,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'pending',?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'2026.11.1',?)", owner.ownerId, documentId, versionId, textVersionId, generation, revision, digest, key, bytes, points, JSON.stringify(segmentDocumentText(text)), now), this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO document_text_versions(owner_id,document_id,document_version_id,id,parser_version,text_hash,object_key,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'2026.11.1',?,?,?)", owner.ownerId, documentId, versionId, textVersionId, digest, key, now), this.repo.statement("INSERT INTO document_storage_operations(owner_id,id,document_id,document_version_id,object_key,generation,expected_revision,writer_protocol,state,next_attempt_at,mutation_endpoint,mutation_id,body_digest,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'writing',?,?,?,?,?)", owner.ownerId, intentId, documentId, versionId, key, generation, current?.revision ?? 0, documentWriterProtocol, now, endpoint, request.mutationId, identity.bodyDigest, now));
    try {
      await this.repo.db.batch(statements);
    } catch {
      if (current) {
        const fresh = await this.repo.document(owner.ownerId, documentId);
        if (fresh.revision !== current.revision || fresh.generation !== generation)
          throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
      }
      const quotas = await this.repo.one("SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE owner_id=? AND lifecycle<>'deleted') documents,(SELECT count(*) FROM document_versions v WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=?
