AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_storage_operations o WHERE o.owner_id=v.owner_id AND o.document_version_id=v.id AND o.state<>'deleted')) versions,(SELECT coalesce(sum(v.code_points),0) FROM document_versions v JOIN documents d ON d.owner_id=v.owner_id AND d.id=v.document_id WHERE v.owner_id=? AND d.lifecycle<>'deleted' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_storage_operations o WHERE o.owner_id=v.owner_id AND o.document_version_id=v.id AND o.state<>'deleted')) points", owner.ownerId, owner.ownerId, documentId, owner.ownerId);
      throw new DocumentServiceError(!current && Number(quotas?.documents) >= 30 || Number(quotas?.versions) >= 10 || Number(quotas?.points) + points > 1e6 ? "quota-exceeded" : "conflict");
    }
    try {
      await this.storage.write(key, text, async (uploadId) => {
        const enrolled = await this.repo.statement(
          `UPDATE document_storage_operations SET r2_upload_id=?
                    WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND document_id=? AND generation=? AND object_key=?
                    AND writer_protocol=? AND state='writing' AND r2_upload_id IS NULL`,
          uploadId,
          owner.ownerId,
          intentId,
          documentId,
          generation,
          key,
          documentWriterProtocol
        ).run();
        if (enrolled.meta.changes !== 1) throw new DocumentServiceError("conflict");
      });
      const receipt = { documentId, documentVersionId: versionId, textVersionId, revision };
      return await this.repo.commit(identity, receipt, [
        this.repo.statement("UPDATE documents SET current_document_version_id=?,revision=?,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND generation=? AND revision=? AND lifecycle='active'", versionId, revision, now, owner.ownerId, documentId, generation, current?.revision ?? 0),
        this.repo.changed(),
        this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_versions SET state='ready' WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND id=? AND state='pending'", owner.ownerId, documentId, versionId),
        this.repo.changed(),
        this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_storage_operations SET state='active',writer_terminated=1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND state='writing'", owner.ownerId, intentId),
        this.repo.changed()
      ]);
    } catch (error51) {
      await this.repo.db.batch([
        this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_storage_operations SET state='cleanup-pending' WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND state='writing'", owner.ownerId, intentId),
        this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_versions SET state='cleanup-pending' WHERE owner_id=? AND document_id=? AND id=? AND state='pending'", owner.ownerId, documentId, versionId)
      ]);
      throw error51;
    }
  }
  async reclaimStorage(limit = 10) {
    const rows = await this.repo.all("SELECT owner_id,id,document_id,attempts FROM document_storage_operations WHERE state='cleanup-pending' AND next_attempt_at<=? ORDER BY next_attempt_at,created_at LIMIT ?", this.repo.now(), Math.min(limit, 10));
    for (const row of rows) {
      try {
        if (!await this.storage.reclaim(this.repo, String(row.owner_id), String(row.id)))
          throw new Error("WRITER_NOT_FENCED");
        await this.repo.statement(`UPDATE documents SET lifecycle='deleted',display_name='\u5DF2\u5220\u9664',generation=generation+1,revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND lifecycle='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_versions v WHERE v.owner_id=documents.owner_id AND v.document_id=documents.id AND v.state='ready') AND NOT (${documentHasPendingStorage})`, this.repo.now(), row.owner_id, row.document_id).run();
      } catch {
        await this.repo.statement("UPDATE document_storage_operations SET attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND state='cleanup-pending'", this.repo.now() + Math.min(36e5, 1e3 * 2 ** Math.min(Number(row.attempts), 12)), row.owner_id, row.id).run();
      }
    }
  }
};
function createDocumentServices(options) {
  const repo = new D1DocumentRepository(options.db, options.clock, options.id), storage = new DocumentStorage(options.bucket), documents = new DocumentService(repo, storage);
  const review = new ReviewService(repo, storage), confirmation = new ConfirmationService(repo, storage), selection = new SelectionService(repo), deletion = new DeletionService(repo, storage, options.deletionPort);
  return {
    readDocumentMutation: documents.readDocumentMutation.bind(documents),
    readDocumentExtraction: review.readDocumentExtraction.bind(review),
    adoptDocumentExtraction: review.adoptDocumentExtraction.bind(review),
    deleteDocument: deletion.deleteDocument.bind(deletion),
    readDocumentDeletion: deletion.readDocumentDeletion.bind(deletion),
    readDocumentReviewDraft: review.readDocumentReviewDraft.bind(review),
    saveDocumentReviewDraft: review.saveDocumentReviewDraft.bind(review),
    createDocumentConfirmation: confirmation.createDocumentConfirmation.bind(confirmation),
    createMaterialSelection: selection.createMaterialSelection.bind(selection),
    updateMaterialSelection: selection.updateMaterialSelection.bind(selection),
    readMaterialSelection: selection.readMaterialSelection.bind(selection),
    readAdoptedMaterials: selection.readAdoptedMaterials.bind(selection),
    listDocuments: documents.listDocuments.bind(documents),
    createDocument: documents.createDocument.bind(documents),
    readDocument: documents.readDocument.bind(documents),
    createDocumentVersion: documents.createDocumentVersion.bind(documents)
  };
}

// app/lib/materials/explanations.ts
var MATERIAL_EXPLANATION_VERSION = "2026.11.5";
function explainMaterialPreview(preview, available) {
  if (!available || !preview) return [{ ruleId: "source-unavailable-v1", changeKind: "unavailable", skillId: null, unitIds: [], reasonItemIds: [], message: "Source evidence deleted", sourceAvailability: "unavailable" }];
  const result = preview.priorities.flatMap((priority) => {
    if (priority.tier === 3 && priority.learningIntentItemIds?.length) return [
      ...priority.practiceItemIds?.length ? [{ ruleId: "confirmed-practice-v1", changeKind: "reordered", skillId: priority.skillId, unitIds: [], reasonItemIds: [...priority.practiceItemIds], sourceAvailability: "available", message: "Existing practice related to your confirmed experience is prioritized." }] : [],
      { ruleId: "confirmed-learning-intent-v1", changeKind: "reordered", skillId: priority.skillId, unitIds: [], reasonItemIds: [...priority.learningIntentItemIds], sourceAvailability: "available", message: "Your chosen learning focus prioritizes existing tasks. Self-assessment and study time stay unchanged." }
    ];
    return [{
      ruleId: priority.tier === 0 ? "mandatory-gap-first-v1" : priority.tier === 1 ? "mandatory-calibration-learning-v1" : priority.tier === 2 ? "mandatory-calibration-v1" : priority.tier === 3 ? "confirmed-practice-v1" : "preferred-after-mandatory-v1",
      changeKind: "reordered",
      skillId: priority.skillId,
      unitIds: [],
      reasonItemIds: [...priority.itemIds],
      sourceAvailability: "available",
      message: priority.tier === 0 ? "Must-have skills from the primary JD are prioritized, retaining prerequisites and full task durations." : priority.tier === 1 ? "Must-have skills use your confirmed Uncertain self-assessment, retaining calibration and later learning." : priority.tier === 2 ? "Must-have skills use your individually confirmed Independent self-assessment and receive calibration tasks." : priority.tier === 3 ? "Existing practice related to your confirmed experience is prioritized." : "Preferred requirements from the primary JD follow must-have requirements."
    }];
  });
  for (const skillId of preview.overlay?.mandatorySkillIds ?? []) result.push({ ruleId: "mandatory-scope-protection-v1", changeKind: "protected", skillId, unitIds: [], reasonItemIds: preview.priorities.find((p) => p.skillId === skillId)?.itemIds ?? [], message: "Must-have skills and their prerequisites are not removed or shortened to meet a deadline.", sourceAvailability: "available" });
  for (const status of ["full", "partial", "none"]) {
    const details = preview.mappingDetails?.filter((detail) => detail.taskCoverage?.status === status) ?? [];
    if (!details.length) continue;
    result.push({
      ruleId: `course-task-${status}-v1`,
      changeKind: "unapplied",
      skillId: null,
      unitIds: [...new Set(details.flatMap((detail) => detail.taskCoverage.support.map((id) => COURSE_TASK_EVIDENCE[id].unitId)))],
      reasonItemIds: [...new Set(details.map((detail) => detail.itemId))],
      sourceAvailability: "available",
      message: status === "full" ? "Course content supports the recognized narrow task. Coverage does not establish ability or an adopted priority; no courses or tasks were added." : status === "partial" ? "Course content supports part of the concrete task; the remaining requirements are unverified. Coverage does not establish ability or an adopted priority; no courses or tasks were added." : "Course content has not been verified to support the concrete task. A topic match or manual choice does not establish full coverage, ability or an adopted priority."
    });
  }
  for (const issue2 of preview.issues) result.push({ ruleId: `${issue2.code}-v1`, changeKind: issue2.code === "uncovered" ? "uncovered" : "unapplied", skillId: issue2.skillIds.length === 1 ? issue2.skillIds[0] : null, unitIds: [], reasonItemIds: [...issue2.itemIds], message: issue2.code === "target-infeasible" ? "The full must-have scope cannot fit the target date. Tasks were not shortened and daily budgets were not exceeded." : issue2.code === "uncovered" ? "The current learning catalog does not cover this content. No courses or tasks were added." : issue2.code === "learning-intent-not-adopted" ? "You have not selected this suggestion or topic as a focus, so it does not change task priorities." : issue2.code === "mapping-omitted" ? "You excluded these terms from this course mapping. The original facts are retained." : "This item needs further review and is not yet a confirmed planning basis.", sourceAvailability: "available" });
  return result;
}

// app/lib/intelligence-validation.ts
function validateRoleBlueprint(blueprint) {
  const issues = [];
  const issueKeys = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  function addIssue(issue2) {
    const key = `${issue2.code}\0${issue2.path}\0${issue2.message}`;
    if (issueKeys.has(key)) return;
    issueKeys.add(key);
    issues.push(issue2);
  }
  const seenSkillIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const skill2 of blueprint.skills) {
    if (seenSkillIds.has(skill2.id)) {
      addIssue({
        code: "duplicate-skill",
        path: `skills.${skill2.id}`,
        message: `Skill ID ${skill2.id} is duplicated.`
      });
    }
    seenSkillIds.add(skill2.id);
  }
  const seenResourceIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const resource of blueprint.resources) {
    if (seenResourceIds.has(resource.id)) {
      addIssue({
        code: "duplicate-resource",
        path: `resources.${resource.id}`,
        message: `Resource ID ${resource.id} is duplicated.`
      });
    }
    seenResourceIds.add(resource.id);
  }
  const seenPhaseIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const phase of blueprint.phases) {
    if (seenPhaseIds.has(phase.id)) {
      addIssue({
        code: "duplicate-phase",
        path: `phases.${phase.id}`,
        message: `Phase ID ${phase.id} is duplicated.`
      });
    }
    seenPhaseIds.add(phase.id);
  }
  function reportDuplicateReferences(ids, path) {
    const seenIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    for (const id of ids) {
      if (seenIds.has(id)) {
        addIssue({
          code: "duplicate-reference",
          path,
          message: `Reference ${id} is duplicated.`
        });
      }
      seenIds.add(id);
    }
  }
  for (const skill2 of blueprint.skills) {
    reportDuplicateReferences(
      skill2.prerequisiteIds,
      `skills.${skill2.id}.prerequisiteIds`
    );
    reportDuplicateReferences(skill2.resourceIds, `skills.${skill2.id}.resourceIds`);
  }
  for (const phase of blueprint.phases) {
    reportDuplicateReferences(phase.skillIds, `phases.${phase.id}.skillIds`);
  }
  for (const resource of blueprint.resources) {
    reportDuplicateReferences(resource.skillIds, `resources.${resource.id}.skillIds`);
  }
  const skillsById = new Map(blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => [skill2.id, skill2]));
  const resourcesById = new Map(blueprint.resources.map((resource) => [resource.id, resource]));
  const skillResourceIdsById = new Map(
    blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => [skill2.id, new Set(skill2.resourceIds)])
  );
  const resourceSkillIdsById = new Map(
    blueprint.resources.map((resource) => [resource.id, new Set(resource.skillIds)])
  );
  for (const skill2 of blueprint.skills) {
    for (const prerequisiteId of skill2.prerequisiteIds) {
      if (!skillsById.has(prerequisiteId)) {
        addIssue({
          code: "missing-prerequisite",
          path: `skills.${skill2.id}.prerequisiteIds`,
          message: `Skill ${skill2.id} has missing prerequisite ${prerequisiteId}.`
        });
      }
    }
  }
  for (const resource of blueprint.resources) {
    for (const skillId of resource.skillIds) {
      if (!skillsById.has(skillId)) {
        addIssue({
          code: "missing-resource-skill",
          path: `resources.${resource.id}.skillIds`,
          message: `Resource ${resource.id} links missing skill ${skillId}.`
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (!skillResourceIdsById.get(skillId)?.has(resource.id)) {
        addIssue({
          code: "resource-forward-link-mismatch",
          path: `resources.${resource.id}.skillIds`,
          message: `Resource ${resource.id} links skill ${skillId}, but the skill does not link back.`
        });
      }
    }
  }
  for (const skill2 of blueprint.skills) {
    for (const resourceId2 of skill2.resourceIds) {
      const resource = resourcesById.get(resourceId2);
      if (!resource) {
        addIssue({
          code: "missing-resource",
          path: `skills.${skill2.id}.resourceIds`,
          message: `Skill ${skill2.id} links missing resource ${resourceId2}.`
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (!resourceSkillIdsById.get(resource.id)?.has(skill2.id)) {
        addIssue({
          code: "resource-backlink-mismatch",
          path: `resources.${resource.id}.skillIds`,
          message: `Resource ${resource.id} does not link back to skill ${skill2.id}.`
        });
      }
    }
  }
  for (const phase of blueprint.phases) {
    for (const skillId of phase.skillIds) {
      if (!skillsById.has(skillId)) {
        addIssue({
          code: "missing-phase-skill",
          path: `phases.${phase.id}.skillIds`,
          message: `Phase ${phase.id} links missing skill ${skillId}.`
        });
      }
    }
  }
  const plannedSkillIds = new Set(blueprint.phases.flatMap((phase) => phase.skillIds));
  for (const skill2 of blueprint.skills) {
    if (!plannedSkillIds.has(skill2.id)) {
      addIssue({
        code: "unplanned-skill",
        path: `skills.${skill2.id}`,
        message: `Skill ${skill2.id} is not assigned to a phase.`
      });
    }
  }
  const visitColors = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const rootSkill of blueprint.skills) {
    if (visitColors.has(rootSkill.id)) continue;
    visitColors.set(rootSkill.id, "visiting");
    const stack = [
      { skillId: rootSkill.id, nextPrerequisiteIndex: 0 }
    ];
    while (stack.length > 0) {
      const frame = stack[stack.length - 1];
      const skill2 = skillsById.get(frame.skillId);
      if (!skill2 || frame.nextPrerequisiteIndex >= skill2.prerequisiteIds.length) {
        visitColors.set(frame.skillId, "visited");
        stack.pop();
        continue;
      }
      const prerequisiteId = skill2.prerequisiteIds[frame.nextPrerequisiteIndex];
      frame.nextPrerequisiteIndex += 1;
      if (!skillsById.has(prerequisiteId)) continue;
      const prerequisiteColor = visitColors.get(prerequisiteId);
      if (prerequisiteColor === "visiting") {
        addIssue({
          code: "prerequisite-cycle",
          path: `skills.${skill2.id}.prerequisiteIds`,
          message: `Prerequisite ${prerequisiteId} creates a cycle for ${skill2.id}.`
        });
        continue;
      }
      if (prerequisiteColor === "visited") continue;
      visitColors.set(prerequisiteId, "visiting");
      stack.push({ skillId: prerequisiteId, nextPrerequisiteIndex: 0 });
    }
  }
  for (const skill2 of blueprint.skills) {
    const hasPaidPrimary = skill2.resourceIds.some((resourceId2) => {
      const resource = resourcesById.get(resourceId2);
      return resource?.purpose === "primary" && (resource.cost === "paid" || resource.cost === "mixed");
    });
    const hasFreeAlternative = skill2.resourceIds.some((resourceId2) => {
      const resource = resourcesById.get(resourceId2);
      return resource?.purpose === "alternative" && resource.cost === "free";
    });
    if (hasPaidPrimary && !hasFreeAlternative) {
      addIssue({
        code: "free-alternative-required",
        path: `skills.${skill2.id}.resourceIds`,
        message: `Skill ${skill2.id} needs a free alternative resource.`
      });
    }
  }
  issues.sort((left, right) => {
    if (left.code < right.code) return -1;
    if (left.code > right.code) return 1;
    if (left.path < right.path) return -1;
    if (left.path > right.path) return 1;
    return 0;
  });
  return { valid: issues.length === 0, issues };
}

// app/lib/planning/calendar.ts
var MAX_CALENDAR_DAY_DELTA = 366e3;
var MAX_CALENDAR_DATE_COUNT = 3661;
var WEEKDAYS = ["sunday", "monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday"];
function invalidDate() {
  throw new TypeError("Invalid calendar date");
}
function parseCalendarDate(value) {
  if (!calendarDateSchema.safeParse(value).success) invalidDate();
  const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
  return { year, month, day };
}
function toUtcDate(value) {
  const { year, month, day } = parseCalendarDate(value);
  const date5 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Date(0);
  date5.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  date5.setUTCFullYear(year, month - 1, day);
  return date5;
}
function formatCalendarDate(date5) {
  const year = date5.getUTCFullYear();
  if (!Number.isFinite(date5.getTime()) || year < 0 || year > 9999) invalidDate();
  const formatted = `${String(year).padStart(4, "0")}-${String(date5.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(date5.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  if (!calendarDateSchema.safeParse(formatted).success) invalidDate();
  return formatted;
}
function parseAvailability(value) {
  const parsed = availabilityVersionSchema.safeParse(value);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new TypeError("Invalid availability");
  return parsed.data;
}
function addCalendarDays(date5, days) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(days) || Math.abs(days) > MAX_CALENDAR_DAY_DELTA) {
    throw new RangeError("Invalid calendar day count");
  }
  const result = toUtcDate(date5);
  result.setUTCDate(result.getUTCDate() + days);
  return formatCalendarDate(result);
}
function compareCalendarDates(left, right) {
  parseCalendarDate(left);
  parseCalendarDate(right);
  return left === right ? 0 : left < right ? -1 : 1;
}
function calendarDates(start, count) {
  parseCalendarDate(start);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 0 || count > MAX_CALENDAR_DATE_COUNT) {
    throw new RangeError("Invalid calendar date count");
  }
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => addCalendarDays(start, index));
}
function weekdayForDate(date5) {
  return WEEKDAYS[toUtcDate(date5).getUTCDay()];
}
function minutesForDate(availability, date5) {
  const parsedAvailability = parseAvailability(availability);
  const exception = parsedAvailability.exceptions.find((item) => item.date === date5);
  return exception ? exception.minutes : parsedAvailability.weekdays[weekdayForDate(date5)];
}
function validateAvailabilityHorizon(availability, planningDate) {
  const parsedAvailability = parseAvailability(availability);
  parseCalendarDate(planningDate);
  const lastAllowedDate = addCalendarDays(planningDate, 365);
  for (const exception of parsedAvailability.exceptions) {
    if (compareCalendarDates(exception.date, planningDate) < 0 || compareCalendarDates(exception.date, lastAllowedDate) > 0) {
      throw new RangeError("Availability exception is outside the planning horizon");
    }
  }
}

// app/lib/planning/registry-validation.ts
var REQUIRED_KINDS = ["learn", "calibrate", "reinforce"];
function validateUnitRegistry(registry2, blueprint) {
  const issues = [];
  const issueKeys = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const skillsById = new Map(blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => [skill2.id, skill2]));
  const resourcesById = new Map(blueprint.resources.map((resource) => [resource.id, resource]));
  const seenTracks = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const seenTemplates = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const seenSteps = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const seenCheckpoints = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const templatesBySkill = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const addIssue = (code, path, message) => {
    const key = `${code}\0${path}`;
    if (issueKeys.has(key)) return;
    issueKeys.add(key);
    issues.push({ code, path, message });
  };
  if (registry2.blueprintId !== blueprint.id) {
    addIssue("registry-version-mismatch", "registry:blueprint-id", "Registry blueprint ID must match the blueprint");
  }
  if (registry2.blueprintVersion !== blueprint.version) {
    addIssue(
      "registry-version-mismatch",
      "registry:blueprint-version",
      "Registry blueprint version must match the blueprint"
    );
  }
  for (const track of registry2.tracks) {
    const trackPath = `track:${track.skillId}`;
    if (seenTracks.has(track.skillId)) {
      addIssue("duplicate-track", trackPath, "Skill tracks must be unique");
    } else {
      seenTracks.add(track.skillId);
    }
    if (!skillsById.has(track.skillId)) {
      addIssue("missing-skill", trackPath, "Track skill must exist in the blueprint");
    }
    const skillTemplates = templatesBySkill.get(track.skillId) ?? [];
    for (const template of track.templates) {
      const templatePath = `template:${template.id}`;
      if (seenTemplates.has(template.id)) {
        addIssue("duplicate-template", templatePath, "Template IDs must be unique across the registry");
        continue;
      }
      seenTemplates.add(template.id);
      skillTemplates.push(template);
      if (template.skillId !== track.skillId || !skillsById.has(template.skillId)) {
        addIssue(
          "missing-skill",
          `${templatePath}/skill:${template.skillId}`,
          "Template skill must exist and match its track"
        );
      }
      validateResources(template, track.skillId, resourcesById, addIssue);
      validateMinutesAndSteps(template, seenSteps, addIssue);
      validateCheckpoints(template, seenCheckpoints, addIssue);
    }
    templatesBySkill.set(track.skillId, skillTemplates);
  }
  for (const skill2 of blueprint.skills) {
    const templates = templatesBySkill.get(skill2.id);
    if (!templates) {
      addIssue("missing-skill", `skill:${skill2.id}`, "Registry must cover every blueprint skill exactly once");
      continue;
    }
    for (const kind of REQUIRED_KINDS) {
      const count = templates.filter((template) => template.kind === kind).length;
      const validCount = kind === "learn" ? count >= 1 : count === 1;
      if (!validCount) {
        addIssue(
          "missing-kind",
          `skill:${skill2.id}/kind:${kind}`,
          kind === "learn" ? "Skill track requires at least one learn template" : `Skill track requires exactly one ${kind} template`
        );
      }
    }
  }
  issues.sort((left, right) => compareOrdinal(left.code, right.code) || compareOrdinal(left.path, right.path));
  return { valid: issues.length === 0, issues };
}
function validateResources(template, trackSkillId, resourcesById, addIssue) {
  for (const resourceId2 of [template.primaryResourceId, ...template.alternativeResourceIds]) {
    const resource = resourcesById.get(resourceId2);
    if (!resource || !resource.skillIds.includes(trackSkillId)) {
      addIssue(
        "missing-resource",
        `template:${template.id}/resource:${resourceId2}`,
        "Referenced resource must exist and link back to the template skill"
      );
    }
  }
}
function validateMinutesAndSteps(template, seenSteps, addIssue) {
  for (const step of template.steps) {
    if (seenSteps.has(step.id)) {
      addIssue(
        "duplicate-step",
        `template:${template.id}/step:${step.id}`,
        "Step IDs must be unique within a template"
      );
    }
    seenSteps.add(step.id);
  }
  const stepMinutes = template.steps.reduce((sum, step) => sum + step.minutes, 0);
  if (stepMinutes !== template.estimatedMinutes) {
    addIssue("minute-mismatch", `template:${template.id}`, "Template estimate must equal its step-minute total");
  }
}
function validateCheckpoints(template, seenCheckpoints, addIssue) {
  const checkpointPath = `template:${template.id}/checkpoints`;
  for (const checkpoint of template.checkpoints) {
    if (seenCheckpoints.has(checkpoint.id)) {
      addIssue(
        "duplicate-checkpoint",
        `template:${template.id}/checkpoint:${checkpoint.id}`,
        "Checkpoint IDs must be unique within a template"
      );
    }
    seenCheckpoints.add(checkpoint.id);
  }
  if (template.estimatedMinutes <= 60) {
    if (template.checkpoints.length > 0) {
      addIssue("invalid-checkpoint", checkpointPath, "Templates of 60 minutes or less must remain atomic");
    }
    return;
  }
  if (template.checkpoints.length === 0) {
    addIssue("invalid-checkpoint", checkpointPath, "Templates longer than 60 minutes require checkpoints");
    return;
  }
  const stepsById = new Map(template.steps.map((step) => [step.id, step]));
  const expectedStepIds = template.steps.map((step) => step.id);
  const coveredStepIds = [];
  let checkpointTotal = 0;
  let invalid2 = false;
  for (const checkpoint of template.checkpoints) {
    const uniqueStepIds = new Set(checkpoint.stepIds);
    if (uniqueStepIds.size !== checkpoint.stepIds.length) invalid2 = true;
    let includedMinutes = 0;
    for (const stepId of checkpoint.stepIds) {
      const step = stepsById.get(stepId);
      if (!step) invalid2 = true;
      else includedMinutes += step.minutes;
      coveredStepIds.push(stepId);
    }
    if (checkpoint.estimatedMinutes !== includedMinutes) invalid2 = true;
    if (checkpoint.estimatedMinutes < 30 || checkpoint.estimatedMinutes > 60) invalid2 = true;
    checkpointTotal += checkpoint.estimatedMinutes;
  }
  if (coveredStepIds.length !== expectedStepIds.length || coveredStepIds.some((stepId, index) => stepId !== expectedStepIds[index])) invalid2 = true;
  if (checkpointTotal !== template.estimatedMinutes) invalid2 = true;
  if (invalid2) {
    addIssue(
      "invalid-checkpoint",
      checkpointPath,
      "Checkpoints must cover steps exactly once in contiguous source order with matching minutes"
    );
  }
}
function compareOrdinal(left, right) {
  if (left < right) return -1;
  if (left > right) return 1;
  return 0;
}

function validateUnitGraph(units) {
  const indexById = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  units.forEach((unit, index) => {
    if (indexById.has(unit.id)) invalidInput();
    indexById.set(unit.id, index);
  });

    const index = indexById.get(id);
    if (index === void 0 || index === indexById.get(unit.id)) return invalidInput();
    return index;
  }));
  const dependentIndexes = units.map(() => []);

    prerequisites.forEach((prerequisiteIndex) => dependentIndexes[prerequisiteIndex].push(dependentIndex));
  });
  const remaining = prerequisiteIndexes.map((prerequisites) => prerequisites.length);
  const ready = new MinIndexHeap();
  remaining.forEach((count, index) => {
    if (count === 0) ready.push(index);

function estimateParsedUnitSchedule(input) {
  const schedule = createScheduleState(input.graph, input.completedUnitIds);
  const placements = [];
  if (schedule.remaining === 0) return placements;
  const budget = createBudgetResolver(input.availability, input.planningDate);
  if (input.units.some((unit, index) => schedule.isPending(index) && unit.estimatedMinutes > budget.maximumMinutes)) {
    throw new PlanningScheduleError("UNIT_NEVER_FITS");
  }
  let date5 = input.planningDate;
  for (let dayIndex = 0; dayIndex < SCHEDULE_HORIZON_DAYS; dayIndex += 1) {
    const nextIndex = schedule.nextIndex();
    assertNextUnitCanFit(
      input.units,
      nextIndex,
      budget.maximumFrom(date5, true)
    );
    if (nextIndex !== null && input.units[nextIndex].estimatedMinutes <= budget.minutes(date5, dayIndex)) {
      schedule.complete(nextIndex);
      placements.push({ unitId: input.units[nextIndex].id, date: date5 });
      if (schedule.remaining === 0) return placements;
      assertNextUnitCanFit(
        input.units,
        schedule.nextIndex(),
        budget.maximumFrom(date5, false)
      );
    }
    if (dayIndex === SCHEDULE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1) break;
    try {
      date5 = addCalendarDays(date5, 1);
    } catch {
      throw new PlanningScheduleError("SCHEDULE_HORIZON_EXCEEDED");
    }
  }
  throw new PlanningScheduleError("SCHEDULE_HORIZON_EXCEEDED");
}
function assertNextUnitCanFit(units, nextIndex, maximumMinutes) {
  if (nextIndex !== null && units[nextIndex].estimatedMinutes > maximumMinutes) {
    throw new PlanningScheduleError("UNIT_NEVER_FITS");
  }
}
function createScheduleState(graph, completedUnitIds) {
  const completed = graph.units.map((unit) => completedUnitIds.has(unit.id));
  const pending = completed.map((isCompleted) => !isCompleted);
  const remainingPrerequisites = graph.prerequisiteIndexes.map((prerequisites) => prerequisites.reduce((count, index) => count + (completed[index] ? 0 : 1), 0));
  const ready = new MinIndexHeap();
  pending.forEach((isPending, index) => {
    if (isPending && remainingPrerequisites[index] === 0) ready.push(index);
  });
  let remaining = pending.filter(Boolean).length;
  return {
    nextIndex: () => ready.peek(),
    complete(index) {
      if (!pending[index] || ready.peek() !== index) invalidInput();
      ready.pop();
      pending[index] = false;
      completed[index] = true;
      remaining -= 1;
      for (const dependentIndex of graph.dependentIndexes[index]) {
        if (!pending[dependentIndex]) continue;
        remainingPrerequisites[dependentIndex] -= 1;
        if (remainingPrerequisites[dependentIndex] === 0) ready.push(dependentIndex);
      }
    },
    isPending: (index) => pending[index] ?? false,
    get remaining() {
      return remaining;
    }
  };
}
var WEEKDAY_KEYS = [
  "sunday",
  "monday",
  "tuesday",
  "wednesday",
  "thursday",
  "friday",
  "saturday"
];
function createBudgetResolver(availability, planningDate) {
  const exceptionMinutes = new Map(availability.exceptions.map((exception) => [exception.date, exception.minutes]));
  const orderedExceptions = [...availability.exceptions].sort((left, right) => compareCalendarDates(left.date, right.date));
  const suffixMaximums = new Array(orderedExceptions.length);
  let suffixMaximum = 0;
  for (let index = orderedExceptions.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    suffixMaximum = Math.max(suffixMaximum, orderedExceptions[index].minutes);
    suffixMaximums[index] = suffixMaximum;
  }
  const startWeekdayIndex = WEEKDAY_KEYS.indexOf(weekdayForDate(planningDate));
  const recurringMaximum = Math.max(...Object.values(availability.weekdays));
  const maximumMinutes = Math.max(recurringMaximum, suffixMaximums[0] ?? 0);
  return {
    maximumMinutes,
    maximumFrom(date5, inclusive) {
      let low = 0;
      let high = orderedExceptions.length;
      while (low < high) {
        const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
        const comparison = compareCalendarDates(orderedExceptions[middle].date, date5);
        if (comparison > 0 || inclusive && comparison === 0) high = middle;
        else low = middle + 1;
      }
      return Math.max(recurringMaximum, suffixMaximums[low] ?? 0);
    },
    minutes(date5, dayIndex) {
      return exceptionMinutes.get(date5) ?? availability.weekdays[WEEKDAY_KEYS[(startWeekdayIndex + dayIndex) % 7]];
    }
  };
}
var MinIndexHeap = class {
  constructor() {
    this.values = [];
  }
  get size() {
    return this.values.length;
  }
  peek() {
    return this.values[0] ?? null;
  }
  push(value) {
    this.values.push(value);
    let index = this.values.length - 1;
    while (index > 0) {
      const parent = Math.floor((index - 1) / 2);
      if (this.values[parent] <= value) break;
      this.values[index] = this.values[parent];
      index = parent;
    }
    this.values[index] = value;
  }
  pop() {
    const first = this.values[0];
    const last = this.values.pop();
    if (first === void 0 || last === void 0) return null;
    if (this.values.length === 0) return first;
    let index = 0;
    while (true) {
      const left = index * 2 + 1;
      if (left >= this.values.length) break;
      const right = left + 1;
      const child = right < this.values.length && this.values[right] < this.values[left] ? right : left;
      if (this.values[child] >= last) break;
      this.values[index] = this.values[child];
      index = child;
    }
    this.values[index] = last;
    return first;
  }
};

function prioritizeReadyNodes(nodes, completed = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set()) {
  const byId = new Map(nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
  if (byId.size !== nodes.length) throw new Error("DUPLICATE_NODE");
  const ranks = new Map(nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node.rank]));
  for (const node of nodes) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(node.rank) || node.rank < 0 || node.rank > 5) throw new Error("INVALID_RANK");
    for (const dependency of node.prerequisiteIds) if (!byId.has(dependency) && !completed.has(dependency)) throw new Error("MISSING_DEPENDENCY");
  }
  for (let pass = 0; pass < nodes.length; pass++) {
    let changed = false;
    for (const node of nodes) for (const dependency of node.prerequisiteIds) {
      if (!byId.has(dependency)) continue;
      const rank = Math.min(ranks.get(dependency), ranks.get(node.id));
      if (rank !== ranks.get(dependency)) {
        ranks.set(dependency, rank);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  const seen = new Set(completed), remaining = new Map(byId), result = [];
  while (remaining.size) {
    const ready = [...remaining.values()].filter((node) => node.prerequisiteIds.every((id) => seen.has(id))).sort((a, b) => ranks.get(a.id) - ranks.get(b.id) || a.originalIndex - b.originalIndex || (a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0));
    const next = ready[0];
    if (!next) throw new Error("DEPENDENCY_CYCLE");
    result.push(next.id);
    seen.add(next.id);
    remaining.delete(next.id);
  }
  return result;
}
function createMaterialOverlay(input) {
  const known = new Set(input.knownSkillIds), answers = new Map(input.audit.answers.map((a) => [a.skillId, a.level]));
  const skillRanks = Object.fromEntries(input.knownSkillIds.map((id) => [id, 5]));
  const mandatorySkillIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const skillId of input.practiceSkillIds) if (known.has(skillId)) skillRanks[skillId] = 3;
  for (const requirement of input.requirements) {
    if (!known.has(requirement.skillId)) continue;
    const level = answers.get(requirement.skillId);
    if (requirement.level === "must") mandatorySkillIds.add(requirement.skillId);
    const rank = requirement.level === "must" ? level === "independent" ? 2 : level === "uncertain" ? 1 : 0 : requirement.level === "preferred" ? 4 : 5;
    skillRanks[requirement.skillId] = Math.min(skillRanks[requirement.skillId], rank);
  }
  const classified = new Set(input.requirements.filter((item) => item.level !== "unspecified").map((item) => item.skillId));
  for (const skillId of input.learningIntentSkillIds ?? []) if (known.has(skillId) && !classified.has(skillId)) {
    skillRanks[skillId] = Math.min(skillRanks[skillId], 3);
  }
  return { skillRanks, mandatorySkillIds: [...mandatorySkillIds].sort(), semanticFingerprint: input.semanticFingerprint, policyVersion: MATERIAL_PLANNING_POLICY_VERSION };
}

// app/lib/planning/path-builder.ts
var PlanningInputError = class extends Error {
  constructor(issues) {
    super("Planning input is invalid.");
    this.name = "PlanningInputError";
    this.issues = Object.freeze([...issues].sort(compareIssues).map((issue2) => Object.freeze({ ...issue2 })));
  }
};
var PlanningEstimationBoundaryError = class extends Error {
  constructor(code) {
    super(code === "invalid-completion-date" ? "The completion estimator returned an invalid calendar date." : "The completion estimator returned a date before the planning date.");
    this.name = "PlanningEstimationBoundaryError";
    this.code = code;
  }
};
function createPathBuilder(estimate) {
  if (typeof estimate !== "function") throw new TypeError("A completion estimator is required");
  return (input) => buildValidatedPathAlternatives(input, estimate);
}
var buildLearningPaths = createPathBuilder(
  (units, availability, planningDate) => estimateCompletionDate({
    units,
    availability,
    planningDate
  })
);
function buildValidatedPathAlternatives(input, estimate) {
  const parsed = parseAndValidateInput(input);
  const baselineSkills = topologicallyOrderSkills(parsed.blueprint);
  const orderedSkills = parsed.materialOverlay ? prioritizeReadyNodes(baselineSkills.map((skill2, originalIndex) => ({ id: skill2.id, prerequisiteIds: skill2.prerequisiteIds, rank: parsed.materialOverlay.skillRanks[skill2.id] ?? 5, originalIndex }))).map((id) => baselineSkills.find((skill2) => skill2.id === id)) : baselineSkills;
  const allUnits = expandPathUnits(parsed, orderedSkills);
  const fullCompletionDate = estimateAndValidate(
    estimate,
    allUnits,
    parsed.availability,
    parsed.planningDate
  );
  const fullScope = buildPathVersion(parsed, "full-scope", allUnits, [], fullCompletionDate);
  const deadline = addCalendarDays(parsed.planningDate, parsed.target.targetWeeks * 7 - 1);
  let targetDate = null;
  let infeasibleReason = null;
  if (compareCalendarDates(fullCompletionDate, deadline) <= 0) {
    targetDate = buildPathVersion(parsed, "target-date", allUnits, [], fullCompletionDate);
  } else {
    const retained = new Set(orderedSkills.map((skill2) => skill2.id));
    const protectedSkills = protectedCoreClosure(parsed.blueprint, parsed.materialOverlay?.mandatorySkillIds);
    const deferred = [];
    while (targetDate === null) {
      const candidate = nextDeferCandidate(parsed.blueprint, retained, protectedSkills);
      if (!candidate) break;
      retained.delete(candidate.id);
      deferred.push({
        skillId: candidate.id,
        reason: candidate.importance === "advantage" ? "target-date-advantage" : "target-date-strong"
      });
      const retainedUnits = allUnits.filter((unit) => retained.has(unit.skillId));
      if (retainedUnits.length === 0) break;
      const completionDate = estimateAndValidate(
        estimate,
        retainedUnits,
        parsed.availability,
        parsed.planningDate
      );
      if (compareCalendarDates(completionDate, deadline) <= 0) {
        targetDate = buildPathVersion(parsed, "target-date", retainedUnits, deferred, completionDate);
      }
    }
    if (targetDate === null) {
      infeasibleReason = "The protected learning scope cannot be completed by the target date without shortening authored units.";
    }
  }
  return deepFreeze2(pathBuildResultSchema.parse({ fullScope, targetDate, infeasibleReason }));
}
function parseAndValidateInput(input) {
  const issues = [];
  const blueprint = parseContract(roleBlueprintSchema, input?.blueprint, "blueprint", issues);
  const registry2 = parseContract(unitRegistrySchema, input?.registry, "registry", issues);
  const audit = parseContract(skillAuditVersionSchema, input?.audit, "audit", issues);
  const availability = parseContract(availabilityVersionSchema, input?.availability, "availability", issues);
  const target = parseContract(planningTargetSchema, input?.target, "target", issues);
  const planningDate = parseContract(calendarDateSchema, input?.planningDate, "planning-date", issues);
  if (!blueprint || !registry2 || !audit || !availability || !target || !planningDate) {
    throw new PlanningInputError(issues);
  }
  for (const issue2 of validateRoleBlueprint(blueprint).issues) {
    issues.push({ code: `blueprint-${issue2.code}`, path: `blueprint.${issue2.path}` });
  }
  for (const issue2 of validateUnitRegistry(registry2, blueprint).issues) {
    issues.push({ code: `registry-${issue2.code}`, path: `registry.${issue2.path}` });
  }
  validateAuditCoverage(blueprint, audit, issues);
  try {
    validateAvailabilityHorizon(availability, planningDate);
  } catch (error51) {
    if (error51 instanceof RangeError) {
      issues.push({ code: "availability-horizon-invalid", path: "availability.exceptions" });
    } else if (error51 instanceof TypeError) {
      issues.push({ code: "planning-date-horizon-overflow", path: "planning-date" });
    } else {
      throw error51;
    }
  }
  if (issues.length > 0) throw new PlanningInputError(issues);
  if (input.materialOverlay) {
    const known = new Set(blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => skill2.id));
    const overlay = input.materialOverlay;
    if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u.test(overlay.semanticFingerprint) || !/^\d{4}\.\d{2}\.\d+$/u.test(overlay.policyVersion) || overlay.mandatorySkillIds.some((id) => !known.has(id)) || Object.entries(overlay.skillRanks).some(([id, rank]) => !known.has(id) || !Number.isInteger(rank) || rank < 0 || rank > 5)) {
      throw new PlanningInputError([{ code: "material-overlay-invalid", path: "materialOverlay" }]);
    }
  }
  return { blueprint, registry: registry2, audit, availability, target, planningDate, ...input.materialOverlay ? { materialOverlay: structuredClone(input.materialOverlay) } : {} };
}
function parseContract(schema, value, root, issues) {
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(value);
  if (parsed.success) return parsed.data;
  for (const issue2 of parsed.error.issues) {
    issues.push({
      code: `${root}-contract-${issue2.code}`,
      path: semanticPath(root, issue2.path)
    });
  }
  return null;
}
function semanticPath(root, path) {
  return path.reduce((result, part) => typeof part === "number" ? `${result}[${part}]` : `${result}.${String(part)}`, root);
}
function validateAuditCoverage(blueprint, audit, issues) {
  if (audit.blueprintId !== blueprint.id) {
    issues.push({ code: "audit-blueprint-mismatch", path: "audit.blueprintId" });
  }
  if (audit.blueprintVersion !== blueprint.version) {
    issues.push({ code: "audit-blueprint-version-mismatch", path: "audit.blueprintVersion" });
  }
  const blueprintSkillIds = new Set(blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => skill2.id));
  const answerSkillIds = new Set(audit.answers.map((answer) => answer.skillId));
  for (const skill2 of blueprint.skills) {
    if (!answerSkillIds.has(skill2.id)) {
      issues.push({ code: "audit-answer-missing", path: `audit.answers.skill:${skill2.id}` });
    }
  }
  for (const answer of audit.answers) {
    if (!blueprintSkillIds.has(answer.skillId)) {
      issues.push({ code: "audit-answer-extra", path: `audit.answers.skill:${answer.skillId}` });
    }
  }
}
function topologicallyOrderSkills(blueprint) {
  const skillById = new Map(blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => [skill2.id, skill2]));
  const indegree = new Map(blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => [skill2.id, skill2.prerequisiteIds.length]));
  const dependents = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const skill2 of blueprint.skills) {
    for (const prerequisiteId of skill2.prerequisiteIds) {
      const current = dependents.get(prerequisiteId) ?? [];
      current.push(skill2.id);
      dependents.set(prerequisiteId, current);
    }
  }
  const comparator = skillComparator(blueprint);
  const ready = blueprint.skills.filter((skill2) => indegree.get(skill2.id) === 0).sort(comparator);
  const ordered = [];
  while (ready.length > 0) {
    const skill2 = ready.shift();
    ordered.push(skill2);
    for (const dependentId of dependents.get(skill2.id) ?? []) {
      const remaining = indegree.get(dependentId) - 1;
      indegree.set(dependentId, remaining);
      if (remaining === 0) {
        ready.push(skillById.get(dependentId));
        ready.sort(comparator);
      }
    }
  }
  return ordered;
}
function estimateAndValidate(estimate, units, availability, planningDate) {
  const unitSnapshot = deepFreeze2(units.map((unit) => ({
    ...unit,
    prerequisiteUnitIds: [...unit.prerequisiteUnitIds]
  })));
  const availabilitySnapshot = deepFreeze2(availabilityVersionSchema.parse(availability));
  const estimatedCompletionDate = estimate(unitSnapshot, availabilitySnapshot, planningDate);
  const parsedDate = calendarDateSchema.safeParse(estimatedCompletionDate);
  if (!parsedDate.success) {
    throw new PlanningEstimationBoundaryError("invalid-completion-date");
  }
  if (compareCalendarDates(parsedDate.data, planningDate) < 0) {
    throw new PlanningEstimationBoundaryError("completion-before-planning-date");
  }
  return parsedDate.data;
}
function skillComparator(blueprint) {
  const phaseIndexes = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  blueprint.phases.forEach((phase, phaseIndex) => {
    phase.skillIds.forEach((skillId) => phaseIndexes.set(skillId, phaseIndex));
  });
  const blueprintIndexes = new Map(blueprint.skills.map((skill2, index) => [skill2.id, index]));
  return (left, right) => phaseIndexes.get(left.id) - phaseIndexes.get(right.id) || blueprintIndexes.get(left.id) - blueprintIndexes.get(right.id) || compareOrdinal3(left.id, right.id);
}
function expandPathUnits(input, orderedSkills) {
  const tracks = new Map(input.registry.tracks.map((track) => [track.skillId, track]));
  const answers = new Map(input.audit.answers.map((answer) => [answer.skillId, answer]));
  const finalUnitIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const units = [];
  for (const skill2 of orderedSkills) {
    const answer = answers.get(skill2.id);
    const trackTemplates = tracks.get(skill2.id).templates;
    const learnTemplates = trackTemplates.filter(({ kind }) => kind === "learn");
    const calibrationTemplates = trackTemplates.filter(({ kind }) => kind === "calibrate");
    const templates = answer.level === "independent" ? calibrationTemplates : answer.level === "uncertain" ? [...calibrationTemplates, ...learnTemplates] : learnTemplates;
    let previousUnitId = null;
    for (const template of templates) {
      const parts = template.checkpoints.length > 0 ? template.checkpoints : [null];
      for (const checkpoint of parts) {
        const unitId = stableUnitId(input, template, checkpoint?.id ?? null);
        const prerequisiteUnitIds = previousUnitId ? [previousUnitId] : skill2.prerequisiteIds.map((id) => finalUnitIds.get(id));
        const unit = {
          id: unitId,
          templateId: template.id,
          templateVersion: template.version,
          checkpointId: checkpoint?.id ?? null,
          skillId: skill2.id,
          kind: template.kind,
          estimatedMinutes: checkpoint?.estimatedMinutes ?? template.estimatedMinutes,
          prerequisiteUnitIds
        };
        units.push(deepFreeze2(unit));
        previousUnitId = unitId;
      }
    }
    finalUnitIds.set(skill2.id, previousUnitId);
  }
  return units;
}
function stableUnitId(input, template, checkpointId) {
  return deterministicId("path-unit", {
    blueprintId: input.blueprint.id,
    blueprintVersion: input.blueprint.version,
    registryId: input.registry.id,
    registryVersion: input.registry.version,
    templateId: template.id,
    templateVersion: template.version,
    checkpointId
  });
}
function protectedCoreClosure(blueprint, mandatory = []) {
  const byId = new Map(blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => [skill2.id, skill2]));
  const protectedIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const stack = [...mandatory, ...blueprint.skills.filter((skill2) => skill2.importance === "core").map((skill2) => skill2.id)];
  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const id = stack.pop();
    if (protectedIds.has(id)) continue;
    protectedIds.add(id);
    stack.push(...byId.get(id).prerequisiteIds);
  }
  return protectedIds;
}
function nextDeferCandidate(blueprint, retained, protectedSkills) {
  const requiredByRetained = prerequisiteClosure(blueprint, retained);
  const candidates = blueprint.skills.filter((skill2) => retained.has(skill2.id) && !protectedSkills.has(skill2.id) && !requiredByRetained.has(skill2.id) && (skill2.importance === "advantage" || skill2.importance === "strong"));
  const baseComparator = skillComparator(blueprint);
  candidates.sort((left, right) => importanceRank(left) - importanceRank(right) || baseComparator(left, right));
  return candidates[0] ?? null;
}
function prerequisiteClosure(blueprint, retained) {
  const byId = new Map(blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => [skill2.id, skill2]));
  const closure = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const stack = [];
  for (const skillId of retained) stack.push(...byId.get(skillId).prerequisiteIds);
  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const id = stack.pop();
    if (closure.has(id)) continue;
    closure.add(id);
    stack.push(...byId.get(id).prerequisiteIds);
  }
  return closure;
}
function importanceRank(skill2) {
  return skill2.importance === "advantage" ? 0 : 1;
}
function buildPathVersion(input, scopeMode, units, deferredSkills, estimatedCompletionDate) {
  const unitIds = new Set(units.map((unit) => unit.id));
  const phases = input.blueprint.phases.flatMap((phase) => {
    const phaseSkillIds = new Set(phase.skillIds);
    const phaseUnitIds = units.filter((unit) => phaseSkillIds.has(unit.skillId) && unitIds.has(unit.id)).map((unit) => unit.id);
    return phaseUnitIds.length > 0 ? [{
      phaseId: phase.id,
      name: phase.name,
      outcome: phase.outcome,
      unitIds: phaseUnitIds
    }] : [];
  });
  const inputFingerprint = fingerprint({
    blueprint: input.blueprint,
    registry: input.registry,
    audit: input.audit,
    availability: input.availability,
    target: input.target,
    planningDate: input.planningDate,
    scopeMode,
    units,
    deferredSkills,
    estimatedCompletionDate,
    ...input.materialOverlay ? { materialContext: input.materialOverlay.semanticFingerprint, materialPolicyVersion: input.materialOverlay.policyVersion } : {}
  });
  return {
    id: deterministicId("learning-path", { inputFingerprint }),
    schemaVersion: input.audit.schemaVersion,
    blueprintId: input.blueprint.id,
    blueprintVersion: input.blueprint.version,
    registryId: input.registry.id,
    registryVersion: input.registry.version,
    auditVersionId: input.audit.id,
    availabilityVersionId: input.availability.id,
    targetId: input.target.id,
    scopeMode,
    phases,
    units: [...units],
    deferredSkills: [...deferredSkills],
    estimatedStartDate: input.planningDate,
    estimatedCompletionDate,
    inputFingerprint
  };
}
function deepFreeze2(value) {
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
    for (const child of Object.values(value)) deepFreeze2(child);
    Object.freeze(value);
  }
  return value;
}
function compareIssues(left, right) {
  return compareOrdinal3(left.code, right.code) || compareOrdinal3(left.path, right.path);
}
function compareOrdinal3(left, right) {
  if (left < right) return -1;
  if (left > right) return 1;
  return 0;
}

// app/lib/materials/course-relation-scope.ts
var sentenceBreak = /[。！？!?;；]|\.(?:\s+|$)/u;
var clauseBreak = /[,，]|(?=\b(?:but|whereas|while|although|however|rather than)\b)|\band\s+(?=(?:i|we|they|my|another|the)\b)|(?=但是|不过|然而|而|但|同时)/iu;
var deniedContext = /\b(?:not(?!\s+only\b)|no|never|without|rather than)\b|不(?!仅|只)|没有|并非|而非|未(?:曾|使用|涉及)/u;
var sqlContext = /\b(?:sql|sqlite|postgresql|mysql|join|cte)\b|关系数据库/u;
var softwareContext = /\b(?:software|code|api|http|typescript|javascript|python|dbt|vitest|jest|playwright)\b|软件|代码|接口|数据管道/u;
var reactContext = /\breact\b/u;
var explicitTesting = /^(?:vitest|jest|playwright|unit test(?:s|ing)?|automated tests?|automated testing|software tests?|software testing|单元测试|自动化测试|软件测试)$/u;
var testingTask = /(?:\btests?\b|\btesting\b|测试)/u;
var attachedWcagLabels = /\bwcag(?:\s*(?:的|关于)\s*表单标签|\s+(?:(?:guidance|guidelines) for )?form[ -]labels?)/u;
function courseRelationSentences(text, term) {
  return text.split(sentenceBreak).filter((part) => findMaterialSkillMention(part, term) !== null);
}
function ownContexts(text, term) {
  return courseRelationSentences(text, term).flatMap((sentence) => sentence.split(clauseBreak)).filter((part) => findMaterialSkillMention(part, term) !== null);
}
function courseRelationTopics(term, text) {
  const token = normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(term), topics = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const contexts = ownContexts(text, term);
  if (!contexts.length && !courseRelationSentences(text, term).length) return [];
  if (/\bsql\b/u.test(token) || token === "cte" || term === "JOIN" || /^(?:distributed tracing|opentelemetry|分布式追踪)$/u.test(token)) {
    topics.add(/\bsql\b/u.test(token) || token === "cte" || term === "JOIN" ? "sql" : "observability");
  }
  if (explicitTesting.test(token)) topics.add("testing");
  for (const rawContext of contexts) {
    const context = normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(rawContext);
    if (deniedContext.test(context)) continue;
    const has = (pattern) => [...rawContext.matchAll(new RegExp(pattern.source, "giu"))].some((match) => findMaterialSkillEvidence(rawContext, match[0]) !== null);
    if (has(sqlContext) && /^(?:cte|join|queries|query|(?:model )?warehouse tables|reconcile\b.*|汇总查询|联表|查询|窗口计算|空值(?:边界|处理)|替换了?日期参数|重复行问题|完成报表)$/u.test(token)) topics.add("sql");
    if (/\btypescript\b/u.test(token) || has(/\btypescript\b/u) && /^(?:(?:implement|build) (?:ui|interface) logic|实现界面逻辑)$/u.test(token)) topics.add("typescript");
    if (has(reactContext) && /^(?:react\b.*|(?:semantic )?forms?|prototype|component (?:states?|tests?|testing)|interaction tests?|表单|原型|组件状态设计|组件测试|交互测试)$/u.test(token)) topics.add("react");
    if (/^(?:html5?|semantic html forms?|labeled (?:semantic )?html forms?|accessible form labels|表单标签)$/u.test(token) && /\b(?:forms?|labels?)\b|表单|标签/u.test(context)) topics.add("web-platform");
    if (token === "wcag" && attachedWcagLabels.test(context)) {
      topics.add("web-platform");
      topics.add("design-systems");
    }
    if (/^(?:accessible form labels|表单标签|键盘焦点顺序|键盘可访问性的基本检查|按钮状态|组件说明|keyboard focus(?: order)?|button states?|component descriptions?)$/u.test(token)) topics.add("design-systems");
    if (/^(?:ui tokens?|design tokens?)$/u.test(token)) topics.add("design-systems");
    if (testingTask.test(token) && (has(softwareContext) || has(reactContext) || /^(?:清洗规则写入测试|脚本测试)$/u.test(token))) topics.add("testing");
    if (/^(?:api (?:error )?logs?|interpret api logs|log parser|traced? (?:one |a )?(?:failed )?request|document incidents)$/u.test(token) && (has(/\b(?:api|opentelemetry|python|software)\b/u) || /^api /u.test(token))) topics.add("observability");
    if (/^(?:trace|log)$/u.test(token) && /difference between (?:a )?trace and (?:a )?log/u.test(context)) topics.add("observability");
    if (/^(?:(?:(?:review|reviewing|write|create|author) (?:a |the )?)?(?:release|migration) checklist|end-to-end deployment exercise|记录回滚步骤|rollback documentation)$/u.test(token)) topics.add("cloud-delivery");
    if (/^(?:(?:define|design) )?product metrics$/u.test(token)) topics.add("product-thinking");
  }
  if (/^交互测试$/u.test(token) && courseRelationSentences(text, term).some((sentence) => /\breact\b[^,，]*(?:prototype|原型)[,，]\s*交互测试由[^。;；]*(?:协助|帮助)/iu.test(sentence))) {
    topics.add("react");
    topics.add("testing");
  }
  if (/^替换了?日期参数$/u.test(token) && courseRelationSentences(text, term).some((sentence) => /^(?:(?:项目说明|项目描述|说明)\s*[:：]\s*)?(?:所有\s*)?sql\s*由(?:导师|同事|团队)提供\s*[,，]\s*(?:我|本人)(?:只|仅)?替换了?日期参数\s*$/u.test(normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(sentence).trim()))) topics.add("sql");
  return [...topics];
}
function courseTaskBody(value) {
  return normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(value).replace(/[。.!]$/u, "").trim().replace(/^(?:required|essential|preferred|must have|nice to have|任职必备|必备|必须|加分项|岗位摘要|任职清单)\s*[:：]\s*/u, "").replace(/^(?:must be able to|must|should|required to|(?:i|we|my colleague) (?:need to|want to|will|can|have|had)|(?:learn|need|want) to) /u, "").replace(/^(?:i|we|my colleague) /u, "").replace(/^(?:练习项目中[，,]?|我|本人|我个人|只|跟随教程|按(?:导师示例|示例|评审反馈)|必须能|必须|能|掌握|学习目标是|有)+/u, "").replace(/^在[\p{L}\p{N} ]{1,40}(?:社|公司|工作室|项目中)/u, "").replace(/^(?:与设计师协作|在同事指导下)/u, "").replace(/(?:经验者优先|经验|者优先)$/u, "").replace(/[,，]?\s*(?:following review notes|按(?:导师示例|示例|评审反馈))$/u, "").trim();
}
function courseTaskScopes(text, term, wholeFact) {
  if (wholeFact) return [courseTaskBody(text)];
  const sourceTerm = term === "testing" && findMaterialSkillMention(text, term) === null ? text.match(/\btests?\b/iu)?.[0] ?? term : term;
  const broadName = /^(?:sql|typescript|react)$/u.test(normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(term));
  return courseRelationSentences(text, sourceTerm).flatMap((sentence) => {
    const clauses = sentence.split(/[,，]\s*(?=(?:按(?:导师示例|示例|评审反馈)(?=修复|检查|设计|实现|编写|构建|维护|测试|拆分|定义|交付|建立|审查)|交付|我|i\b|we\b|my\b))|(?=\b(?:but|whereas|while)\s+(?:i|we|my|another|design|write|build|implement|investigate|take)\b)|\band\s+(?=(?:i|we|my|another)\b)/iu);
    return clauses.filter((clause) => findMaterialSkillMention(clause, sourceTerm) !== null).flatMap((clause) => {
      const pieces = broadName ? [clause] : clause.split(/\s+and\s+(?=(?:design|write|build|implement|investigate|take)\b)|并(?=检查|设计|实现|编写)/iu);
      return pieces.filter((piece) => findMaterialSkillMention(piece, sourceTerm) !== null).map(courseTaskBody);
    });
  });
}

function recognizedTask(id, term, body) {
  const token = normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(term);
  if (!taskTerms[id].test(token)) return null;
  if (id === "software-signals" && /\bparser\b/u.test(body)) return null;
  for (const pattern of [tasks[id], additionalTasks[id]]) {
    const match = pattern?.exec(body);
    if (match) return { full: id !== "product-outcomes" && match.index === 0 && match[0].length === body.length };
  }
  const topics = courseRelationTopics(term, body);
  const partial2 = {
    "sql-schema": /\bsql\b/u.test(body) && /\bmodel warehouse tables\b/u.test(body),
    "sql-joins": /\bjoin\b/u.test(body) && /重复行|duplicate rows/u.test(body) || /\bsql joins?\b/u.test(body) && /\breconcile\b/u.test(token),
    "typescript-contract": /\btypescript\b/u.test(body) && /\b(?:ui|interface) logic\b|界面逻辑/u.test(body),
    "react-form": (topics.includes("react") || /\breact\b/u.test(body)) && /\bprototype\b|原型|交互测试/u.test(body),
    "semantic-form": token === "wcag" && topics.includes("web-platform"),
    "behavior-tests": topics.includes("testing"),
    "component-audit": topics.includes("design-systems") && /\btokens?\b|表单标签|accessible form labels/u.test(body),
    "software-signals": topics.includes("observability") || /\b(?:api|software|http|runtime)\b|软件|接口|运行时|服务器/u.test(body) && /\b(?:logs?|traces?|tracing)\b|日志|追踪/u.test(body),
    "release-checklist": topics.includes("cloud-delivery"),
    "product-outcomes": topics.includes("product-thinking")
  };
  if (id === "software-signals" && /^(?:explain )?the difference between (?:a )?trace and (?:a )?log$/u.test(body)) return { full: true };
  const broadBody = body.replace(/^(?:同一份)?(?:补充)?说明(?:同时)?写着\s*/u, "");
  const broadRequirement = /^(?:sql|typescript)\s+(?:is )?(?:required|preferred|essential)(?: for this (?:secondary )?role)?$/u.test(broadBody) || /^(?:required|preferred|essential)\s*[:：]?\s*(?:sql|typescript)$/u.test(broadBody) || /^(?:sql|typescript)\s*(?:为|仅为|仅)?(?:必备|加分)(?:和\s*(?:sql|typescript)\s*(?:为|仅为|仅)?(?:必备|加分))?(?:[,，]\s*不是必备)?$/u.test(broadBody);
  if (broadRequirement && (id === "sql-schema" && token === "sql" || id === "typescript-contract" && token === "typescript")) return { full: false };
  return partial2[id] ? { full: false } : null;
}

function verifiedAnchors(blueprint, registry2) {
  if (blueprint.id !== "ai-native-full-stack-engineer" || blueprint.version !== "2026.08.1" || blueprint.status !== "ready" || registry2.id !== "ai-native-full-stack-engineer-units" || registry2.version !== "2026.08.1" || !validateUnitRegistry(registry2, blueprint).valid) return /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  return new Set(COURSE_TASK_IDS.filter((id) => {
    const anchor = COURSE_TASK_EVIDENCE[id];
    const unit = registry2.tracks.find((track) => track.skillId === anchor.skillId)?.templates.find((unit2) => unit2.id === anchor.unitId);
    if (!unit) return false;
    const leaves = [anchor, ..."additionalLeaves" in anchor ? anchor.additionalLeaves : []];
    return leaves.every((leaf) => (leaf.field === "steps" ? unit.steps.find((step) => step.id === leaf.leafId)?.label : leaf.field === "completionCriteria" || leaf.field === "rubric" ? unit[leaf.field][leaf.index] : unit[leaf.field]) === leaf.quote);
  }));
}
function createCourseTaskTopicMatcher(blueprint, registry2) {
  const verified = verifiedAnchors(blueprint, registry2);
  return (term, text) => {
    const scope = text.split(/[。!?;；\n]|\.(?:\s+|$)/u).find((part) => findMaterialSkillMention(part, term) !== null);
    if (!scope) return [];
    const token = taskBody(term).replace(/^(?:write|design|model|build|create|implement|audit|choose|select) (?:a |an )?/u, "");
    const contentSkills = new Set([...verified].map((id) => COURSE_TASK_EVIDENCE[id].skillId));
    return [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
      ...taskTopics.filter(([id, pattern]) => verified.has(id) && pattern.test(token)).map(([id]) => COURSE_TASK_EVIDENCE[id].skillId),
      ...courseRelationTopics(term, text).filter((id) => contentSkills.has(id))
    ])];
  };
}
function createCourseTaskCoverageEvaluator(blueprint, registry2, source = "flagship") {
  const verified = source === "flagship" ? verifiedAnchors(blueprint, registry2) : /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  return (detail, item) => {
    if (detail.status === "omitted" || detail.status === "non-learning") return { status: "not-applicable", support: [], remaining: null };
    const bodies = courseTaskScopes(item.text, detail.term, item.skillLabels === void 0);
    const candidates = COURSE_TASK_IDS.filter((id) => detail.skillIds.includes(COURSE_TASK_EVIDENCE[id].skillId));
    const support = candidates.filter((id) => verified.has(id) && bodies.some((body) => recognizedTask(id, detail.term, body)));
    const changedEvidence = candidates.some((id) => !verified.has(id) && bodies.some((body) => recognizedTask(id, detail.term, body)));
    if (!support.length) return { status: "none", support: [], remaining: changedEvidence ? "unverified-content" : bodies.length === 1 && taskBody(detail.term) === bodies[0] && detail.status === "mapped" ? "unspecified-task" : "unassessed-scope" };
    const additionalSentence = item.skillLabels?.length === 1 && item.text.split(/[。!?;；]|\.(?:\s+|$)/u).some((part) => part.trim() && findMaterialSkillMention(part, detail.term) === null);
    const full = !additionalSentence && bodies.length === 1 && support.some((id) => recognizedTask(id, detail.term, bodies[0])?.full);
    return { status: full ? "full" : "partial", support, remaining: full ? null : "unassessed-scope" };
  };
}

var uiTerm = /^(?:(?:(?:ui|design)[ -])?tokens?|(?:(?:ui|interface|reusable|accessible)[ -])?components?(?:[ -]states?)?|local[ -]states?|设计令牌|界面组件|交互组件|组件(?:状态)?|本地状态|局部状态)$/u;
var uiContext = /\b(?:ui|user interfaces?|figma|interfaces?|accessible|accessibility)\b|界面|交互|无障碍/u;
var uiBehavior = /\b(?:components?|controls?|tokens?|focus|contrast|keyboard|states?|loading|disabled|error)\b|组件|控件|令牌|焦点|对比度|键盘|状态/u;
var unrelatedTokens = /\b(?:oauth|jwt|access|refresh|authentication|authorization|llm|prompts?|tokenization|language models?)\b|鉴权|认证|授权|访问令牌|刷新令牌|大模型|分词|提示词/u;
var modelingTerm = /^(?:(?:(?:relational|data|database|table|schema)[ -])?modell?ing|(?:关系(?:表|数据)?|关系型|数据表|数据库|数据)?建模|表设计|表结构设计)$/u;
var relationalContext = /\b(?:sql|sqlite|postgresql|mysql|relational|databases?|schema|foreign keys?|primary keys?)\b|数据库|关系表|数据表|主键|外键|表关系|表结构/u;
var unrelatedModeling = /\b(?:financial|predictive|statistical|forecasting|machine learning|3d)\b|财务|财会|金融|预测|统计|机器学习|三维/u;
var signalTerm = /^(?:(?:(?:api|server|application|operational|runtime|structured|error|request|service)[ -])?(?:logs?|logging|traces?|tracing)|(?:运行|服务|接口|系统|应用|请求|错误)?日志|(?:请求|接口|服务|调用|链路)?追踪)$/u;
var operationalContext = /\b(?:api|http|runtime|telemetry|software)\b|服务器|软件|接口|运行时/u;
var unrelatedSignals = /\b(?:woodworking|timber|lumber|firewood|paint|footprints?)\b|木工|原木|木材|颜料/u;
var testingTerm = /^(?:(?:(?:async|asynchronous|component|software|integration|regression|behavioral|behavioural)[ -])?(?:tests?|testing)|test(?:ing)?[ -](?:async|asynchronous)[ -]logic|异步测试|组件测试|软件测试|测试异步逻辑)$/u;
var softwareContext2 = /\b(?:software|code|api|http|vitest|jest|playwright|typescript|javascript)\b|软件|代码|接口/u;
var contextScopeBreak = /[。！？!?;；,，\n]|\.(?:\s+|$)|(?=\b(?:but|whereas|while|although|though|however|yet|rather than|except for|excluding)\b)|\band\s+(?=(?:i|we|our|they|my|she|he|the|another|other|not|never)\b)|(?=但是|不过|然而|而|但|却|同时)/giu;
var nonAffirmativeContext = /\b(?:not(?!\s+only\b)|no|never|neither|without|cannot|[a-z]{1,30}n['’]t|rather than|except|excluding)\b|不(?!仅|只)|没有|并非|而非|未(?:曾|能|做|使用|涉及|包含|支持)|无[需须]/u;
function hasGroundedContext(context, pattern) {
  for (const match of context.matchAll(new RegExp(pattern.source, "gu"))) {
    if (findMaterialSkillEvidence(context, match[0]) !== null) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function createContextualSkillMatcher(blueprint, registry2) {
  if (blueprint.id !== "ai-native-full-stack-engineer" || blueprint.version !== "2026.08.1" || blueprint.status !== "ready" || registry2.id !== "ai-native-full-stack-engineer-units" || registry2.version !== "2026.08.1" || !validateUnitRegistry(registry2, blueprint).valid) return () => [];
  const matchTaskTopic = createCourseTaskTopicMatcher(blueprint, registry2);
  return (term, text) => {
    const token = normalizeMaterialSkillLabel(term);
    const contexts = text.split(contextScopeBreak).map(normalizeMaterialSkillLabel).filter((context) => !nonAffirmativeContext.test(context) && findMaterialSkillEvidence(context, term) !== null);
    const matches = new Set(matchTaskTopic(term, text));
    for (const context of contexts) {
      if (uiTerm.test(token) && hasGroundedContext(context, uiContext) && hasGroundedContext(context, uiBehavior) && !unrelatedTokens.test(context)) matches.add("design-systems");
      if (modelingTerm.test(token) && !unrelatedModeling.test(context) && (hasGroundedContext(context, relationalContext) || hasGroundedContext(context, /\btables?\b/u) && hasGroundedContext(context, /\b(?:relationships?|relations?|keys?)\b/u))) matches.add("sql");
      if (signalTerm.test(token) && hasGroundedContext(context, operationalContext) && !unrelatedSignals.test(context)) matches.add("observability");
      if (testingTerm.test(token) && hasGroundedContext(context, softwareContext2)) matches.add("testing");
    }
    return [...matches];
  };
}

var englishPractice = /^(?:(?:have|had|am|was|been|do|did|also|only|currently|previously|personally|independently)\s+)*(?:not only\s+)?(?:us(?:e[ds]?|ing)|test(?:s|ed|ing)?|build(?:s|ing)?|built|writ(?:e[sn]?|ing)|wrote|implement(?:s|ed|ing)?|configur(?:e[ds]?|ing)|run(?:s|ning)?|ran|develop(?:s|ed|ing)?|maintain(?:s|ed|ing)?|debug(?:s|ged|ging)?|repair(?:s|ed|ing)?|modif(?:y|ies|ied|ying)|edit(?:s|ed|ing)?|chang(?:e[ds]?|ing)|analy[sz](?:e[ds]?|ing)|clean(?:s|ed|ing)?|deploy(?:s|ed|ing)?|install(?:s|ed|ing)?|assist(?:s|ed|ing)?)\b/iu;

function hasAssertionProse(body) {
  return /\b(?:I|my|our|we|you|your|they|their|he|his|she|her|the|a|an|no|not|never|without|cannot|will|would|plan|plans|hope|hopes|is|are|was|were|has|have|had|did|do|does|to|for|by|that|whether|supplied|provided|scheduled|arranged|recorded|documented|said|says|reported|claimed)\b/iu.test(body) || /^(?:我|本人|同事|导师|团队|小组|我们|他们|她们|由|没有|从未|未|不|无法|不能|计划|打算|将|希望|安排|记录|示例|例如)/u.test(body) || practiceAction.exec(body)?.index === 0 || body.split(/\s+/u).some((word) => englishPractice.test(word) || englishClaim.test(word));

function resumeSkillFragment(raw) {
  const body = raw.replace(/^(?:skills?|technologies|tools)\s*[:：]\s*/iu, "");
  if (hasAssertionProse(body)) return false;
  return /^[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N}_.+#/-]*(?:[ \t]+[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N}_.+#/-]*){0,2}(?:(?:\s*[,、]\s*|\s+(?:and|or)\s+)[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N}_.+#/-]*(?:[ \t]+[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N}_.+#/-]*){0,2})*[。.!]?$/u.test(body);
}
function followingActorBoundary(text) {
  for (const comma of text.matchAll(/,\s*/gu)) {
    const following = text.slice(comma.index + comma[0].length).replace(/^and\s+/iu, "");
    if (englishPractice.test(following) || englishClaim.test(following)) continue;
    const words2 = following.split(/\s+/u);
    for (let length = 1; length <= 5 && length < words2.length; length++) {
      if (!/^[\p{L}\p{N}'’_-]+$/u.test(words2[length - 1])) break;
      const predicate = words2.slice(length).join(" ");
      if (englishPractice.test(predicate) || englishClaim.test(predicate)) return comma.index;
    }
  }
  return null;
}
function personalExperienceScope(raw) {
  const normalized = raw.replace(/\s+/gu, " ").trim();
  const guided = guidedSkillScope(normalized, maskQuotes(normalized));
  let evidence = guided ?? normalized;
  let text = maskQuotes(evidence);
  if (guided && !chineseGuidance.test(text)) {
    const comma = /[，,]\s*/u.exec(text);
    if (comma && chineseGuidance.test(text.slice(comma.index + comma[0].length))) {
      evidence = evidence.slice(comma.index + comma[0].length);
      text = maskQuotes(evidence);
    }
  }
  const guidance = chineseGuidance.exec(text);
  if (guidance) {
    evidence = evidence.slice(guidance[0].length).replace(/^[，,\s]+/u, "");
    text = maskQuotes(evidence);
  }
  const passive = personalPassivePractice.exec(text);
  if (passive) {
    evidence = evidence.slice(passive[0].length);
    text = maskQuotes(evidence);
  }
  const actor = /^(?:I\s+|I['’]m\s+|(?:我|本人)(?!的|们))/iu.exec(text);
  const action = (actor ? text.slice(actor[0].length) : text).replace(/^(?:(?:目前|现在|正在|曾经|曾|亲自|独立|直接|只|仅|已经|已|来|继续))+/u, "");
  const firstClause = action.split(/[，,；;。!?！？]|\.(?=\s|$)/u, 1)[0];
  if (/(?:是[^，,；;。]*计划|的计划)/u.test(firstClause)) return null;
  const capable = /^(?:can|am able to)\s+/iu.exec(action);
  const englishAction = englishPractice.exec(action);
  const assistanceBody = capable ? action.slice(capable[0].length) : action;
  const assistanceAction = capable ? englishPractice.exec(assistanceBody) : englishAction;
  if (assistanceAction && /\bassist(?:s|ed|ing)?$/iu.test(assistanceAction[0])) {
    const object2 = /^\s+(?:with|in)\s+(.+)/iu.exec(assistanceBody.slice(assistanceAction[0].length))?.[1];
    if (!object2 || /^(?:(?:an?|the|my|our)\s+)?(?:schedul(?:e[ds]?|ing)|arrang(?:e[ds]?|ing|ements?)|record(?:s|ed|ing)?|document(?:s|ed|ing|ation)?|report(?:s|ed|ing)?|summar(?:y|ies)|notes?|plan(?:s|ned|ning)?)\b/iu.test(object2) || /\b(?:schedules?|plans?)\s*[.!]?$/iu.test(object2)) return null;
    const nestedAction = englishPractice.exec(object2);
    const objectHead = object2.split(/\s+(?:for|to|about|on|of)\b/iu, 1)[0];
    if (!nestedAction && /\b(?:scheduling|planning|(?:progress|status)\s+reporting)\s*[.!]?$/iu.test(objectHead)) return null;
    if (nestedAction && reportedActionObject.test(object2.slice(nestedAction[0].length))) return null;
  }
  if (englishAction && reportedActionObject.test(action.slice(englishAction[0].length))) return null;
  const practice = englishAction !== null || chinesePractice.test(action) || instructionalFragmentStart(action) !== null;
  const claim = conceptualAssessment("I " + action) || conceptualAssessment("I am " + action) || conceptualAssessment(action) || englishClaim.test(action) || chineseClaim.test(action) || capable !== null && englishPractice.test(action.slice(capable[0].length));
  if (!practice && !claim && (actor || !resumeSkillFragment(evidence))) return null;
  const prefix = normalized.slice(0, normalized.length - evidence.length);
  const reportPurpose = /\s+to\s+(?:record|document|report|describe|explain)\b/iu.exec(text);
  const nextActor = followingActorBoundary(text);
  evidence = evidence.slice(0, Math.min(reportPurpose?.index ?? evidence.length, nextActor ?? evidence.length));
  const quotedProposition = Array.from(evidence.matchAll(quoted)).some((match) => hasAssertionProse(match[0].slice(1, -1).trim()));
  return {
    evidence,
    whole: !quotedProposition && !reportPurpose && nextActor === null && !practiceAction.test(prefix) && !prefix.split(/\s+/u).some((word) => englishPractice.test(word))
  };
}
function uncoveredText(text, scopes) {
  const masked = maskQuotes(text);
  let uncovered = masked.replace(personalAssessmentHeading, (heading) => " ".repeat(heading.length)).replace(scopeBreak, (separator) => " ".repeat(separator.length));
  let end = 0;
  for (const scope of scopes) {
    const start = text.indexOf(scope.raw, end);
    if (start < end) return text;
    end = start + scope.raw.length;
    uncovered = uncovered.slice(0, start) + " ".repeat(scope.raw.length) + uncovered.slice(end);
  }
  return uncovered;
}
function experienceAssertionScopes(text) {
  const masked = maskQuotes(text);
  const original = assessmentScopes(text, masked);
  const excluded = uncoveredText(text, original);
  const scopes = [];
  const sentenceMask = masked.replace(/\s/gu, " ");
  for (const sentence of new Intl.Segmenter("und", { granularity: "sentence" }).segment(sentenceMask)) {
    const raw = text.slice(sentence.index, sentence.index + sentence.segment.length);
    let end = 0;
    for (const scope of assessmentScopes(raw, sentence.segment)) {
      const start = raw.indexOf(scope.raw, end);
      end = start + scope.raw.length;
      if (start >= 0 && !excluded.slice(sentence.index + start, sentence.index + end).trim()) scopes.push(scope);
    }
  }
  return scopes;
}
function supportsMaterialExperience(input) {
  if (input.kind !== "experience" && input.kind !== "skill-claim") return false;
  const scopes = experienceAssertionScopes(input.text);
  const supported = scopes.map((scope) => personalExperienceScope(scope.raw));
  if (input.target.kind === "terms") {
    return input.target.terms.length > 0 && input.target.terms.every((term) => supported.some((scope) => scope !== null && assertedSkillEvidence(scope.evidence, term)));
  }
  return scopes.length > 0 && !uncoveredText(input.text, scopes).trim() && supported.some((scope) => scope?.whole) && scopes.every((scope, index) => supported[index]?.whole || index > 0 && supported[index - 1]?.whole && /^(?:documenting|recording) (?:the )?(?:results|output)\b/iu.test(scope.text) && !/\b(?:of|from)\b/iu.test(scope.text));
}

function mapMaterialPracticeSkills(items, blueprint, registry2, options = {}) {

    if (item.kind !== "experience" && item.kind !== "skill-claim") continue;
    const skills = seen.get(item.id) ?? /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();

  }

}
