  async recordMaterialDetachment(ownerId, mutationId, change) {
    const { scope } = change.request;
    await this.mutate(ownerId, mutationId, scope.baseVersionId, { kind: "material_usage_changed" }, scope, change);
  }
  async mutate(userId, mutationId, baseVersionId, body, expected, materialDetachment) {
    const ownerId = parseOwner(userId);
    const scope = await this.resolveScope(ownerId);
    if (expected && scope.goalId !== expected.goalId) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const accepting = body.kind === "replan_accepted";
    const replay = await this.loadReplay(
      scope,
      mutationId,
      accepting ? "accept" : "event",
      accepting ? await materialSha256({ mutationId, baseVersionId, candidatePlanVersionId: body.candidatePlanVersionId }) : void 0
    );
    if (replay) return responseForEvent(replay, mutationId, baseVersionId, body);
    const stored = await repositoryRead(() => this.dependencies.repository.load(scope));
    if (!stored) throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
    const parsedStored = await this.parseOwnedWorkspace(stored, scope);
    const { workspace, sourceContext } = parsedStored;
    if (materialDetachment && workspace.pendingPlanVersionId !== null) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    if (expected && (workspace.id !== expected.workspaceId || workspace.revision !== expected.revision))
      throw new PlanningConflictError();
    if (workspace.activePlanVersionId !== baseVersionId) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    try {
      const { blueprint, registry: registry2, reference: sourceReference } = sourceContext;
      const event2 = planningEventSchema.parse({
        ...body,
        eventId: this.createId(),
        mutationId,
        sequence: workspace.lastSequence + 1,
        targetPlanVersionId: baseVersionId,
        occurredAt: this.now().toISOString()
      });
      const transition = applyPlanningEvent({ workspace, event: event2, blueprint, registry: registry2 });
      const result = resultFromTransition(transition);
      const saved = await this.dependencies.repository.saveEvent({
        ...scope,
        mutationId,
        baseRevision: workspace.revision,
        baseVersionId,
        previous: workspace,
        result,
        sourceReference,
        materialDetachment
      });
      const response = await this.parseOwnedResult(saved, scope, sourceReference);
      return responseForEvent(response, mutationId, baseVersionId, body);
    } catch (error51) {
      throw normalizeError(error51);
    }
  }
  async resolveScope(userId) {
    const ownerId = parseOwner(userId);
    let scope;
    try {
      scope = await this.dependencies.repository.findActiveGoal(ownerId);
    } catch {
      throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
    }
    if (!scope) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
    if (scope.ownerId !== ownerId || !scope.goalId) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
    return { ownerId, goalId: scope.goalId };
  }
  async loadReplay(scope, mutationId, operation, materialRequestDigest) {
    const stored = await repositoryRead(() => this.dependencies.repository.findMutation({ ...scope, mutationId, operation, materialRequestDigest }));
    return stored ? this.parseOwnedResult(stored, scope) : null;
  }
  async parseOwnedWorkspace(stored, scope) {
    assertOwned(stored, scope);
    try {
      const workspace = planningWorkspaceSchema.parse(cloneUnknown(stored.payload));
      if (workspace.goalId !== scope.goalId) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
      const sourceReference = resolveStoredReference(stored.sourceReference, workspace);
      const sourceContext = await this.resolveStoredContext(stored, scope.ownerId, sourceReference);
      assertWorkspaceSource(workspace, sourceContext);
      return { workspace, sourceContext };
    } catch (error51) {
      if (error51 instanceof PlanningNotFoundError) throw error51;
      throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
    }
  }
  async parseOwnedResult(stored, scope, expectedReference) {
    assertOwned(stored, scope);
    try {
      const result = planningMutationResultSchema.parse(cloneUnknown(stored.payload));
      if (result.workspace.goalId !== scope.goalId) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
      const sourceReference = resolveStoredReference(stored.sourceReference ?? expectedReference, result.workspace);
      if (expectedReference && JSON.stringify(sourceReference) !== JSON.stringify(expectedReference)) {
        throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
      }
      const sourceContext = await this.resolveStoredContext(stored, scope.ownerId, sourceReference);
      assertWorkspaceSource(result.workspace, sourceContext);
      return { result: { ...result, workspace: clientWorkspace(result.workspace) }, sourceContext };
    } catch (error51) {
      if (error51 instanceof PlanningServiceError) throw error51;
      throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
    }
  }
  async resolveStoredContext(stored, ownerId, sourceReference) {
    const context = stored.sourceContext === void 0 ? await this.sourceResolver.resolveForReplay(ownerId, sourceReference) : planningSourceContextSchema.parse(cloneUnknown(stored.sourceContext));
    if (JSON.stringify(context.reference) !== JSON.stringify(sourceReference)) {
      throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
    }
    if (validateRoleBlueprint(context.blueprint).issues.length || validateUnitRegistry(context.registry, context.blueprint).issues.length) {
      throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
    }
    return context;
  }
};
function responseForEvent(response, mutationId, baseVersionId, body) {
  const event2 = response.result.workspace.events.at(-1);
  if (!event2) throw new PlanningConflictError();
  const expected = {
    ...body,
    eventId: event2.eventId,
    sequence: event2.sequence,
    occurredAt: event2.occurredAt,
    mutationId,
    targetPlanVersionId: baseVersionId
  };
  if (canonicalJson(event2) !== canonicalJson(expected)) throw new PlanningConflictError();
  return response;
}
function materialUnappliedChanges(frozen, workspace) {
  return canonicalJson(frozen.audit.answers) !== canonicalJson(workspace.audit.answers) || canonicalJson(frozen.target) !== canonicalJson(workspace.target) ? [MATERIAL_UNAPPLIED_MESSAGE] : [];
}
function clientWorkspace(workspace) {
  return { ...workspace, events: workspace.events.map((event2) => {
    if (event2.kind !== "agent_replanned") return event2;
    const visible = { ...event2 };
    delete visible.materialContextFingerprint;
    delete visible.materialProposal;
    if (event2.materialContextFingerprint !== void 0) visible.materialProposal = true;
    return visible;
  }) };
}
function parseOwner(userId) {
  const parsed = authenticatedOwnerSchema.safeParse(userId);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
  return parsed.data;
}
function resolveStoredReference(input, workspace) {
  if (input) return input;
  const exactFlagship = workspace.audit.blueprintId === FLAGSHIP_SLUG && workspace.pathVersions.every((path) => path.blueprintId === FLAGSHIP_SLUG && path.blueprintVersion === workspace.audit.blueprintVersion && path.registryId === "ai-native-full-stack-engineer-units");
  if (!exactFlagship) throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
  return { source: "flagship", roleId: FLAGSHIP_SLUG };
}
function assertWorkspaceSource(workspace, context) {
  const { blueprint, registry: registry2 } = context;
  if (workspace.audit.blueprintId !== blueprint.id || workspace.audit.blueprintVersion !== blueprint.version || workspace.pathVersions.some((path) => path.blueprintId !== blueprint.id || path.blueprintVersion !== blueprint.version || path.registryId !== registry2.id || path.registryVersion !== registry2.version)) {
    throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
  }
}
function parseContract2(schema, value) {
  try {
    return schema.parse(cloneUnknown(value));
  } catch {
    throw new PlanningInvalidInputError(["contract"]);
  }
}
function assertOwned(stored, expected) {
  if (stored.ownerId !== expected.ownerId || stored.goalId !== expected.goalId) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
}
function cloneUnknown(value) {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
}
function resultFromTransition(transition) {
  return planningMutationResultSchema.parse({
    outcome: transition.kind === "automatic" ? "active" : transition.kind,
    workspace: transition.workspace,
    diff: transition.kind === "proposed" ? transition.diff : null
  });
}
function normalizeError(error51) {
  if (error51 instanceof PlanningServiceError) return error51;
  if (error51 instanceof PlanningSourceContractError) return new PlanningInvalidInputError();
  if (error51 instanceof PlanningSourceUnavailableError) return new PlanningUnavailableError();
  if (error51 instanceof PlanningEventError && error51.code === "BASE_REVISION_MISMATCH") return new PlanningConflictError();
  if (error51 instanceof PlanningInputError) return new PlanningInvalidInputError(error51.issues.map(({ code }) => code));
  if (error51 instanceof PlanningEventError || error51 instanceof PlanningScheduleError || error51 instanceof external_exports.ZodError) {
    return new PlanningInvalidInputError();
  }
  return new PlanningUnavailableError();
}
function messageFor(code) {
  if (code === "CONFLICT") return "Planning state changed. Refresh and try again.";
  if (code === "NOT_FOUND") return "Planning workspace was not found.";
  if (code === "INVALID_INPUT") return "Planning input is invalid.";
  return "Planning is unavailable. The previous valid state is unchanged.";
}
async function repositoryRead(read) {
  try {
    return await read();
  } catch (error51) {
    if (error51 instanceof PlanningServiceError) throw error51;
    throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
  }
}

// app/server/planning/material-commit.ts
function materialGuardStatement(db, ownerId, commit, options = {}) {
  const snapshot = commit.snapshot;
  const predicates = [];
  const values = [];
  const bind = (value) => {
    values.push(value);
    return `?${values.length}`;
  };
  const owner = bind(ownerId), selection = bind(snapshot.selectionRef.selectionId), revision = bind(snapshot.selectionRef.selectionRevision);
  if (snapshot.ownerId !== ownerId) throw new Error("MATERIAL_OWNER_MISMATCH");
  if (!options.ignoreSelection) predicates.push(`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_selections s WHERE s.owner_id=${owner} AND s.id=${selection} AND s.revision=${revision} AND s.state IN ('active','bound') AND json(s.scope_json)=json(${bind(JSON.stringify(snapshot.scope))}))`);
  if (options.requireContext !== false) {
    predicates.push(`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_context_versions c WHERE c.owner_id=${owner} AND c.id=${bind(commit.contextVersionId)} AND c.state='active' AND c.fingerprint=${bind(commit.fingerprint)} AND c.preview_token=${bind(commit.previewToken)} AND c.selection_id=${selection} AND c.selection_revision=${revision} AND c.snapshot_json=${bind(canonicalJson(snapshot))}${options.ignoreExpiry ? "" : ` AND c.expires_at>${bind(commit.checkedAt)}`})`);
    predicates.push(`(SELECT count(*) FROM material_context_dependencies WHERE owner_id=${owner} AND context_version_id=${bind(commit.contextVersionId)})=${bind(snapshot.dependencies.length)}`);
  }
  if (!options.ignoreSelection) predicates.push(`(SELECT count(*) FROM material_selection_entries WHERE owner_id=${owner} AND selection_id=${selection})=${bind(snapshot.dependencies.length)}`);
  for (const dependency of snapshot.dependencies) {
    const document = bind(dependency.documentId), version2 = bind(dependency.documentVersionId), confirmation = bind(dependency.confirmationId), text = bind(dependency.textVersionId), generation = bind(dependency.generation), slot = bind(dependency.slot);
    const frozen = commit.confirmations.find((item) => item.documentId === dependency.documentId);
    if (!frozen) throw new Error("MATERIAL_CONFIRMATION_MISSING");
    predicates.push(`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM documents d JOIN document_versions v ON v.owner_id=d.owner_id AND v.document_id=d.id JOIN document_confirmations f ON f.owner_id=v.owner_id AND f.document_id=v.document_id AND f.document_version_id=v.id WHERE d.owner_id=${owner} AND d.id=${document} AND d.lifecycle='active' AND d.generation=${generation} AND v.id=${version2} AND v.state='ready' AND v.text_version_id=${text} AND f.id=${confirmation} AND f.text_version_id=${text} AND f.state='active' AND json(f.items_json)=json(${bind(frozen.itemsJson)}))`);
    if (!options.ignoreSelection) predicates.push(`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_selection_entries e WHERE e.owner_id=${owner} AND e.selection_id=${selection} AND e.document_id=${document} AND e.document_version_id=${version2} AND e.confirmation_id=${confirmation} AND e.slot=${slot})`);
    if (options.requireContext !== false) predicates.push(`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_context_dependencies x WHERE x.owner_id=${owner} AND x.context_version_id=${bind(commit.contextVersionId)} AND x.document_id=${document} AND x.document_version_id=${version2} AND x.text_version_id=${text} AND x.confirmation_id=${confirmation} AND x.generation=${generation} AND x.slot=${slot} AND x.confirmation_digest=${bind(dependency.confirmationDigest)})`);
  }
  if (snapshot.sourceReference.source === "research" && !options.ignoreExpiry) {
    const source = snapshot.sourceReference;
    predicates.push(`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM research_runs r JOIN research_packages p ON p.id=r.package_id WHERE r.user_id=${owner} AND r.id=${bind(source.researchRunId)} AND r.state='ready' AND r.package_id=${bind(source.packageId)} AND r.config_fingerprint=${bind(source.configFingerprint)} AND p.config_fingerprint=r.config_fingerprint AND p.content_fingerprint=${bind(source.contentFingerprint)} AND p.blueprint_id=${bind(source.blueprintId)} AND p.blueprint_version=${bind(source.blueprintVersion)} AND p.registry_id=${bind(source.registryId)} AND p.registry_version=${bind(source.registryVersion)} AND p.expires_at>${bind(commit.checkedAt)})`);
  }
  return db.prepare(`SELECT json(CASE WHEN ${predicates.join(" AND ")} THEN '{}' ELSE '' END) AS material_guard`).bind(...values);
}
async function loadMaterialCommit(db, ownerId, contextVersionId, checkedAt) {
  const row = await db.prepare("SELECT snapshot_json,fingerprint,preview_token,state FROM material_context_versions WHERE owner_id=?1 AND id=?2").bind(ownerId, contextVersionId).first();
  if (!row || row.state !== "active") throw new Error("MATERIAL_REVOKED");
  const snapshot = contextInputSnapshotSchema.parse(JSON.parse(row.snapshot_json));
  if (snapshot.ownerId !== ownerId || await createMaterialContextFingerprint(snapshot) !== row.fingerprint) throw new Error("MATERIAL_CHANGED");
  const confirmations = [];
  for (const dependency of snapshot.dependencies) {
    const confirmation = await db.prepare("SELECT items_json FROM document_confirmations WHERE owner_id=?1 AND document_id=?2 AND document_version_id=?3 AND id=?4 AND state='active'").bind(ownerId, dependency.documentId, dependency.documentVersionId, dependency.confirmationId).first();
    if (!confirmation || await materialSha256(JSON.parse(confirmation.items_json)) !== dependency.confirmationDigest) throw new Error("MATERIAL_CHANGED");
    confirmations.push({ documentId: dependency.documentId, itemsJson: confirmation.items_json });
  }
  return { contextVersionId, fingerprint: row.fingerprint, previewToken: row.preview_token, snapshot, checkedAt, confirmations, kind: "accepted", requestDigest: "" };
}
function materialAssociationStatements(db, input) {
  const { ownerId, goalId, workspaceId, planVersionId, mutationId, commit } = input;
  const result = [];
  if (commit.kind === "generation") result.push(db.prepare(`UPDATE material_selections SET state='bound',bound_goal_id=?1,generation_mutation_id=?2,updated_at=?3 WHERE owner_id=?4 AND id=?5 AND revision=?6 AND state='active'`).bind(goalId, mutationId, commit.checkedAt, ownerId, commit.snapshot.selectionRef.selectionId, commit.snapshot.selectionRef.selectionRevision));
  if (commit.kind !== "proposal") {
    result.push(db.prepare("UPDATE goal_document_links SET enabled=0 WHERE owner_id=?1 AND goal_id=?2").bind(ownerId, goalId));
    for (const dependency of commit.snapshot.dependencies) result.push(db.prepare(`INSERT INTO goal_document_links(owner_id,goal_id,document_id,document_version_id,confirmation_id,context_version_id,slot,purpose,enabled,created_at) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7,'planning',1,?8) ON CONFLICT(owner_id,goal_id,context_version_id,document_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled=1`).bind(ownerId, goalId, dependency.documentId, dependency.documentVersionId, dependency.confirmationId, commit.contextVersionId, dependency.slot, commit.checkedAt));
  }
  result.push(db.prepare(`INSERT INTO document_usage_links(owner_id,context_version_id,goal_id,workspace_id,plan_version_id,kind,created_at) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7)`).bind(ownerId, commit.contextVersionId, goalId, workspaceId, planVersionId, commit.kind, commit.checkedAt));
  if (commit.kind === "proposal") result.push(db.prepare(`INSERT INTO material_plan_proposals(owner_id,goal_id,workspace_id,candidate_plan_version_id,active_base_plan_id,input_revision,proposal_revision,context_version_id,context_fingerprint,state,created_at) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7,?8,?9,'pending',?10)`).bind(ownerId, goalId, workspaceId, planVersionId, input.baseVersionId, input.baseRevision, input.revision, commit.contextVersionId, commit.fingerprint, commit.checkedAt));
  const endpoint = commit.kind === "generation" ? "POST /api/planning/generate" : commit.kind === "proposal" ? "POST /api/planning/material-replans" : "POST /api/planning/replans/accept";
  result.push(db.prepare(`INSERT INTO document_mutations(owner_id,endpoint,mutation_id,body_digest,result_json,created_at) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6)`).bind(ownerId, endpoint, mutationId, commit.requestDigest, JSON.stringify({ contextVersionId: commit.contextVersionId, goalId, workspaceId, planVersionId }), commit.checkedAt));
  return result;
}

// app/server/documents/adopted-context.ts
async function compareAdoptedContext(db, ownerId, candidate) {
  const { snapshot } = candidate;
  if (snapshot.ownerId !== ownerId || snapshot.scope.kind !== "goal") return { matches: false };
  const { goalId, workspaceId } = snapshot.scope;
  const { results: rows } = await db.prepare(`
    SELECT l.context_version_id,l.slot,l.document_id,l.document_version_id,l.confirmation_id,
      x.text_version_id,x.generation,x.confirmation_digest,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_usage_links u WHERE u.owner_id=l.owner_id AND u.goal_id=l.goal_id
        AND u.workspace_id=?3 AND u.context_version_id=l.context_version_id AND u.kind IN ('generation','accepted')) AS committed
    FROM goal_document_links l LEFT JOIN material_context_dependencies x ON x.owner_id=l.owner_id
      AND x.context_version_id=l.context_version_id AND x.document_id=l.document_id
      AND x.document_version_id=l.document_version_id AND x.confirmation_id=l.confirmation_id AND x.slot=l.slot
    WHERE l.owner_id=?1 AND l.goal_id=?2 AND l.purpose='planning' AND l.enabled=1
    ORDER BY l.slot,l.document_id LIMIT 6
  `).bind(ownerId, goalId, workspaceId).all();
  if (!rows.length) return snapshot.dependencies.length ? { matches: false } : { matches: true, baselineLinks: [], baselineContext: null };
  if (rows.length !== snapshot.dependencies.length || rows.some((row) => !row.committed)) return { matches: false };
  const entries = rows.map((row) => ({ slot: row.slot, documentId: row.document_id, documentVersionId: row.document_version_id, confirmationId: row.confirmation_id }));
  if (!materialSelectionEntriesSchema.safeParse(entries).success || new Set(rows.map((row) => row.context_version_id)).size !== 1) return { matches: false };
  const contextId = rows[0].context_version_id;
  const context = await db.prepare("SELECT id,snapshot_json,fingerprint,state FROM material_context_versions WHERE owner_id=?1 AND id=?2").bind(ownerId, contextId).first();
  if (!context || context.state !== "active") return { matches: false };
  let stored;
  try {
    stored = JSON.parse(context.snapshot_json);
  } catch {
    return { matches: false };
  }
  const parsed = contextInputSnapshotSchema.safeParse(stored);
  if (!parsed.success || parsed.data.ownerId !== ownerId || await createMaterialContextFingerprint(parsed.data) !== context.fingerprint) return { matches: false };
  const baseline = parsed.data;
  if (baseline.scope.kind === "goal" && (baseline.scope.goalId !== goalId || baseline.scope.workspaceId !== workspaceId)) return { matches: false };
  const links = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const dependency = baseline.dependencies.find((item) => item.documentId === row.document_id);
    if (!dependency || canonicalJson(dependency) !== canonicalJson({
      slot: row.slot,
      documentId: row.document_id,
      documentVersionId: row.document_version_id,
      confirmationId: row.confirmation_id,
      textVersionId: row.text_version_id,
      generation: row.generation,
      confirmationDigest: row.confirmation_digest
    })) return { matches: false };
    links.push({ ...dependency, contextVersionId: contextId });
  }
  const enabled = new Set(links.map((link) => link.documentId));
  if (canonicalJson(adoptionSemantics(snapshot)) !== canonicalJson(adoptionSemantics(baseline, enabled))) return { matches: false };
  return { matches: true, baselineLinks: links, baselineContext: { id: context.id, snapshotJson: context.snapshot_json, fingerprint: context.fingerprint } };
}
function adoptionSemantics(snapshot, enabled) {
  const dependencies = snapshot.dependencies.filter((item) => !enabled || enabled.has(item.documentId));
  const confirmations = new Set(dependencies.map((item) => item.confirmationId));
  const retained = (items) => (items ?? []).filter((item) => confirmations.has(item.confirmationId));
  const sorted = (items) => [...items].sort((left, right) => {
    const a = canonicalJson(left), b = canonicalJson(right);
    return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
  });
  return {
    dependencies: sorted(dependencies),
    skillMappings: sorted(retained(snapshot.skillMappings)),
    termMappings: sorted(retained(snapshot.termMappings).map((item) => ({ ...item, skillIds: [...item.skillIds].sort() }))),
    learningIntents: sorted(retained(snapshot.learningIntents)),
    sourceReference: snapshot.sourceReference,
    sourceVersions: snapshot.sourceVersions ?? null,
    policyVersion: snapshot.policyVersion,
    mappingVersion: snapshot.mappingVersion,
    explanationVersion: snapshot.explanationVersion
  };
}
function adoptedContextGuardStatement(db, ownerId, commit, match) {
  if (commit.snapshot.ownerId !== ownerId || commit.snapshot.scope.kind !== "goal") throw new Error("MATERIAL_ADOPTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH");
  const { goalId, workspaceId } = commit.snapshot.scope;
  return db.prepare(`SELECT json(CASE WHEN
    (SELECT count(*) FROM goal_document_links WHERE owner_id=?1 AND goal_id=?2 AND purpose='planning' AND enabled=1)=json_array_length(?4)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?4) expected WHERE NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM goal_document_links l JOIN material_context_dependencies x ON x.owner_id=l.owner_id
        AND x.context_version_id=l.context_version_id AND x.document_id=l.document_id
        AND x.document_version_id=l.document_version_id AND x.confirmation_id=l.confirmation_id AND x.slot=l.slot
      WHERE l.owner_id=?1 AND l.goal_id=?2 AND l.purpose='planning' AND l.enabled=1
        AND l.context_version_id=json_extract(expected.value,'$.contextVersionId') AND l.slot=json_extract(expected.value,'$.slot')
        AND l.document_id=json_extract(expected.value,'$.documentId') AND l.document_version_id=json_extract(expected.value,'$.documentVersionId')
        AND l.confirmation_id=json_extract(expected.value,'$.confirmationId') AND x.text_version_id=json_extract(expected.value,'$.textVersionId')
        AND x.generation=json_extract(expected.value,'$.generation') AND x.confirmation_digest=json_extract(expected.value,'$.confirmationDigest')
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_usage_links u WHERE u.owner_id=l.owner_id AND u.goal_id=l.goal_id AND u.workspace_id=?3
          AND u.context_version_id=l.context_version_id AND u.kind IN ('generation','accepted'))
    )) AND (?5 IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_context_versions c WHERE c.owner_id=?1 AND c.id=?5
      AND c.state='active' AND c.snapshot_json=?6 AND c.fingerprint=?7))
    THEN '{}' ELSE '' END) AS adopted_context_guard`).bind(
    ownerId,
    goalId,
    workspaceId,
    JSON.stringify(match.baselineLinks),
    match.baselineContext?.id ?? null,
    match.baselineContext?.snapshotJson ?? null,
    match.baselineContext?.fingerprint ?? null
  );
}

// app/server/documents/context-builder.ts
var MATERIAL_PREVIEW_TTL_MS = 30 * 6e4;
var MaterialContextService = class {
  constructor(options) {
    this.options = options;
    this.now = options.now ?? (() => /* @__PURE__ */ new Date());
    this.createId = options.createId ?? (() => `material-context-${crypto.randomUUID()}`);
  }
  async create(ownerId, input) {
    const request = parse3(createMaterialContextRequestSchema, input);
    const digest = await materialSha256(request);
    const prior = await this.receipt(ownerId, "POST /api/planning/material-contexts", request.mutationId);
    if (prior) {
      if (prior.body_digest !== digest) throw new PlanningConflictError();
      const id = JSON.parse(prior.result_json).contextVersionId;
      const loaded = await this.loadValid(ownerId, id);
      return createMaterialContextResponseSchema.parse({ contextVersionId: id, previewToken: loaded.commit.previewToken, preview: loaded.preview });
    }
    const selection = await this.options.db.prepare("SELECT scope_json,revision,state FROM material_selections WHERE owner_id=?1 AND id=?2").bind(ownerId, request.selectionRef.selectionId).first();
    if (!selection) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
    if (selection.state !== "active" || selection.revision !== request.selectionRef.selectionRevision || canonicalJson(JSON.parse(selection.scope_json)) !== canonicalJson(request.scope)) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    await this.assertScope(ownerId, request.scope);
    const source = await this.options.sourceResolver.resolveForGenerate(ownerId, request.source);
    const selected = await this.selected(ownerId, request.selectionRef.selectionId);
    if (selected.some((row) => row.lifecycle !== "active" || row.version_state !== "ready" || row.confirmation_state !== "active")) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const choices = this.validateChoices(request, selected, source);
    const dependencies = await Promise.all(selected.map(async (row) => ({ slot: row.slot, documentId: row.document_id, documentVersionId: row.document_version_id, textVersionId: row.text_version_id, confirmationId: row.confirmation_id, generation: row.generation, confirmationDigest: await materialSha256(JSON.parse(row.items_json)) })));
    const snapshot = contextInputSnapshotSchema.parse({ schemaVersion: DOCUMENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, ownerId, selectionRef: request.selectionRef, scope: request.scope, sourceReference: source.reference, sourceVersions: await sourceVersions(source), dependencies, ...choices, audit: request.audit, availability: request.availability, target: request.target, planningDate: request.planningDate, selectedScope: request.selectedScope, policyVersion: MATERIAL_PLANNING_POLICY_VERSION, mappingVersion: MATERIAL_MAPPING_VERSION, explanationVersion: MATERIAL_EXPLANATION_VERSION });
    const fingerprint2 = await createMaterialContextFingerprint(snapshot);
    const preview = this.project(snapshot, selected, source, fingerprint2);
    const contextVersionId = this.createId();
    const expiresAt = this.now().getTime() + MATERIAL_PREVIEW_TTL_MS;
    const previewToken = await materialSha256({ ownerId, contextVersionId, fingerprint: fingerprint2, expiresAt, nonce: crypto.randomUUID() });
    const response = createMaterialContextResponseSchema.parse({ contextVersionId, previewToken, preview });
    const commit = { contextVersionId, fingerprint: fingerprint2, previewToken, requestDigest: digest, snapshot, checkedAt: this.now().getTime(), confirmations: selected.map((row) => ({ documentId: row.document_id, itemsJson: row.items_json })), kind: request.scope.kind === "draft" ? "generation" : "proposal" };
    const statements = [materialGuardStatement(this.options.db, ownerId, commit, { requireContext: false }), this.options.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO material_context_versions(owner_id,id,snapshot_json,preview_json,fingerprint,preview_token,expires_at,state,selection_id,selection_revision,created_at) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7,'active',?8,?9,?10)`).bind(ownerId, contextVersionId, canonicalJson(snapshot), JSON.stringify(preview), fingerprint2, previewToken, expiresAt, request.selectionRef.selectionId, request.selectionRef.selectionRevision, commit.checkedAt)];
    for (const dependency of dependencies) statements.push(this.options.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO material_context_dependencies(owner_id,context_version_id,document_id,document_version_id,text_version_id,confirmation_id,generation,confirmation_digest,slot) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7,?8,?9)`).bind(ownerId, contextVersionId, dependency.documentId, dependency.documentVersionId, dependency.textVersionId, dependency.confirmationId, dependency.generation, dependency.confirmationDigest, dependency.slot));
    statements.push(this.options.db.prepare("INSERT INTO document_mutations(owner_id,endpoint,mutation_id,body_digest,result_json,created_at) VALUES (?1,'POST /api/planning/material-contexts',?2,?3,?4,?5)").bind(ownerId, request.mutationId, digest, JSON.stringify({ contextVersionId }), commit.checkedAt));
    try {
      await this.options.db.batch(statements);
    } catch {
      const winner = await this.receipt(ownerId, "POST /api/planning/material-contexts", request.mutationId);
      if (winner && winner.body_digest === digest) return this.create(ownerId, request);
      throw new PlanningConflictError();
    }
    return response;
  }
  async read(ownerId, contextVersionId) {
    const loaded = await this.loadValid(ownerId, parse3(materialIdSchema, contextVersionId));
    return readMaterialContextResponseSchema.parse({ contextVersionId, state: "active", expiresAt: new Date(loaded.row.expires_at).toISOString(), preview: loaded.preview });
  }
  async generationReceipt(ownerId, input) {
    const request = parse3(materialGenerationReceiptRequestSchema, input);
    const row = await this.options.db.prepare("SELECT c.state,c.expires_at,c.snapshot_json,g.active_slot,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM planning_workspaces w WHERE w.user_id=g.user_id AND w.goal_id=g.id) AS has_workspace FROM material_context_versions c JOIN career_goals g ON g.user_id=c.owner_id AND g.id=?3 WHERE c.owner_id=?1 AND c.id=?2").bind(ownerId, request.contextVersionId, request.goalId).first();
    if (!row) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
    const prior = await this.receipt(ownerId, "POST /api/planning/generate", request.mutationId);
    const previewExpired = row.expires_at <= this.now().getTime();
    if (prior) {
      const result = JSON.parse(prior.result_json);
      if (result.contextVersionId !== request.contextVersionId || result.goalId !== request.goalId) throw new PlanningConflictError();
      return materialGenerationReceiptResponseSchema.parse({ state: "committed", previewExpired });
    }
    if (row.active_slot !== 1 || row.has_workspace || row.state !== "active") throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const snapshot = contextInputSnapshotSchema.parse(JSON.parse(row.snapshot_json));
    if (snapshot.scope.kind !== "draft" || snapshot.scope.previousGoalId !== null) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    await this.loadValid(ownerId, request.contextVersionId, { ignoreExpiry: true });
    return materialGenerationReceiptResponseSchema.parse({ state: "uncommitted", previewExpired });
  }
  async history(ownerId, goalId, includeProposalState) {
    const owned = await this.options.db.prepare("SELECT id FROM career_goals WHERE user_id=?1 AND id=?2").bind(ownerId, parse3(materialIdSchema, goalId)).first();
    if (!owned) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
    const rows = await this.options.db.prepare(`
      WITH used AS (
        SELECT workspace_id, context_version_id, plan_version_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_used,
          CASE WHEN MAX(kind='accepted') THEN 'accepted' WHEN MAX(kind='generation') THEN 'generation' ELSE 'proposal' END AS kind
        FROM document_usage_links WHERE owner_id=?1 AND goal_id=?2 GROUP BY workspace_id, context_version_id, plan_version_id
      ), history AS (
        SELECT u.*, CASE WHEN p.state IN ('revoked','discarded') THEN p.state
          WHEN p.state='pending' AND w.pending_plan_version_id=u.plan_version_id AND w.active_plan_version_id=p.active_base_plan_id
               AND w.revision=p.proposal_revision THEN 'pending' ELSE 'unknown' END AS proposal_state
        FROM used u LEFT JOIN material_plan_proposals p ON p.owner_id=?1 AND p.goal_id=?2 AND p.workspace_id=u.workspace_id
          AND p.candidate_plan_version_id=u.plan_version_id AND p.context_version_id=u.context_version_id
        LEFT JOIN planning_workspaces w ON w.user_id=?1 AND w.goal_id=?2 AND w.id=u.workspace_id
      )
      SELECT context_version_id,plan_version_id,kind,proposal_state FROM history
      WHERE ?3=1 OR kind!='proposal' OR proposal_state='pending'
      ORDER BY last_used DESC,plan_version_id,context_version_id LIMIT 200
    `).bind(ownerId, goalId, includeProposalState === "current" ? 1 : 0).all();
    const plans = [];
    for (const row of rows.results) {
      let preview = null;
      if (row.proposal_state !== "revoked") {
        try {
          preview = (await this.loadValid(ownerId, row.context_version_id, { ignoreExpiry: true, ignoreSelection: true })).preview;
        } catch {
        }
      }
      plans.push({
        planVersionId: row.plan_version_id,
        contextVersionId: row.context_version_id,
        kind: row.kind,
        ...includeProposalState && row.kind === "proposal" ? { proposalState: row.proposal_state } : {},
        sourceAvailability: preview ? "available" : "unavailable",
        explanations: explainMaterialPreview(preview, Boolean(preview))
      });
    }
    return materialHistoryResponseSchema.parse({ plans });
  }
  async verifyGeneration(ownerId, request) {
    if (!request.materials) throw new PlanningInvalidInputError();
    const requestDigest = await materialSha256(request);
    const prior = await this.receipt(ownerId, "POST /api/planning/generate", request.mutationId);
    if (prior && prior.body_digest !== requestDigest) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const loaded = await this.verifyReference(ownerId, request.materials, Boolean(prior));
    const snapshot = loaded.commit.snapshot;
    const requestedSource = "source" in request ? request.source : { source: "flagship", roleId: request.roleId };
    const source = prior ? loaded.source : await this.options.sourceResolver.resolveForGenerate(ownerId, requestedSource);
    if (requestedSource.source !== snapshot.sourceReference.source || requestedSource.source === "research" && snapshot.sourceReference.source === "research" && requestedSource.researchRunId !== snapshot.sourceReference.researchRunId) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    if (snapshot.scope.kind !== "draft") throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const previousGoalId = "newGoal" in request ? request.newGoal?.previousGoalId ?? null : null;
    if (snapshot.scope.previousGoalId !== previousGoalId) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const compared = { ...snapshot, audit: request.audit, availability: request.availability, target: request.target, planningDate: request.planningDate, selectedScope: request.selectedScope, sourceReference: source.reference, sourceVersions: await sourceVersions(source) };
    if (await createMaterialContextFingerprint(compared) !== loaded.commit.fingerprint) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    return { sourceContext: source, overlay: loaded.preview.overlay, commit: { ...loaded.commit, requestDigest, kind: "generation" } };
  }
  async verifyProposalRequest(ownerId, input) {
    const digest = await materialSha256(input);
    const prior = await this.receipt(ownerId, "POST /api/planning/material-replans", input.mutationId);
    if (prior && prior.body_digest !== digest) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const verified = await this.verifyReference(ownerId, input, Boolean(prior));
    const result = prior ? JSON.parse(prior.result_json) : null;
    return { ...verified, noChange: result?.outcome === "no-change", unapplied: result?.unapplied === true };
  }
  compareAdoptedContext(ownerId, commit) {
    return compareAdoptedContext(this.options.db, ownerId, commit);
  }
  async recordNoChange(ownerId, request, commit, unapplied, adopted) {
    const digest = await materialSha256(request);
    const { scope } = request;
    try {
      await this.options.db.batch([
        materialGuardStatement(this.options.db, ownerId, { ...commit, checkedAt: this.now().getTime() }),
        adoptedContextGuardStatement(this.options.db, ownerId, commit, adopted),
        this.options.db.prepare("SELECT json(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM planning_workspaces w JOIN career_goals g ON g.id=w.goal_id AND g.user_id=w.user_id WHERE w.user_id=?1 AND w.goal_id=?2 AND w.id=?3 AND w.revision=?4 AND w.active_plan_version_id=?5 AND w.pending_plan_version_id IS NULL AND g.active_slot=1) THEN '{}' ELSE '' END)").bind(ownerId, scope.goalId, scope.workspaceId, scope.revision, scope.baseVersionId),
        this.options.db.prepare("INSERT INTO document_mutations(owner_id,endpoint,mutation_id,body_digest,result_json,created_at) VALUES (?1,'POST /api/planning/material-replans',?2,?3,?4,?5)").bind(ownerId, request.mutationId, digest, JSON.stringify({ outcome: "no-change", contextVersionId: commit.contextVersionId, goalId: scope.goalId, workspaceId: scope.workspaceId, unapplied }), this.now().getTime())
      ]);
    } catch {
      const winner = await this.receipt(ownerId, "POST /api/planning/material-replans", request.mutationId);
      if (!winner || winner.body_digest !== digest || JSON.parse(winner.result_json).outcome !== "no-change") throw new PlanningConflictError();
    }
  }
  async verifyReference(ownerId, reference, ignoreExpiry = false) {
    const loaded = await this.loadValid(ownerId, reference.contextVersionId, { ignoreExpiry });
    if (reference.previewToken !== loaded.commit.previewToken || canonicalJson(reference.selectionRef) !== canonicalJson(loaded.commit.snapshot.selectionRef)) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const source = ignoreExpiry ? await this.options.sourceResolver.resolveForReplay(ownerId, loaded.commit.snapshot.sourceReference) : await this.options.sourceResolver.resolveForGenerationCommit(ownerId, loaded.commit.snapshot.sourceReference);
    if (canonicalJson(await sourceVersions(source)) !== canonicalJson(loaded.commit.snapshot.sourceVersions)) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    return { ...loaded, source };
  }
  async loadValid(ownerId, id, options = {}) {
    const row = await this.options.db.prepare("SELECT * FROM material_context_versions WHERE owner_id=?1 AND id=?2").bind(ownerId, id).first();
    if (!row) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
    if (row.state !== "active" || !options.ignoreExpiry && row.expires_at <= this.now().getTime()) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const snapshot = contextInputSnapshotSchema.parse(JSON.parse(row.snapshot_json));
    if (snapshot.ownerId !== ownerId || await createMaterialContextFingerprint(snapshot) !== row.fingerprint) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const confirmations = [];
    for (const dependency of snapshot.dependencies) {
      const confirmation = await this.options.db.prepare("SELECT items_json FROM document_confirmations WHERE owner_id=?1 AND document_id=?2 AND document_version_id=?3 AND id=?4 AND state='active'").bind(ownerId, dependency.documentId, dependency.documentVersionId, dependency.confirmationId).first();
      if (!confirmation || await materialSha256(JSON.parse(confirmation.items_json)) !== dependency.confirmationDigest) throw new PlanningConflictError();
      confirmations.push({ documentId: dependency.documentId, itemsJson: confirmation.items_json });
    }
    const commit = { contextVersionId: id, fingerprint: row.fingerprint, previewToken: row.preview_token, requestDigest: "", snapshot, checkedAt: this.now().getTime(), confirmations, kind: snapshot.scope.kind === "draft" ? "generation" : "proposal" };
    try {
      await materialGuardStatement(this.options.db, ownerId, commit, options).first();
    } catch {
      throw new PlanningConflictError();
    }
    return { row, commit, preview: materialContextPreviewSchema.parse(JSON.parse(row.preview_json)) };
  }
  validateChoices(choices, selected, source) {
    const { skillMappings = [], termMappings = [], learningIntents = [] } = choices;
    if (!skillMappings.length && !termMappings.length && !learningIntents.length) return {};
    if (source.blueprint.status !== "ready" || !validateUnitRegistry(source.registry, source.blueprint).valid) throw new PlanningInvalidInputError(["material-mapping-source"]);
    const items = new Map(selected.flatMap((row) => confirmedMaterialItemsSchema.parse(JSON.parse(row.items_json)).map((item) => [`${row.confirmation_id}:${item.id}`, { row, item }])));
    const key = (choice) => `${choice.confirmationId}:${choice.itemId}`;
    const adopted = new Set(learningIntents.map(key));
    for (const choice of learningIntents) {
      const selectedItem = items.get(key(choice));
      if (!selectedItem || !learningIntentEligible(selectedItem.row, selectedItem.item)) throw new PlanningInvalidInputError(["material-intent-reference"]);
    }
    const known = new Set(source.blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => skill2.id));
    for (const mapping of [...skillMappings, ...termMappings]) {
      const selectedItem = items.get(key(mapping));
      const skillIds = "skillId" in mapping ? [mapping.skillId] : mapping.skillIds;
      if (!selectedItem || selectedItem.item.kind === "constraint" && !adopted.has(key(mapping)) || skillIds.some((skillId) => !known.has(skillId)) || "skillId" in mapping && selectedItem.item.skillLabels !== void 0 || "skillLabel" in mapping && !selectedItem.item.skillLabels?.includes(mapping.skillLabel)) throw new PlanningInvalidInputError(["material-mapping-reference"]);
    }
    return { ...skillMappings.length ? { skillMappings } : {}, ...termMappings.length ? { termMappings } : {}, ...learningIntents.length ? { learningIntents } : {} };
  }
  project(snapshot, selected, source, fingerprint2) {
    const taskCoverageFor = createCourseTaskCoverageEvaluator(source.blueprint, source.registry, source.reference.source);
    const confirmedItems = [];
    const itemReferences = [];
    const requirements = [];
    const practices = [];
    const intents = [];
    const mappingDetails = [];
    const uncoveredLabels = [];
    const issues = [];
    const uncoveredFactIds = [];
    const unadoptedFactIds = [], omittedFactIds = [];
    for (const row of selected) {
      const userMappings = {};
      const termMappings = {};
      const learningIntentItemIds = [];
      const unadopted = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      const items = confirmedMaterialItemsSchema.parse(JSON.parse(row.items_json)).map((item) => {
        const id = deterministicId("material-item", { confirmationId: row.confirmation_id, itemId: item.id });
        const eligible = learningIntentEligible(row, item);
        itemReferences.push({ id, confirmationId: row.confirmation_id, itemId: item.id, ...eligible ? { learningIntentEligible: true } : {} });
        if (snapshot.learningIntents?.some((choice) => choice.confirmationId === row.confirmation_id && choice.itemId === item.id)) learningIntentItemIds.push(id);
        else if (eligible) {
          unadopted.add(id);
          if (item.kind === "requirement" || item.skillLabels?.length) unadoptedFactIds.push(id);
        }
        const explicit = snapshot.skillMappings?.filter((mapping) => mapping.confirmationId === row.confirmation_id && mapping.itemId === item.id).map((mapping) => mapping.skillId);
        if (explicit?.length) userMappings[id] = explicit;
        const terms = snapshot.termMappings?.filter((mapping) => mapping.confirmationId === row.confirmation_id && mapping.itemId === item.id);
        if (terms?.length) termMappings[id] = terms;
        return { ...item, id };
      });
      confirmedItems.push(...items);
      const options = { userMappings, termMappings, learningIntentItemIds };
      const details = mapMaterialItemTerms(items, source.blueprint, source.registry, options);
      if (row.slot !== "jd") practices.push(...mapMaterialPracticeSkills(items, source.blueprint, source.registry, options));
      const groups = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
      for (const detail of details) {
        const item = items.find((item2) => item2.id === detail.itemId);
        const termIndex = item.skillLabels?.indexOf(detail.term) ?? -1;
        const taskCoverage = taskCoverageFor(detail, item);
        const groupKey = canonicalJson({ itemId: item.id, status: detail.status, skillIds: detail.skillIds, basis: detail.basis, taskCoverage });
        const group = groups.get(groupKey) ?? { itemId: item.id, termIndexes: [], status: detail.status, skillIds: detail.skillIds, basis: detail.basis, taskCoverage };
        if (!group.termIndexes.includes(termIndex)) group.termIndexes.push(termIndex);
        groups.set(groupKey, group);
        if (detail.status === "omitted") omittedFactIds.push(item.id);
      }
      mappingDetails.push(...groups.values());
      for (const id of learningIntentItemIds) if (!details.some((detail) => detail.itemId === id)) uncoveredFactIds.push(id);
      for (const mapping of mapMaterialItems(items, source.blueprint, source.registry, options)) {
        const item = items.find((value) => value.id === mapping.itemId);
        if (unadopted.has(item.id)) continue;
        if (mapping.status === "non-learning") continue;
        if (mapping.status !== "mapped") {
          if (mapping.status === "uncovered" || item.skillLabels === void 0) uncoveredLabels.push(...mapping.labels);
          if (mapping.status === "uncovered" && item.skillLabels !== void 0) uncoveredFactIds.push(item.id);
          else issues.push({ code: mapping.status === "ambiguous" ? "ambiguous-mapping" : "uncovered", itemIds: [item.id], skillIds: mapping.skillIds });
          continue;
        }
        for (const skillId of mapping.skillIds) {
          if (row.slot === "jd" && item.kind === "requirement") requirements.push({ skillId, level: item.requirementLevel ?? "unspecified", itemId: item.id });
          if (learningIntentItemIds.includes(item.id)) intents.push({ skillId, itemId: item.id });
        }
      }
    }
    if (uncoveredFactIds.length) issues.push({ code: "uncovered", itemIds: [...new Set(uncoveredFactIds)], skillIds: [] });
    if (unadoptedFactIds.length) issues.push({ code: "learning-intent-not-adopted", itemIds: unadoptedFactIds, skillIds: [] });
    if (omittedFactIds.length) issues.push({ code: "mapping-omitted", itemIds: [...new Set(omittedFactIds)], skillIds: [] });
    const overlay = createMaterialOverlay({ audit: snapshot.audit, knownSkillIds: source.blueprint.skills.map((skill2) => skill2.id), semanticFingerprint: fingerprint2, requirements, practiceSkillIds: practices.map((item) => item.skillId), learningIntentSkillIds: intents.map((item) => item.skillId) });
    const priorities = Object.entries(overlay.skillRanks).filter(([, tier]) => tier < 5).map(([skillId, tier]) => {
      const sources = tier === 3 ? practices : requirements.filter((item) => item.level === (tier === 4 ? "preferred" : "must"));
      const practiceItemIds = [...new Set(practices.filter((item) => item.skillId === skillId).map((item) => item.itemId))];
      const learningIntentItemIds = tier === 3 && !requirements.some((item) => item.skillId === skillId && item.level !== "unspecified") ? [...new Set(intents.filter((item) => item.skillId === skillId).map((item) => item.itemId))] : [];
      return {
        skillId,
        tier,
        itemIds: [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...sources.filter((item) => item.skillId === skillId).map((item) => item.itemId), ...learningIntentItemIds])],
        ...learningIntentItemIds.length ? { practiceItemIds, learningIntentItemIds } : {}
      };
    });
    const paths = buildLearningPaths({ blueprint: source.blueprint, registry: source.registry, audit: snapshot.audit, availability: snapshot.availability, target: snapshot.target, planningDate: snapshot.planningDate, materialOverlay: overlay });
    if (paths.infeasibleReason) issues.push({ code: "target-infeasible", itemIds: [], skillIds: overlay.mandatorySkillIds.slice() });
    const summary = (path) => ({ estimatedCompletionDate: path.estimatedCompletionDate, totalMinutes: path.units.reduce((sum, unit) => sum + unit.estimatedMinutes, 0) });
    return materialContextPreviewSchema.parse({
      confirmedItems,
      itemReferences,
      mappingDetails,
      ...snapshot.skillMappings?.length ? { skillMappings: snapshot.skillMappings } : {},
      ...snapshot.termMappings?.length ? { termMappings: snapshot.termMappings } : {},
      ...snapshot.learningIntents?.length ? { learningIntents: snapshot.learningIntents } : {},
      priorities,
      issues,
      uncoveredLabels: [...new Set(uncoveredLabels)],
      overlay,
      planning: { fullScope: summary(paths.fullScope), targetDate: paths.targetDate ? summary(paths.targetDate) : null, infeasibleReason: paths.infeasibleReason }
    });
  }
  async selected(ownerId, selectionId) {
    const rows = await this.options.db.prepare(`SELECT e.slot,e.document_id,e.document_version_id,e.confirmation_id,v.text_version_id,d.generation,f.items_json,d.lifecycle,v.state AS version_state,f.state AS confirmation_state FROM material_selection_entries e JOIN documents d ON d.owner_id=e.owner_id AND d.id=e.document_id JOIN document_versions v ON v.owner_id=e.owner_id AND v.document_id=e.document_id AND v.id=e.document_version_id JOIN document_confirmations f ON f.owner_id=e.owner_id AND f.document_id=e.document_id AND f.document_version_id=e.document_version_id AND f.id=e.confirmation_id WHERE e.owner_id=?1 AND e.selection_id=?2 ORDER BY e.slot,e.document_id`).bind(ownerId, selectionId).all();
    return rows.results;
  }
  async assertScope(ownerId, scope) {
    if (scope.kind !== "goal") return;
    const repository = this.options.planningRepository;
    if (!repository) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const active = await repository.findActiveGoal(ownerId);
    if (!active || active.goalId !== scope.goalId) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    const stored = await repository.load(active);
    if (!stored || stored.ownerId !== ownerId) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
    const workspace = planningWorkspaceSchema.parse(stored.payload);
    if (workspace.id !== scope.workspaceId || workspace.activePlanVersionId !== scope.baseVersionId || workspace.revision !== scope.revision || workspace.pendingPlanVersionId) throw new PlanningConflictError();
  }
  receipt(ownerId, endpoint, mutationId) {
    return this.options.db.prepare("SELECT body_digest,result_json FROM document_mutations WHERE owner_id=?1 AND endpoint=?2 AND mutation_id=?3").bind(ownerId, endpoint, mutationId).first();
  }
};
function learningIntentEligible(row, item) {
  return row.slot !== "jd" && (item.kind === "constraint" || item.kind === "requirement");
}
async function sourceVersions(source) {
  return { blueprintId: source.blueprint.id, blueprintVersion: source.blueprint.version, registryId: source.registry.id, registryVersion: source.registry.version, contentDigest: await materialSha256({ blueprint: source.blueprint, registry: source.registry }) };
}
function parse3(schema, input) {
  const result = schema.safeParse(input);
  if (!result.success) throw new PlanningInvalidInputError();
  return result.data;
}

// app/server/documents/detach-adopted-material.ts
function materialDetachmentStatements(db, ownerId, change) {
  const repo = new D1DocumentRepository(db);
  const { scope, entry } = change.request;
  return [
    repo.guard(`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM planning_workspaces w JOIN career_goals g ON g.user_id=w.user_id AND g.id=w.goal_id
      WHERE w.user_id=? AND w.goal_id=? AND w.id=? AND w.revision=? AND w.active_plan_version_id=?
        AND w.pending_plan_version_id IS NULL AND g.active_slot=1 AND g.status='active')`, ownerId, scope.goalId, scope.workspaceId, scope.revision, scope.baseVersionId),
    repo.statement(
      `UPDATE goal_document_links SET enabled=0 WHERE owner_id=? AND goal_id=? AND purpose='planning' AND enabled=1
      AND document_id=? AND document_version_id=? AND confirmation_id=? AND slot=?
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_usage_links u WHERE u.owner_id=goal_document_links.owner_id AND u.goal_id=goal_document_links.goal_id
        AND u.context_version_id=goal_document_links.context_version_id AND u.workspace_id=? AND u.kind IN ('generation','accepted'))`,
      ownerId,
      scope.goalId,
      entry.documentId,
      entry.documentVersionId,
      entry.confirmationId,
      entry.slot,
      scope.workspaceId
    ),
    repo.changed(),
    // Revoke open drafts. History reads the immutable snapshot independently of its selection.
    repo.statement(
      `UPDATE material_selections SET state='revoked',updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND state='active'
      AND json_extract(scope_json,'$.kind')='goal' AND json_extract(scope_json,'$.goalId')=? AND json_extract(scope_json,'$.workspaceId')=?`,
      repo.now(),
      ownerId,
      scope.goalId,
      scope.workspaceId
    ),
    repo.receiptStatement(change.identity, change.receipt)
  ];
}

    const row = await this.db.prepare(`

  async findMutation(input) {
    const row = await this.db.prepare(`
      SELECT response_json FROM idempotency_records
      WHERE user_id = ?1 AND scope = ?2 AND mutation_id = ?3
      LIMIT 1
    `).bind(input.ownerId, scopeFor(input.goalId), input.mutationId).first();
    if (!row) return null;
    const stored = parseStoredMutation(row.response_json);
    if (stored.ownerId !== input.ownerId || stored.goalId !== input.goalId) throw new PlanningNotFoundError();
    const generationRequested = input.operation === "generation" || input.operation === "material-generation";
    if (input.operation && stored.kind === "generation" !== generationRequested) throw new PlanningConflictError();
    await this.assertMaterialReplay(input);
    if (stored.kind === "generation") {
      const sourceReference = storedReference(stored);
      const sourceContext = await this.resolveReplaySource(input.ownerId, sourceReference, stored.result.workspace);
      return { ownerId: stored.ownerId, goalId: stored.goalId, payload: stored.result, sourceReference, sourceContext };
    }
    const history = await this.replayHistory(input, stored.sequence);
    const replay = history.resultAtTarget;
    if (!replay || replay.outcome !== stored.outcome || history.lineageAtTarget !== stored.lineageFingerprint) {
      throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
    }
    return {
      ownerId: stored.ownerId,
      goalId: stored.goalId,
      payload: replay,
      sourceReference: history.sourceReference,
      sourceContext: history.sourceContext
    };
  }
  async load(scope) {
    const workspaceRow = await this.db.prepare(`

        active_path_version_id, active_plan_version_id, pending_plan_version_id

    `).bind(scope.ownerId, scope.goalId).first();
    if (!workspaceRow) return null;
    try {
      const row = await this.db.prepare(`SELECT response_json FROM idempotency_records
        WHERE user_id = ?1 AND scope = ?2
          AND json_extract(response_json, '$.kind') = 'generation'
        ORDER BY created_at ASC
        LIMIT 1`).bind(scope.ownerId, scopeFor(scope.goalId)).first();
      if (!row) throw new Error("missing workspace payload");
      const generation = parseStoredGeneration(row.response_json);
      if (generation.ownerId !== scope.ownerId || generation.goalId !== scope.goalId) throw new Error("owner mismatch");
      const replayed = await this.replayHistory(scope, workspaceRow.next_sequence - 1, generation);
      const snapshot = replayed.workspace;
      const [audit, availabilities, paths, plans, units] = await Promise.all([
        this.loadOne("skill_audit_versions", scope, workspaceRow.current_audit_version_id),
        this.loadMany("availability_versions", scope),
        this.loadMany("learning_path_versions", scope),
        this.loadMany("plan_versions", scope),
        this.loadMany("daily_units", scope)
      ]);
      const workspace = parsePlanningWorkspaceAtRepositoryBoundary({
        ...snapshot,
        audit,
        availabilityVersions: alignRows(availabilities, snapshot.availabilityVersions, versionKey),
        availability: availabilities.find((item) => readId(item) === workspaceRow.current_availability_version_id),
        pathVersions: alignRows(paths, snapshot.pathVersions, versionKey),
        planVersions: alignRows(plans, snapshot.planVersions, versionKey),
        dailyUnits: alignRows(units, snapshot.dailyUnits, dailyUnitKey)
      });
      if (workspace.id !== workspaceRow.id || workspace.revision !== workspaceRow.revision || workspace.lastSequence + 1 !== workspaceRow.next_sequence || workspace.audit.id !== workspaceRow.current_audit_version_id || workspace.availability.id !== workspaceRow.current_availability_version_id || workspace.activePathVersionId !== workspaceRow.active_path_version_id || workspace.activePlanVersionId !== workspaceRow.active_plan_version_id || workspace.pendingPlanVersionId !== workspaceRow.pending_plan_version_id) {
        throw new Error("pointer mismatch");
      }
      if (canonicalJson(workspace) !== canonicalJson(snapshot)) throw new Error("snapshot mismatch");
      return {
        ...scope,
        payload: workspace,
        sourceReference: replayed.sourceReference,
        sourceContext: replayed.sourceContext
      };
    } catch (error51) {
      if (error51 instanceof PlanningUnavailableError && error51.reason === "version-mismatch") throw error51;
      throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
    }
  }
  async saveGeneration(command) {
    const result = parseMutationResult(command.result);
    if (result.workspace.goalId !== command.goalId || result.workspace.revision !== 0) throw new PlanningUnavailableError();
    const sourceReference = parseSourceReference(command.sourceReference);
    const mutationLookup = {
      ...command,
      operation: command.materialCommit ? "material-generation" : "generation",
      materialRequestDigest: command.materialCommit?.requestDigest
    };
    const replay = await this.findMutation(mutationLookup);
    if (replay) return replay;

    if (command.materialCommit) {

      statements.push(this.db.prepare("SELECT json(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_selections WHERE owner_id=?1 AND id=?2 AND state='active') THEN '{}' ELSE '' END)").bind(command.ownerId, commit.snapshot.selectionRef.selectionId));
    }
